Job.JobTitle: Assistant Scientist, Associate Scientist, Scientist in Large Nonlinear Computational Dynamical Systems, College of Optics and Photonics
Job.JobDescription:
The Opportunity

The University of Central Florida (UCF) is looking for a 12-month, non-tenure earning assistant scientist, associate scientist, or scientist, to conduct research in the College of Optics and Photonics. This position is located at the UCF main campus with an anticipated start date in Spring 2027. UCF is undergoing rapid growth in the size of external research funding, academic stature, and student and faculty groups. UCF supports and benefits from economic growth in Central Florida, which is emerging as a major hub for technology development. The University is located in the metropolitan Orlando area, which offers a vibrant lifestyle and a variety of cultural and recreational activities.


CREOL (Center for Research and Education in Optics and Lasers) is one of the world's foremost institutions for research and education in optical and photonic science and engineering. The College offers MS and PhD degrees in optics and photonics, and a BS degree in photonic science and engineering. The faculty engages in fundamental and applied research and education in lasers, optical fibers, semiconductor and integrated photonic devices, nonlinear and quantum optics, imaging, sensing, and displays. The college is home to the CREOL, Florida Photonics Center of Excellence (FPCE), and Townes Laser Institute (TLI), and the Institute for the Frontier of Attosecond Science and Technology (iFAST). In addition, the College of Medicine, which includes the Burnett School of Biomedical Sciences, provides rich opportunities for collaboration. For more information see www.creol.ucf.edu.

Applications are invited for a position in computational nonlinear dynamics and large-scale numerical modeling of semiconductor laser arrays at the College of Optics and Photonics (CREOL), University of Central Florida. Our research program investigates collective dynamics, synchronization, and self-organization in large arrays of coupled semiconductor diode lasers. The work combines experiments with computational and theoretical modeling of nonlinear dynamical systems with time-delayed interactions.


A major objective of this position is to develop and implement efficient numerical methods for increasingly large and complex systems of coupled nonlinear delay-differential equations (DDEs). Models range from arrays of single-mode semiconductor lasers described by Lang–Kobayashi-type equations to substantially larger multimode systems incorporating multiple optical modes, carrier dynamics, nonlinear interactions, heterogeneity, and delayed nonlocal coupling. As the number of lasers and optical modes increases, direct numerical simulation becomes computationally demanding. The successful candidate will therefore focus not only on physical modeling but also on developing, optimizing, and accelerating computational approaches capable of treating large laser networks efficiently.


The research scientist will contribute to several areas, including:

  • Numerical integration of large systems of nonlinear delay-differential equations
  • Modeling of single-mode and multimode semiconductor laser arrays
  • Optimization and acceleration of existing simulation codes
  • Parallel computing and high-performance computing (HPC)
  • GPU acceleration, where appropriate
  • Development of scalable numerical algorithms for systems containing large numbers of lasers and optical modes

An important component of the project will be determining how numerical algorithms and existing stimulation codes can be redesigned or optimized to achieve substantial improvements in computational speed while preserving numerical accuracy and stability. The position provides an opportunity to work at the intersection of computational mathematics, nonlinear dynamics, high-performance computing, and experimental photonics. The research is closely connected with ongoing experiments involving large semiconductor diode laser arrays. This interaction provides an unusual opportunity for computational researchers to test theoretical and numerical predictions against experimentally observed collective dynamics. This position allows for opportunities for interdisciplinary collaboration involving researchers in optics, photonics, nonlinear dynamics, applied mathematics, and computational science.


Semiconductor-laser experience is not required. The successful candidate will work closely with experimental researchers, and the necessary background in semiconductor laser physics and external-cavity laser systems can be developed as part of the project.


Minimum Qualifications:

  • Ph.D. from an accredited institution in Applied Mathematics, Computational Mathematics, Computational Science, Physics, Optical Science, Electrical Engineering or a closely related discipline.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Strong experience in one or more of the following:
    • Numerical methods for ordinary and delay-differential equations.
    • Scientific computing and numerical analysis
    • Large-scale dynamical systems
    • High-performance computing
    • Parallel numerical algorithms
    • GPU computing
  • Strong programming skills are very important.
  • Experience with C/C++, Python, Julia, MATLAB, CUDA, or a comparable scientific-computing environment is desirable.

Additional Application Materials Required:

UCF requires all applications and supporting documents to be submitted electronically through the Human Resources employment opportunities website, https://www.ucf.edu/jobs/. In addition to the online application, interested candidates should upload the following:


  • A curriculum vitae.
  • Brief statement of research interests and relevant experimental experience.
  • A list of publications
  • List of three professional references with contact information

NOTE: Please have all documents ready when applying so they can be simultaneously uploaded. Once the online submission process is finalized, the system does not allow applicants to submit additional documents later.

The selected candidate will be required to submit official transcripts (and, as applicable, U.S. degree equivalency evaluations) documenting the conferral of their qualifying academic credentials.

Questions regarding this search should be directed to: Dr. Yehuda Braiman at yehuda.braiman@ucf.edu.

Special Instructions to the Applicants:

This position is restricted to U.S. citizens or U.S. permanent residents due to the nature of the research funding. All applicants must be authorized to work for any U.S. employer. H-1B visa sponsorship is not available for this position, and the university cannot accommodate H-1B transfers or employment-based visa processing for individuals currently sponsored by another employer.

This is a Contract & Grants (C&G) funded position. Employment is subject to availability of funding and may cease at the time funding for this employment is depleted.

The position is anticipated for at least two years, with continued appointment and possible extension subject to satisfactory performance and availability of funding.


Note to applicants: Please keep in mind that a job posted without an end date may close at any time without notice. As such, we encourage you to submit your application and all required documentation as quickly as possible to ensure consideration for the posted position.


Are you ready to unleash YOUR potential?

As a next-generation public research university and Forbes-ranked top employer in Florida, we are a community of thinkers, doers, creators, innovators, healers, and leaders striving to create broader prosperity and help shape a better future. No matter what your role is, when you join Knight Nation, you'll play an integral role at one of the most impactful universities in the country. You'll be met with opportunities to connect and collaborate with talented faculty, staff, and students across 13 colleges and multiple campuses, engaging in impactful work that makes a positive difference. Your time at UCF will provide you with many meaningful opportunities to grow, you'll work alongside talented colleagues on complex projects that will challenge you and help you gain new skills and you'll have countless rewarding experiences that go well beyond a paycheck.

Working at UCF has its perks! UCF offers:

  • Benefit packages, including Medical, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, Flexible Spending, and Employee Assistance Program.
  • Paid time off, including annual (12-month faculty) and sick time off and paid holidays.
  • Retirement savings options.
  • Employee discounts, including tickets to many Orlando attractions.
  • Education assistance.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • And more…For more benefits information, view the UCF Employee Benefits Guide click here.

Unless explicitly stated on the job posting, it is UCF's expectation that an employee of UCF will reside in Florida as of the date the employment begins.

Additional Requirements related to Research Positions:

Pursuant to Florida State Statute 1010.35, prior to offering employment to certain individuals in research-related positions, UCF is required to conduct additional screening. Applicants subject to additional screening include any citizen of a foreign country who is not a permanent resident of the U.S., or who is a citizen or permanent resident but is affiliated with or has had at least 1 year of education, employment, or training in China, Cuba, Iran, Russia, North Korea, Syria, or Venezuela.

The additional screening requirements only apply to research-related positions, including, but not limited to faculty, graduate positions, individuals compensated by research grants or contract funds, post-doctoral positions, undergraduate positions, visiting assistant professors, and visiting research associates.

Work you will do

As a Deloitte Senior, Tax Analyst You will be responsible for delivering payroll tax services for clients. You will need to deliver the following activities to the highest standards of client service with impeccable levels of accuracy:

  • Configuration of payroll wage codes for the accurate application of employer and employee taxes and social security

  • Preparation and filing of payroll tax returns
  • Preparation of Forms W-2, Forms 1099 and state equivalents
  • Perform regular audits to identify and resolve compliance issues, avoiding delays in filings and monitoring penalties/notices.
  • Work in partnership with clients to ensure accurate and timely processing of payroll tax liabilities.
  • Reconcile federal and state withholding taxes and unemployment taxes monthly, quarterly, and annually.
  • Apply for identification numbers, such as FEIN and SUI, when entering new jurisdictions.
  • Evaluate and improve payroll tax processes for higher efficiency and accuracy.
  • Identify opportunities for automation and lead implementation efforts related to payroll taxes.
  • Coordinate year-end efforts to ensure accurate W-2s and other annual tax filings.
  • Ensure proper setup and maintenance of local withholding codes for employers and employees in the Deloitte payroll tax system.
  • Good knowledge on Tax State/SUI agency portals
  • Perform quarterly reconciliation and data analysis
  • Reconcile payroll taxes at the employee level
  • Tax Adjustment & Amendment knowledge
  • Play a lead role in Year-End processing for accurate W-2

JOB SUMMARY:

The Scrum Master will facilitate agile development and how information is exchanged across teams to support delivery. Support the scrum methodology that allows the team to self-organize and make changes quickly, in accordance with agile principles. This person supports that all activities use the principles of the Universal Scrum Framework and guides the team toward improving the way they work to be more effective. The Scrum Master removes impediments internal and external to the team and guides the team to an optimum, sustainable velocity. Act as support leader that enables the team to adopt an attitude of continuous improvement. The Scrum Master facilitates Scrum ceremonies including sprint planning, retrospectives and sprint demos to maintain team effectiveness. The Scrum Master works with the Release Train Engineer(s) to integrate the teams efforts with other teams. They communicate information and metrics to the team on progress against team objectives.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

AGILE / SCRUM PRACTICES

  • Facilitate agile ceremonies including sprint planning, retrospectives and sprint demos. Work with the Release Train Engineer to integrate efforts, other teams. Consult with the Product Owner to validate and communicate team priorities. Guide, coach and motivate the team with the goal of increasing productivity.
  • Guiding the team and organization on how to use Agile/Scrum practices and values to drive end value
  • Serve as the teams Scrum expert. Guide the team toward improving the way they work. Remove impediments to help the team reach an optimum, sustainable velocity.
  • Leads the team on self-organizing to fill in the intentional gaps left in the Agile/Scrum frameworks.
  • Foster accountability, transparency, and regularity in status updates. Remove impediments external to the team. Ensure that the Agile tracking system is always up to date to reflect the current state.
  • Assess the Scrum Maturity of the team and organization and coaching the team to higher levels of maturity, at a pace that is sustainable and comfortable for the team and organization.

COMMUNICATION / COLLABORATION

  • Communicate and ensure alignment of priorities with Program stakeholders and within the team.
  • Build and support a trusting and safe environment where challenges are address proactively with an emphasis on healing and problem-solving.
  • Assisting with internal and external communication, improving transparency, and radiating the right information the teams need at the right time.
  • Remove impediments or guiding the team to remove impediments by finding the right personnel to remove the impediment.
    Facilitating getting the work done without coercion, assigning, or dictating the work.

METRICS / REPORTING

  • Manage, publish, and communicate information radiators and relevant metrics to the team on progress against team objectives.
  • Understands and actively participates in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UO policy, procedures, training and team member involvement activities.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Certified Scrum Master to lead Agile software development
  • Experience guiding teams to effectively write/ split / map stories
  • Understanding of basic fundamentals of software development processes and procedures.
  • Applicable knowledge of the technologies used by IT.
  • Ability to develop, plan, manage or execute projects or work plans to ensure successful completion
  • Demonstrated knowledge of test driven development
  • Experience with Continuous Integration / Continuous Delivery processes related to Scrum
  • Experience with relative estimation, retrospective, and agile release planning techniques
  • Must be self-motivated, well-organized and have strong innovation and facilitation skills.
  • Proven oral, written, and business presentation skills.
  • Strong analytical skills.
  • Ability to interface effectively with Release Train Engineer(s) and all levels and across organizational lines, including business units.
  • Ability to effectively utilize external vendors and resources throughout the organization.

EDUCATION:

  • Associates degree required in Information Technology or Technical degree preferred;
  • Bachelors degree preferred in Information Technology or Technical degree

EXPERIENCE:

  • 5+ years of scrum experience with 2+ years as a Scrum Master required;
  • or equivalent combination of education and experience.

CERTIFICATIONS, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS:

  • Certified Scrum Master CSM or SAFe Scrum Master SSM (Required)
  • Safe Advanced Scrum Master SASM (Desired)
  • Certified Product Owner CSPO (Desired)
  • PMI Agile Certified Practitioner ACP (Desired)
  • Certified SAFe Agilist SA (Desired)

JOB OVERVIEW:

The Software Quality Assurance Analyst is responsible for validating the quality and production readiness of software solutions by translating business requirements into effective test strategies, executing comprehensive testing, and providing actionable quality insights. This role embraces an AI-first quality engineering mindset, leveraging Generative AI, Testing Agents, and automation technologies to accelerate test design and execution, improve test coverage, streamline defect investigation, and enhance quality insights. The analyst collaborates across Product, Development, Data, and Business teams to ensure requirements are met, risks are identified early, and software releases are delivered with confidence, quality, and efficiency.

ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

-Review business, functional, and technical requirements to ensure clarity, completeness, and testability.

-Design, author, maintain, and execute test scenarios, test cases, test suites, and related test artifacts within Azure DevOps (ADO), ensuring end-to-end traceability between requirements, tests, defects, and releases.

-Execute functional, integration, system, regression, exploratory, and data validation testing as appropriate.

-Identify, document, prioritize, and track defects in a clear, reproducible manner through resolution.

-Analyze test results and defect trends to identify risks, recurring issues, and opportunities to improve testing processes, automation coverage, and overall quality engineering effectiveness.

-Create, configure, and leverage AI-powered Testing Agents, reusable Skills, and Generative AI tools to support requirements analysis, test design, test data generation, defect investigation, documentation, and quality insights while applying appropriate human oversight and validation.

-Proactively communicate project status, quality risks, dependencies, and issues to stakeholders and leadership.

-Monitor and manage assigned work items, testing activities, and release deliverables to ensure timely execution.

-Produce accurate, actionable, and timely test reports, quality metrics, and release readiness assessments.

-Effectively prioritize and execute work in fast-paced Agile delivery environments with competing priorities.

-Research and evaluate emerging testing technologies, AI capabilities, quality engineering practices, and industry trends to continuously improve testing outcomes.

REQUIRED TECHNICAL SKILLS:

-2+ years of experience in development or QA

-Experience with Azure DevOps (ADO) for test case management, defect tracking, execution, and reporting.

-Experience leveraging Generative AI, AI-powered Testing Agents, and reusable Skills, or similar AI-assisted technologies within the software development and testing lifecycle.

-Experienced in functional test design, execution, and analysis.

-Thorough understanding of development and testing life cycles (SDLC/STLC).

-Experience working in an agile environment.

-Experience with browser compatibility testing

REQUIRED EDUCATION:

-Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Management Information Systems, Applied Mathematics

OTHER KEY QUALIFICATIONS:

-Highly motivated self-starter with the ability to work independently.

-Excellent analytical and organizational skills with strict attention to detail.

-Creativity in proactively developing approaches to problems and recommending actions to management, or implementing the recommendations.

-Strong team player, willingness to do whatever it takes to complete assignments on time with quality.

-Excellent communication skills, both written and oral.

-Ability to communicate using both technical and non-technical "layman's" terms to an audience.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

-QAI, ISTQB, CSTP, CSTAS, CTFL or CTAL Certification.

-Knowledge of industry standard test practices and strategies.

-Ability to create and execute SQL queries to support data validation, troubleshooting, and quality analysis.

-Experience with test automation frameworks such as Playwright, Selenium, or equivalent modern automation tools.

-Experience using GitHub Copilot, Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, or similar AI-assisted development and testing tools.

-Identify repeatable testing activities and convert them into reusable automation assets, AI-assisted workflows, and quality engineering accelerators.

-Experience with Point of Sale (POS) systems.

-Experience with mobile application testing across multiple technologies such as, but not limited to; J2ME, Android, Symbian, .NET Technology.

-Knowledge of restaurant operations a plus.

Position Summary

Our Deloitte Cyber team understands the unique challenges and opportunities businesses face in cybersecurity. Join our team to deliver powerful solutions to help our clients navigate the ever-changing threat landscape. Through powerful solutions and managed services that simplify complexity, we enable our clients to operate with resilience, grow with confidence, and proactively manage to secure success.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/31/2026.

Work you'll do

As an Associate Vice President, Engineering Management on the Cyber Identity team, you will be responsible for…

· Leading the strategy, solutioning, and delivery of privileged access management (PAM) engagements across cloud, hybrid, and on-premises environments.

· Advising client leaders on PAM platform strategy, vendor evaluation, control design, and roadmap decisions across privileged account management, session management, endpoint privilege management, secrets management, and secure remote access.

· Overseeing multiple concurrent engagements, including scope, staffing, budgets, margins, delivery risk, quality, and executive-level status reporting.

· Directing enterprise-scale PAM implementation and application onboarding programs, including operating model design, build standards, testing, cutover planning, runbooks, and transition to operations.

· Driving practice growth through business development, proposal development, alliance relationships, technical mentoring, and leadership of multidisciplinary delivery teams across geographies.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

· Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team

· Effective written and verbal communication skills

· Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product

· Ability to build and sustain professional relationships

· Ability to lead projects or workstreams

· Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment

· Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor

· Ability to meet deadlines

· Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The team

Deloitte's Cyber Identity team helps organizations strengthen security, support transformation, and manage risk through identity-centered solutions across the enterprise. Within that practice, the Privileged Access Management offering focuses on strategy, implementation, modernization, and operations for privileged account controls, secrets management, endpoint privilege management, and secure access capabilities. Teams work across leading platforms and delivery models to help clients improve governance, reduce risk, and scale sustainable PAM programs.

Qualifications

Required:

· Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Security, Engineering, Information Technology, Finance, or Business

· 12+ years of experience in information technology or cybersecurity involving the design, implementation, or architecture of information systems or security solutions

· 10+ years of experience delivering privileged access management solutions across strategy, design, implementation, migration, and operations

· Experience leading enterprise-scale privileged access management implementations using one or more platforms such as CyberArk, Delinea, BeyondTrust, HashiCorp Vault, or comparable solutions

· Experience owning business development, scope, pricing, staffing, budgets, margin, risk, and quality across multiple concurrent client engagements

· Ability to travel 40–60%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.

· Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred:

· Advanced degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Security, Engineering, Information Technology, Finance, or Business

· Prior Big 4 or top-tier consulting experience at the Senior Manager level or above

· Certifications in one or more privileged access management platforms such as CyberArk, Delinea, BeyondTrust, or HashiCorp Vault

· CISSP, Certified Information Security Manager (CISM), or equivalent certification

· Experience with cloud-native privileged access or cloud infrastructure entitlement management capabilities, including Amazon Web Services Identity and Access Management (AWS IAM), Microsoft Azure Privileged Identity Management (Azure PIM), or Google Cloud Platform Identity and Access Management (GCP IAM)

· Experience leading distributed delivery teams and engaging C-suite stakeholders on enterprise cyber risk strategy

Our people and culture

Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas, and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients' most complex challenges. Our purpose

Deloitte's purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. This position is the trainee in the Wastewater Plant Operator series in which employees work under the close supervision of a Certified Treatment Plant Chief Operator or supervisor while learning to carry out routine duties in the operation of the Wastewater Treatment Plant and preparing to obtain a Class C Treatment Plant Operator license. Performs other related work as assigned.

Wastewater Plant Operator “A”:

Under direction, performs advanced skilled work in the efficient operation of a wastewater treatment plant on an assigned shift or rotating shift requiring a Class A operator license. Makes proper adjustments to equipment, machinery operating controls, and related control apparatus in accordance with established procedures and standards. Performs other related work as assigned. Exercises some independent judgment in making adjustments; however, unusual or major problems are reported to a shift supervisor for resolution. This is a safety-sensitive position subject to safety regulations. Work is normally performed under direction of Treatment Plant Operations Shift Supervisor and is reviewed primarily by observation and through the analysis of charts and reports.

Makes proper adjustments to equipment, machinery operating controls, and related control apparatus in accordance with established procedures and standards. Performs other related work as assigned. Exercises some independent judgment in making adjustments; however, unusual or major problems are reported to a shift supervisor for resolution. This is a safety-sensitive position subject to safety regulations. Work is normally performed under direction of Treatment Plant Operations Shift Supervisor and is reviewed primarily by observation and through the analysis of charts and reports.

Wastewater Plant Operator “C”:

JOB SUMMARY:

The Manager, Global UXUI Experience Design, Research & Accessibility role is a core member of the Global Experience Design Group at UDX, working closely with a cross functional team to craft usability studies, analyze results, and derive insights and recommendations to inform development of new experiences that unlock the potential of Universal Parks products and platforms for our guests. Leads and supports the development of usability testing and accessibility strategies and activities focused on driving business results and validating useful, usable, accessible, and delightful interactions across our global digital product experiences

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

USABILITY TESTING & ACCESSIBILITY ANALYSES

  • Conduct usability testing to test hypotheses of iterative design work that will transform and enhance the Universal Parks user experience as well as to identify design problems, uncover opportunities for improvement and learn about the target users behavior and preferences.
  • Collect and analyze KPIs to make informed data-driven recommendations for UX/UI improvements. Use findings as a positive focal point for collaboration and product design evolution.
  • Write detailed study plans including goals, hypothesis, metrics, and study approach.
  • Apply the best methods to answer UX research questions.
  • Be accountable for ensuring quality of usability tests.
  • Consolidate test findings into a compelling insightful story to share with stakeholders.
  • Have a passion for refining design solutions based on evidence, UX research methodology and results, and accessibility principles, collaborating directly with consumer insights, analytics and research teams as well as product and technology teams.
  • This is a hands-on role, and the candidate will be expected to execute work and will be responsible for planning and conducting usability and accessibility tests, reviews, analysis, and documentation as part of the role.

LEADERSHIP AND COLLABORATION

  • Define and conduct qualitative research, including usability studies, interviews, and more to provide insights on requirements definition, content strategy, wireframes, visual and interaction design in partnership with the Global UXUI Experience Design Team, Product and Technology teams.
  • Be a vocal Champion and encourage team members to deliver accessible and innovative design solutions that improve engagement, conversion and build fan loyalty across our digital platforms.
  • Ensure consistent, cross-functional communication across marketing and experience teams to include IT, Business Operations, Marketing, Creative, Revenue Operations and Finance relative to key business decisions and customer engagement.
  • Achieve operational excellence and superior guest experience advancements by building and sustaining a high-performing UXUI product design team to achieve and exceed goals and objectives.
  • Coach team members in user research methodology and accessibility principlesparticularly those less-experienced in research disciplines.

CUSTOMER EXPERIENCE

  • Develop and conduct usability testing strategies and activities that support the UPR Global Experience Design vision and strategies across the consumer journey with a focus on identifying customer challenges to help improve the user experience.
  • Partner on development of end-to-end experiences and enhancements across all customer touch points and channels in partnership with a cross functional team.
  • Conduct usability tests and heuristic reviews, competitive research, and assess end-to-end business processes and practices to identify and implement enhancements that improve customer satisfaction in effort to deepen loyalty and trust with our guests.
  • Share insights and recommend solutions for key business decisions with and through the organization to enable alignment and collaboration as new products or enhancements roll out.
  • Ensure that the designed practices, annual product and consumer targets, and key performance indicators (KPIs) are met based on the experiences delivered. In addition, be responsible for profit and loss as well as operational profitability of the product as influenced by the consumers reception and experience.
  • Understands and actively participates in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UO policy, procedures, training and team member involvement activities.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

EDUCATION:

  • Bachelors degree is required.
  • Undergraduate degree in User Experience, Experience Design, Human Factors, Psychology, UX Research, Human Centered Interaction and/or Interaction Design is preferred.

EXPERIENCE:

  • 5+ years of experience with demonstrated leadership in user research and usability testing for digital experiences. IA, UX, or CD in a progressive technology enablement, innovation, or marketing organization
  • 2+ years experience as a Senior UX Researcher or Senior Designer developing digital interactive products or experiences.
  • Accessibility certification and experience preferred
  • Experience with immersive technologies, ecommerce sites in the travel and hospitality sector, rewards/engagement and loyalty programs are a plus.
  • Must present a portfolio of work that includes usability research case studies and demonstrate strong UX and interaction design excellence;
  • or equivalent combination of education and experience.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:

  • Experience in project team leadership and large-scale program planning and implementation as well as willing to be hands on when needed
  • Demonstrated success creating end-to-end digital product designs in the consumer technology sector
  • Proven experience working with product teams and UXUI designers in conducting user research (e.g., usability testing, heuristic analyses, competitive benchmarking, contextual interviews) on digital platforms
  • Proven track record in building highly effective interpersonal business relationships, working in a consultative capacity, and presenting to stakeholders of all levels in a highly matrixed organization.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills and the ability to articulate and visualize both qualitative and qualitative results
  • Demonstrable experience in a wide range of qualitative and quantitative methodologies, including heuristics, remote usability testing, contextual interviews, surveys, rapid iterative testing, ethnography, and other techniques
  • The ability to write detailed test plans and summarize data sets
  • Knowledge of reviewing and applying accessibility best practices to solutions.
  • Passionate advocate for the user who enjoys conducting usability testing, and champions accessibility principles.
  • Experience with agile methodology.
  • Understanding of key metrics for digital interactive products including, but not limited to monthly active users (MAU), daily active users (DAU), average revenue per paying user (ARPPU), average revenue per install (ARPI), conversion rates and how these metrics can and will impact the product strategy.
  • Ability to project manage and work effectively under deadlines and in complex business environments through collaboration and utilizing supporting and partner teams. A positive attitude, open mind, and desire to collaborate and learn.
  • Highly proficient in usability testing platforms such as UserZoom or UserTesting.com
  • Experience with Adobe Creative Suite, Sketch, InVision and Abstract.

Your talent, skills and experience will be rewarded with a competitive compensation package.

JOB SUMMARY:

As a member of the Universal Creative senior leadership team, the Senior Vice President, Global Project Hub is responsible for establishing the enterprise governance framework, project controls, standards, and operational processes that enable successful project execution across all Universal Creative portfolios.

The Senior Vice President provides strategic leadership for the Global Project Hub, leading a multidisciplinary team of subject matter experts responsible for enterprise estimating, planning and scheduling, project controls, financial governance, logistics, reporting, and delivery methodologies. The role establishes enterprise standards, provides executive advisory support, and drives consistency, accountability, and operational excellence across the global project portfolio.

Serving as the enterprise authority on project governance, this position partners with portfolio leadership to provide strategic oversight, financial insight, risk management, and best practices that improve project performance while ensuring projects remain aligned with Universal Creative's business objectives.

The Senior Vice President also serves as the primary business liaison to executive leadership across Universal Creative portfolios, supporting long-range portfolio planning, strategic communications, organizational alignment, capital planning, and budget development while cultivating executive relationships with internal stakeholders and joint venture partners to ensure successful delivery of enterprise objectives.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Global Project Hub Leadership
    • Provide strategic vision and leadership for the Global Project Hub, aligning enterprise project support functions with Universal Creative business objectives.
    • Lead multidisciplinary teams of subject matter experts responsible for estimating, planning and scheduling, project controls, logistics, architectural and engineering support, reporting, and enterprise project methodologies.
    • Establish enterprise standards that enable consistent execution, operational excellence, and scalable support across all global portfolios.
    • Develop organizational capabilities and leadership talent that strengthen enterprise project delivery and continuous improvement.
    • Serve as the primary business liaison with executive leadership across Universal Creative portfolios, ensuring strategic priorities remain aligned with enterprise objectives.
  • Enterprise Governance & Project Controls
    • Establish and govern enterprise-wide project management standards, methodologies, stage gates, approval processes, and project controls across all Universal Creative portfolios.
    • Develop and maintain standardized approaches for scheduling, estimating, forecasting, reporting, change management, cost controls, and risk management.
    • Drive consistency in project delivery methodologies while continuously improving governance frameworks, operational processes, and performance metrics.
    • Lead enterprise adoption of emerging technologies, digital tools, and industry best practices that enhance project execution and organizational effectiveness.
    • Establish governance frameworks and enterprise standards for the engagement, performance, and oversight of consultants, contractors, manufacturers, fabricators, vendors, and strategic partners, ensuring consistent expectations, accountability, quality, and delivery excellence across all portfolios.
    • Develop enterprise processes supporting procurement governance, correspondence, RFIs, directives, submittals, meeting documentation, project controls, and change management that enable predictable project execution across the organization.
  • Financial & Business Governance
    • Establish enterprise financial governance standards supporting capital project planning, estimating, forecasting, and budget development.
    • Provide executive oversight and strategic guidance regarding project financial health, cost trends, contingency utilization, forecasting accuracy, and budget realism.
    • Partner with Finance and portfolio leadership to improve capital planning, financial transparency, and executive decision-making.
    • Evaluate enterprise financial performance metrics and recommend improvements that optimize investment decisions and project outcomes.
    • Support development and communication of long-range planning strategies across Universal Creative portfolios while aligning financial priorities with enterprise objectives.
  • Executive Advisory & Portfolio Support
    • Serve as the executive advisor to portfolio leadership, providing strategic guidance regarding project controls, schedule recovery, estimating accuracy, financial performance, governance, enterprise risk, and organizational effectiveness.
    • Partner with executive leadership to identify organizational risks, remove barriers, and implement enterprise solutions that improve project delivery across all portfolios.
    • Build and maintain strategic relationships across Universal Creative, Universal Destinations & Experiences, portfolio leadership, and external partners to ensure cross-functional alignment and successful execution of enterprise initiatives.
    • Provide executive oversight for enterprise procurement strategies, vendor performance, sourcing approaches, and strategic partnerships that improve quality, consistency, and long-term organizational value.
    • Cultivate executive relationships with joint venture partners and external stakeholders to support collaboration, portfolio integration, and successful execution of strategic initiatives.
  • Operational Excellence & Continuous Improvement
    • Champion a culture of operational excellence through continuous improvement, enterprise performance measurement, benchmarking, and process optimization.
    • Develop and monitor enterprise KPIs that measure organizational effectiveness and project performance.
    • Identify opportunities to simplify processes, improve organizational efficiency, and strengthen executive decision-making across the Global Project Hub.
    • Lead organizational transformation initiatives that improve enterprise capability, governance maturity, and operational excellence.
  • Understand and actively participate in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UDX policy, procedures, training and team member involvement activities. 
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION: 

Global travel required.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic, and creative environment.
  • Ability to lead organizational transformation, enterprise governance, and strategic change across a global organization.
  • Ability to effectively present complex business, operational, financial, and strategic information to executive leadership, boards, and key stakeholders.
  • Strong executive decision-making, strategic thinking, and problem-solving skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop enterprise governance frameworks, project controls, financial governance, and organizational standards.
  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and executive relationship-building skills.
  • Comprehensive understanding of project delivery methodologies, capital planning, estimating, scheduling, forecasting, financial analysis, organizational performance, and enterprise risk management.
  • Ability to build executive partnerships across internal organizations, external partners, consultants, vendors, and joint venture stakeholders.
  • Proficiency in project management methodologies, enterprise systems, and executive reporting tools.
  • Passion for the themed entertainment industry and commitment to delivering exceptional guest experiences.
  • Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  • Consistent attendance is a job requirement.

EDUCATION:

  • Bachelor's degree in Architecture, Engineering, Construction, Finance or related discipline required.
  • Master's degree preferred.
  • Professional Architecture or Engineering license preferred.
  • Project Management Professional (PMP) certification preferred.

EXPERIENCE: 

15+ years of progressive executive leadership experience in project governance, project controls, capital project management, portfolio management, or large-scale development organizations, including responsibility for enterprise scheduling, estimating, financial oversight, governance frameworks, organizational leadership, strategic planning, and operational excellence. Global leadership experience strongly preferred.

Your talent, skills and experience will be rewarded with a competitive compensation package.

JOB SUMMARY:

Performs basic re-design and development efforts for mechanical / structural systems of theme park rides and attractions to provide increased reliability and operational improvements. Duties include support downtime recovery, troubleshooting, fault analysis, redesign assignments, test and start-up integration of Ride and Show systems. All work shall be in conformance with ASTM F24 Committee guidelines and compliant with applicable codes, regulations and standards including: AISC, ASME, ASTM, ANSI, AWS, JIC, NEC, and OSHA, among others.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Implements solutions and performs design modifications to Ride and Show system equipment on assigned projects to include mechanical / structural modifications to complex systems to improve safety, reliability, operational readiness, diagnostics and serviceability of mechanical / structural systems.
  • Manages assigned projects from design through installation to include project schedules, testing, training and budget demands.
  • Prepares scope of work documents for engineering projects. Develops and conducts Acceptance Test Procedures on control or mechanical systems modifications, generation of maintenance procedures and manual updates. Prepares and conducts maintenance training on mechanical / structural equipment.
  • Interfaces with ride supervisors and managers to resolve problems and design issues. Coordinates engineering activities between ride supervisors, ride managers and technicians.
  • Monitors and interfaces with vendors/ride manufacturers to resolve problems and design issues. Prepares and reviews equipment specifications and performs technical evaluation of vendor products/services.
  • Performs engineering calculations for design, analysis, test and implementation of mechanical / structural systems.
  • Provides project status of assigned task list items to senior level engineers, Engineering Manger and/or appropriate ride manager on a regular basis. Updates project status via Maximo on a regular basis.
  • Maintains configuration management of mechanical / structural documentation in accordance with Engineerings guidelines for proper archiving and security.
  • Understands and actively participates in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UO policy, procedures, training and team member involvement activities.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

SCOPE:

Responsible for performing basic re-design and development efforts of all Ride & Show systems to provide increased reliability and operational improvements. Responsible for providing sustaining (mechanical) engineering support for all Ride & Show systems parkwide both daily and on-call 24/7.

EDUCATION:

Bachelors degree (list discipline(s)): Bachelors degree from a four-year college or university in Engineering, Mechanical, Structural or Civil Engineering or related field required.

EXPERIENCE:

  • 3-5 years demonstrated project engineering experience of mechanical / structural systems in an engineering environment for the development of dynamic motion (mobile) systems in a theme park industry or 4-6 years experience of mechanical/structural design associated w/ dynamic motion (mobile) systems and components required
  • Or equivalent combination of education and experience

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:

Required

  • Strong analytical skills to perform engineering calculations for design, analysis, test and implementation of mechanical, structural, hydraulic and pneumatic system modifications.
  • Background in design of welded structures, beam elements, welded joints, structural steels, gearing, composite materials, manufacturing and fabrication processes as applies to AWS and AISC.
  • Proficiency in hydraulic and pneumatic design, and familiarity with components.
  • Strong knowledge and logical approach to problem solving and troubleshooting capabilities of mechanical and structural systems.
  • Proficiency in mechanical drawings and technical documents.
  • Experience with motion control, show, and animation systems.
  • Experience in the generation of component and mechanical system specifications, acceptance test procedures, failure and effects analysis, scopes of work, installation procedures, training procedure, technical and maintenance manuals.
  • Knowledge in servo controls as applied to hydraulic, pneumatic, and electromotive motion control systems is required.
  • Ability to perform engineering calculations commensurate with Baccalaureate training in electrical, mechanical and structural engineering.

Preferred

  • Knowledgeable in NEC, AWS, ASTM and F24 standards.
  • Experience in the design of safety critical systems.
  • Experience with Allen-Bradley PLC based control systems.
  • Experience with AC and DC motors and motor control systems.
  • Experience with cryogenic systems.

Your talent, skills and experience will be rewarded with a competitive compensation package.

JOB SUMMARY:

Responsible for executing advanced, discipline-specific tasks necessary to maintain and optimize the operation of Universal Orlando Facilities. This includes comprehensive diagnostics, repair, and maintenance of industrial, commercial, and non-commercial HVAC and refrigeration systems. Duties encompass troubleshooting complex mechanical and control issues, performing precision calibrations, conducting system performance assessments, and ensuring compliance with all relevant safety and operational standards.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Advanced HVAC/R System Services. Perform complex servicing on heating, air conditioning, ventilation, supply/exhaust/effect, pumps, solenoid valves/electronic expansion valves, piping, and associated controls and accessories site wide. Utilize PLC programming and electronic controls systems to assist with quick calls as well as the Building Management System (BMS) for troubleshooting, programming, and repairs. Integrate and optimize electronic controls to enhance the performance and efficiency of the HVAC systems.
  • Comprehensive Refrigeration System Management. Troubleshoot, maintain, repair, or replace all mechanical and electronic components in walk-in freezers, walk-in coolers, and rack systems that utilize PLC and advanced electronic efficiency controls (EEC). Implement and maintain PLC controlled refrigeration systems ensuring real-time monitoring, predictive maintenance, and efficient operation of all refrigeration systems. Perform upgrades and retrofits on existing refrigeration systems to integrate electronic controls, enhancing system reliability and reducing food waste due to downtime.
  • Interface and communicate with third party contractors/vendors involved in infrastructure repairs, upgrades, and replacements of HVAC/R equipment. Ensure that all contractor work involved meets industry standards and company expectations for quality and performance. Interface with the BMS systems to program, modify, and optimize set points and BAS schedules as requested by customers or management, ensuring precise control over environmental conditions.
  • Populate the Maximo system to ensure every piece of HVAC/R equipment asset is in Maximo and that every asset has a PM job plan and schedule to be PMd. Utilize the BMS to aid in full-functional PM testing. Assist the HVAC Planners by creating detailed technical documentation to support accurate parts procurement and efficient equipment maintenance.
  • Technical Leadership and Expertise. Provide mechanical, technical, and programming guidance to HVAC Tech IIs, Tech IIIs and HVAC apprentices. Continually improving the departments education, experience, and skill set in advanced HVAC/R technologies. Conduct training sessions focused on best practices for maintaining modern complex HVAC/R systems.
  • Understands and actively participates in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UO policy, procedures, training and team member involvement activities.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

EDUCATION:

  • Technical school is preferred
  • Associate degree (AA) is preferred.

EXPERIENCE:

  • 6+ years equivalent Commercial/Industrial HVAC/R systems including building automations systems, PLC systems, boilers, chilled water, DX equipment up to 40 tons, VAVs and Data center HVAC systems is required.
  • 1+ year in theme park industry preferred.

CERTIFICATIONS, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS:

  • A valid Florida Drivers License is mandatory for the operation of company vehicles.
  • An EPA Universal Refrigerant Certification is required for handling refrigerants.
  • Additionally, a Journeyman, Contractor, or Masters licenses with a minimum of 8,000 hours of relevant job experience that is issued by a Municipality, City, County, State, for the MEP trades is required.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:

  • Execute advanced tasks in the troubleshooting, repair, maintenance, and installation of refrigeration, heating, air conditioning, ventilation systems, and associated controls. This includes organizing and performing complex service operations, repairs, and overhauls of light commercial and industrial HVACR systems.
  • Responsibilities also involve interpreting and understanding intricate electrical schematics, BMS control functions, and electrical distribution networks.
  • Identify root causes of system issues and determine appropriate repair solutions.
  • Analyze system performance data to assess the need for increased maintenance intervals or enhancements to equipment efficiency.
  • Additionally, support Utilities management by overseeing and documenting contractor activities to ensure compliance with specifications and standards.

Your talent, skills and experience will be rewarded with a competitive compensation package.

Responsible for the highest level of skilled discipline-specific tasks required to ensure the smooth operation of Universal Orlando Utilities as it pertains to all Industrial, Commercial and Non-Commercial HVAC/Refrigeration equipment, and Ride Vehicle (RV) HVAC equipment in Ride buildings, and the oversight of the UO chill water infrastructure.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Responsible for the systematic approach, guidance, and expertise regarding servicing heating, air conditioning, ventilation, supply/exhaust fans, pumps, valves, piping, associated controls, and accessories site wide, with an emphasis on Ride buildings, to improve operational reliability, safety, serviceability, and system efficiencies.
  • Responsible for the systematic approach, guidance and expertise regarding servicing all mechanical and electrical components associated with walk in freezers, coolers, rack systems, accessories and controls site wide to improve operational reliability, safety, serviceability, and system efficiencies.
  • Responsible for providing mechanical and technical guidance to HVAC Tech I, Tech II, Tech III technicians and apprentices to continually develop the education, experience and skill set within the department.
  • Responsible for the oversight of third party contractors and/or vendors task with infrastructure repairs, renovations, or replacement of HVAC/Refrigeration equipment, underground mechanical utilities as directed. Will be responsible for the verification of all City of Orlando permitted work completed in house or by a third party vendor.
  • Responsible for completion of preventative maintenance on HVAC/Refrigeration systems as required site wide.
  • Coordinate with the BMS department to modify set points or change BAS schedules as required to gain efficiencies and/or satisfy customers and managements expectations. Assist BMS department with emergency troubleshooting and repair as needed site wide.

  • Performs other duties as assigned.

Perform the highest level of advanced tasks in the troubleshooting, repair, maintenance and installation of refrigeration, heating, air conditioning and ventilation, and related systems and controls, including: Organizing and performing advanced service, repairs, troubleshooting and overhaul of light commercial and industrial heating, air conditioning ventilation and refrigeration; Understanding complex electrical schematics, BMS control functions/strategies and electrical distribution systems; Troubleshooting root causes and determine proper repairs; Analyzing system data to determine the need for increased maintenance frequencies or improved performance of the equipment; and assisting Utilities management with the supervision and documentation of any contractor activity.

Job.JobDescription:
Description

Join a hands-on, milestone-driven Claims Apprenticeship designed to prepare you for a career in casualty claims. Over 612 months,youllcomplete a flexible, goal-based program combining classroom training, on-the-job assignments, one-on-one mentoring, and real claim work. Successful completion prepares you to move into a ClaimsResolutionSpecialist role or other claims opportunities.

Program highlights

  • Duration: 612 months (flexible, hybrid,based on milestone completion)
  • Schedule: Part-time or full-time options; progress is milestone-based so participants can advance as theydemonstratecompetency
  • Training: Comprehensive classroom and practical training,jobshadowingandone-on-one mentoring
  • Compensation:Competitive paid apprenticeship and eligibility forcompany benefits as applicable
  • Career path: Clear progression to Claims Specialist roles and support for licensing and development

Whatyoulldo (Key responsibilities)

  • Manage, investigate, and resolve assigned claims within established authority levels.Including but not limited to Auto Accidents
  • Gather information from policyholders, claimants, witnesses, and third parties (appraisers, medical providers, repair shops) to evaluate coverage, liability, and damages
  • Review medical records, police reports, and other documentation to assess claim severity and determineappropriate reserves
  • Negotiate settlements with claimants and attorneys; arrange expert inspections and coordinate ancillary resources as needed
  • Identifysuspicious claims and refer to Special Investigations Unit (SIU);identifythird partysubrogation opportunities
  • Maintainaccurateandtimelyclaim files, status reports, and documentation in claims systems
  • Sends and responds to various written, telephone and SMS text inquiries to pursue resolution of the claim.

Training & support

  • LicensingTraining(state adjuster licensing requirementassistancewhere applicable)
  • Structured curriculum combining technical skills (coverage analysis, state tort basics, reserving,evaluation,negotiation) and soft skills (communication, empathy, customer service)
  • One-on-onementoring from experienced claims professionals and regular milestone assessmentswith trainer and coach support
  • Hands-on scenario-based exercisesinand exposure to leadership and cross-functional teams
  • Continuous learning journeyprovidedfor enhancingCasualtyskills

What we offer

  • Paid apprenticeship with competitive compensation
  • Mentorship, career development, and individualized mobility plans
  • Support for licensing and tuition reimbursement for approved educational needs
  • Access to health and wellness benefits (as applicable),andpaid leave
  • Opportunity to convert to a full-time ClaimsResolutionSpecialist or other roles upon successful completion

How the milestone-based progression works

  • Youlladvance by completing a sequence of competency milestones (knowledge assessments,demonstratedtask performance, quality reviews) rather than strict calendar time
  • Typical milestones include coverage & liability evaluations, reserves setting, independent file management, negotiation simulations, and compliance/ethics checkpoints
  • The program is flexible: apprentices whodemonstratecompetency early can complete the program in ~6 months; others may take up to 12 months to meet all milestones

How to apply:Submityour resume and a brief cover letter describing your interest in claims and your availability. Candidates who meet the basic criteria will be invited to complete a virtual interview and skills assessment.

Equal opportunity statement:We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace and encourage applicants of all backgrounds to apply. Reasonableaccommodations areavailable upon request during the selection process.

Pursue a meaningful career helping people recover after loss apply for the Claims Apprenticeship today.

Qualifications

Whatwerelooking for

  • High school diploma or GEDrequired(no bachelors degreerequired)
  • 02 years of professional experience; customer service, legal, medical, or investigative experience a plus
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to present information clearly, concisely, and professionally withappropriate empathy
  • Solid analytical, investigative, negotiation, and time-management skills
  • Detail-oriented and able to thrive in a fast-paced, customer-focused environment
  • Demonstrates change resiliency and a growth mindset by adapting quickly to shifting claim priorities, seeking feedback, and proactively pursuing learning opportunities to improve processes and outcomes.
  • Permanent authorization to work in the United States and ability to obtain required state licensing where applicable
  • Comfortableusing standard office software and learning claims management systems

Industrial Electrician Responsibilities:

  • Install, maintain, troubleshoot, and repair electrical systems associated with water and wastewater treatment facilities, including pumps, motors, MCCs, control panels, instrumentation, SCADA systems, underground conduit, and duct bank systems.
  • Install and terminate conduit, wiring, feeders, and electrical equipment for treatment processes, lift stations, and facility infrastructure.
  • Diagnose electrical and control system issues using testing equipment and hand tools to safely restore system operation.
  • Inspect electrical systems and equipment for hazards, defects, and code compliance.
  • Perform testing of electrical systems, controls, instrumentation, and power distribution equipment to ensure safe and reliable operation.
  • Coordinate with supervisors, operators, engineers, and other trades to support plant operations and project activities.
  • Follow all company safety procedures, lockout/tagout requirements, and site-specific safety standards.

  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Requirements – Water & Wastewater Treatment Electrician:

  • Minimum of 3 years of electrical experience preferred, with experience in water or wastewater treatment facilities strongly preferred.
  • Working knowledge of electrical systems including motors, pumps, MCCs, VFDs, control panels, instrumentation, and SCADA systems.
  • Experience installing and maintaining conduit systems, underground conduit, duct banks, feeders, and power distribution equipment.
  • Ability to read and interpret blueprints, one-line diagrams, control schematics, and electrical specifications.
  • Proficient in troubleshooting electrical and control systems using standard testing equipment and hand tools.
  • Knowledge of NEC requirements, electrical safety standards, and lockout/tagout procedures.
  • Ability to work safely in active industrial, water treatment, and wastewater treatment environments.
  • Capable of lifting materials, working outdoors in varying weather conditions, climbing ladders, and working in confined spaces when required.
  • Strong communication, teamwork, and problem-solving skills.

  • Valid driver's license and reliable transportation required.

  • Class A CDL *Preferred*.

Physical Demands

Must be able to perform multiple tasks and can handle the physical demands of the job, including but not limited to, digging using a shovel, standing, walking, kneeling, bending, crouching, pulling, pushing, climbing, and lifting at least 50lbs.

Position Summary

Data Privacy Manager

As a Manager in Deloitte's Digital Trust & Privacy practice, you will lead the discovery, design, and implementation of privacy technology solutions that help organizations address regulatory requirements, strengthen data governance, and enable trusted business outcomes. You will contribute configuration, integration, testing, and deployment activities while working with client, vendor, and cross-functional teams. This role offers the opportunity to take on increased ownership in privacy-by-design initiatives, Consent & Preference Management, and AI governance efforts, and large-scale technology implementations.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/31/2026.

Work you'll do

Design:

  • Strategize with clients to identify privacy technology gaps that can be addressed with technology to enable future state privacy goals.
  • Lead working sessions with client stakeholders to gather technical, functional, and business requirements and establish use cases to inform future state architecture.

Architect:

  • Navigate complex IT architectures to incorporate privacy technology solutions.
  • General awareness of global and domestic privacy regulations and concepts, and how they relate to the deployment of technology in line with applicable laws and regulations.
  • General knowledge of integrating technologies with third-party tools and APIs.

Implement:

  • Configure, integrate, test, and deploy privacy tools and technologies to help clients automate their privacy capabilities and enhance customer experiences.
  • Familiar with change management, test plan design and backout plans.
  • Coordinate with client stakeholders and technology vendor representatives to clarify queries, troubleshoot implementation issues, and test end-to-end deployment and system integrations.

Manage:

  • Manage and execute project activities across the IT Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) including leading regular check-ins with team members and vendors
  • Lead a cross-functional group of client stakeholders to meet their unique needs in a fast-paced environment.
  • Work alongside practice leaders and experienced privacy technology professionals gaining industry-leading insights into data privacy.
  • Develop and maintain technical configuration documentation.
  • Manage and provide technical oversight to solution deployment and rollout.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or similar Engineering disciplines
  • 7+ years of experience in software design, architecture development, and technology implementation
  • 4+ years of experience with Data Privacy principles such as Privacy Impact Assessment, Data Inventory, Privacy Breach Management, Data Subject Rights, Notice & Policy Management, Consent & Preference Management, Cookie Management, etc.
  • Ability to travel 25-75%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve
  • Experience leading collaborative efforts across organizational silos, including multifunctional teams of IT professionals, legal/compliance teams, and business executives
  • Familiarity with change management, deployment and operational processes in large IT organizations
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available

Preferred Qualifications:

Technical skills

  • Understand marketing technologies, including customer data platforms, consent, cookies, tag management solutions
  • Ability to understand, develop and enhance existing client architectures and solution designs to meet data privacy requirements
  • Prior experience in performing SaaS implementations for complex organizations and IT ecosystems.
  • Ability to comprehend and execute basic technology concepts such as Application Programming Interfaces (API's), system requests methods (GET/POST), etc.
  • Demonstrated experience in performing integrations with Marketing Platforms (e.g., Sales Force Marketing Cloud), Master Data Management (e.g., Informatica MDM), Customer Relationship Management (CRM), and middleware (MuleSoft, Kafka)
  • 4+ years of experience implementing privacy solutions such as OneTrust, BigID, Securiti.ai
  • Hands-on experience and knowledge of software engineering concepts/technologies, such as:
    • JavaScript, RESTful APIs, HTTP Requests, JDBC, HTML CSS
    • SQL, NoSQL, database management concepts
    • API management tools such as Apigee, Postman
    • Agile/Scrum methodology to build and rollout complex software solutions
  • Understanding of privacy program requirements and capabilities such as data inventory, data subject rights, consent and preference management, privacy by design, privacy impact assessments, incident response, third-party risk, etc.
  • Knowledge of Data Privacy Laws and Regulations: Familiarity with data privacy legislation such as GDPR, CCPA, LGPD, and other regional or industry-specific privacy regulations.
  • Communication Skills: Strong written and verbal communication skills to effectively articulate complex privacy concepts to business-facing audiences, such as clients and other team members.
  • Project Management Experience: Experience in managing projects, including planning, risk management, resource management, and meeting project timelines.
  • Teamwork and Collaboration: Proven experience in working effectively with diverse teams.
  • Change Management: Understanding of change management principles and approaches, to enable successful implementation and adoption of privacy solutions.
  • Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or similar Engineering disciplines
  • Certifications in one or more of the following: CIPT, CIPM, CISSP, CPDSE, CIPT, Agile/Scrum Master
  • Experience with application development and testing using one or more programming or scripting languages (e.g., .Net, C#, Python)
  • Understanding of Ad-Tech / Mar-Tech ecosystem, frameworks, tools, and solutions

Job.CustomJobTypeName: UX / UI Designer, Creative / Design / Architecture
Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

Our Deloitte Customer team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, Generative AI, transformative technologies, and creative design. We can enhance customer experiences and drive sustained growth and customer value creation and capture, through customer and commercial strategies, digital products and innovation, marketing, commerce, sales, and service. We are a team of strategists, data scientists, operators, creatives, designers, engineers, and architects. Our team balances business strategy, technology, creativity, and ongoing managed services to solve the biggest problems that affect customers, partners, constituents, and the workforce.

Work you'll do

As a Delivery Analyst, Creative Content Solutions on the Customer Strategy & Design team, you will be responsible for…

  • Creating visual design deliverables, including mockups, wireframes, and prototypes, aligned to client brand standards, project goals, and user needs
  • Collaborating with design leads and cross-functional teams to develop, present, and refine design concepts across design, user experience, and development workflows
  • Supporting initiatives across the product lifecycle, including minimum viable product launches, feature releases, and maintenance updates for established digital products
  • Using artificial intelligence tools to accelerate research synthesis, ideation, content development, and design iteration
  • Working in a hybrid delivery model with up to 30% co-location at assigned locations and up to 10% overnight travel for client or project needs

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The Team

Deloitte's Government & Public Services (GPS) practice – our people, ideas, technology and outcomes – is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our Customer Strategy & Design team discovers, designs, and prototypes customer growth strategies and innovation portfolios.

This opportunity sits within our Center talent model, which is dedicated to driving impactful business services. It leverages Deloitte's scale and talent, as well as a center delivery model to provide high-quality, cost-effective service with standardized processes and procedures to service businesses across Deloitte.

The Deloitte Center has a small-business feel with a big-business impact. With the resources of Deloitte and a community feel, the center model provides high-quality services to our clients. Center professionals work out of one of our specific delivery center locations, and each location presents dynamic career opportunities for professionals to focus on their work with nominal travel requirements.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree
  • 1+ years of experience creating visual designs for web or mobile applications, including mockups, wireframes, or prototypes
  • 1+ years of experience using Figma and at least one digital design or prototyping tool such as Adobe XD, Sketch, or InVision
  • 1+ years of experience using design systems for enterprise digital experiences
  • 1+ years of experience applying user-centered design principles to web or mobile product design
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.
  • Must be able to obtain and maintain Public Trust security clearance
  • Delivery Center Location & Travel Requirements:
    • Hybrid Work Model: Operate under a hybrid system requiring residence within a commutable distance to one of the US Delivery Center locations (Gilbert, Lake Mary, or Mechanicsburg)
    • Co-location Expectation: Spend up to 30% of working time co-located at an assigned office for orchestrated opportunities, including projects, practice sessions, training, and Moments That Matter at a Deloitte Delivery Center location, Geo-Hub location, approved site, or project location
    • Travel Requirement: Maximum of 10% overnight travel for client or project purposes
    • Relocation Requirement: If relocation is necessary, complete the move within 12 weeks from the start date to reside within a commutable distance

Preferred:

  • Experience supporting federal, state, local government, or public higher education clients
  • Experience working on minimum viable products, feature releases, or maintenance releases
  • Experience collaborating with developers, business analysts, and project managers across the product lifecycle
  • Experience using artificial intelligence tools to accelerate design workflows
  • Experience with iOS and Android mobile application design, including Material Design and Human Interface Guidelines
  • Experience using motion design tools such as Adobe After Effects, Principle, or Framer

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $53,300 to $105,000.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

Deloitte is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for people with disabilities. If you require a reasonable accommodation to participate in the recruiting process, please direct your inquiries to the Global Call Center (GCC) at USTalentCICInbox@deloitte.com.

Recruiting tips

From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

Benefits

At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. We value our people and offer employees a broad range of benefits. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.

Our people and culture

Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas, and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients' most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.

Our purpose

Deloitte's purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities. Learn more.

Professional development

From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe there's always room to learn. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership opportunities and connect and grow through mentorship. From on-the-job learning experiences to formal development programs, our professionals have a variety of opportunities to continue to grow throughout their career.

As used in this posting, "Deloitte" means Deloitte Consulting LLP, a subsidiary of Deloitte LLP. Please see https://www.deloitte.com/us/about for a detailed description of the legal structure of Deloitte LLP and its subsidiaries.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability or protected veteran status, or any other legally protected basis, in accordance with applicable law.
