Job.JobDescription:
National General is a part of The Allstate Corporation, which means we have the same innovative drive that keeps us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. We offer home, auto and accident and health insurance, as well as other specialty niche insurance products, through a large network of independent insurance agents, as well as directly to consumers.

Job Description

The Direct Sales Agent Specialist is responsible for driving profitable growth by generating new business, cross-selling existing customers, and building lasting relationships. This role focuses on understanding customer needs, delivering tailored solutions, and maintaining a strong book of business.

This role sells to local customers both in person and over the phone, while driving growth through community involvement, relationship building, and outside marketing efforts.

If you are ready to start working in a fun & exciting environment while making adifference, then apply to join our team today!

As a Direct Sales Agent Specialist, you will:

  • Achieve sales goals through new business, cross-sell, and retention
  • Build and maintain a consistent pipeline, including local lead generation and referrals
  • Develop relationships within the community (e.g., dealerships, events, local partners) to support business growth
  • Conduct outbound prospecting and follow-ups to convert opportunities into sales
  • Partner with leadership to support sales and local marketing initiatives
  • Stay informed on products, underwriting guidelines, and market competition
  • Deliver results aligned with performance standards, compliance requirements, and customer experience expectations

  • Ability to sell a multitude of industry-leading products through retail stores andphone
  • Entrepreneurial, performance-based, and results-focused culture

Job.JobTitle: Senior Manager, Global UXUI Experience Design - Hotels (2 year project hire)
Job.JobDescription:
JOB SUMMARY:

The Sr. Manager, UXUI role will be a core member of the Global UXUI Experience Design team at Universal Parks and Resorts and lead brand solutions centered on UXUI and system design from inception to execution, framing product needs from a holistic and global perspective.

This candidate will work with a cross functional team focused on identifying opportunities to enhance customer engagement by executing an elegant and seamless experience as well as maintain high quality experience design frameworks for our products (websites, apps, interactive touch screens) to ensure we present a coherent brand image.

This person is a key member in creating opportunities for audience engagement, revenue growth through design executions, measuring demand and loyalty marketing across the customer buying process.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Lead the holistic view of the products design across integration (customer and technical) points to provide a superior, seamless experience from daily improvements to longer-term strategies.
  • Lead brand solutions centered on UXUI and system design from inception to execution, framing product needs from a holistic and global perspective.
  • Communicate with business and design leaders and act as point of contact for specific commerce related design initiatives.
  • Synthesize product design and consumer trends, propose hypothesis, test via A/B testing tools, document and recommend clear, specific solutions to meet consumer needs.
  • Understand and actively participate in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UO policy, procedures, training and team member involvement activities.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Demonstrated success creating end-to-end digital product designs in the consumer technology sector.
  • Should have exceptional brand, visual, and interaction design skills and a depth of experience working across the user-centered design process: from conducting and leveraging research (quantitative and qualitative) to prototyping and implementation to testing and evaluation.
  • Strong UI design background and foundational skills: Typography, layout, composition, color theory, iconography, UXUI, motion/interaction design and branding.
  • Experience creating and documenting UI toolkits, style guides, and front-end frameworks for design and development teams.
  • Experience leading cross-functional reward, loyalty, and customer community projects intended to drive engagement and business value.
  • Requires strong domain knowledge in marketing, loyalty, rewards, messaging, and engagement.
  • Experience in building cross-channel experiences in growth marketing.
  • Experience utilizing user-centric design methodology: Gathering/shaping requirements, defining user stories, storyboarding features and iterating based on user feedback/testing.
  • Knowledge of current challenges in the marketing environment such as attribution of marketing touch points, understanding customer lifetime value, and the use of data science led personalization.
  • A desire to tackle and solve problems, from big picture strategy to granular details.
  • Independent, self-motivated, thoughtful, strategic and a clear communicator.
  • Passionately advocate for the user.
  • Experience leading projects with cross functional teams.
  • Comfortable with agile transformation.
  • Some experience in workshop and training facilitation preferred.
  • A positive attitude, open mind, and desire to collaborate and learn.
  • Highly proficient in Adobe Creative Suite, Sketch, InVision, and Abstract.

SCOPE:

  • The Sr. Manager, UXUI role will be a core member of the Global UXUI Experience Design team at Universal Parks and Resorts. We are responsible for Global UXUI; design concept, development and delivery of digital product across web, app and other digital applications for all Universal vacation destinations worldwide.

EDUCATION:

  • High school degree is required; Bachelors degree or higher is required Graphic Design, Human Centered Interaction and/or Interaction Design

EXPERIENCE:

  • Minimum of 5-7 years of relevant experience in ecommerce sites, rewards/engagement and loyalty programs working with data-driven product development teams.
  • Must present a portfolio of work that illustrates strong UXUI, visual design and interaction design excellence, brand creation; or equivalent combination of education and experience.


Your talent, skills and experience will be rewarded with a competitive compensation package.

Job.JobTitle: Senior Manager, IT Enterprise Data & BI
Job.JobDescription:
JOB SUMMARY:

The Senior Manager, Enterprise Data & BI will provide vision and leadership for the design, engineering, operations, and maintenance for a comprehensive strategy and roadmap for enterprise data supporting Universal Destination & Experiences (UDX) globally. This role will be leading enterprise data projects, working closely and aligning with partner teams, including Digital & Technology, NBCUniversal Operations & Technology, and business stakeholders globally to ensure all enterprise data requirements are understood and supported effectively and efficiently. Promotes collaboration by partnering with other leaders within and across division to share strategies and best practices to promote collaboration and improve efficiency.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Provide leadership responsibilities for a team of salaried technical individual contributors and contractors. Responsible for the planning, development, implementation, support, maintenance and enhancements of data management systems.
  • Work closely with Data Architects, Data Engineers, and Data Testers to ensure data solutions are aligned with business objectives
  • Coordinates with the business users during project implementations and continue to serve as a point of contact for future data questions and issues
  • Facilitates and leads meetings with end users at all levels (VP, Director, Managers, and Subject Matter Experts). Keeps management and business stakeholders informed of critical issues, project status, changes, etc.
  • Define and establish and evolve best practices in data engineering, data analytics, and support
  • Understands and actively participates in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UO policy, procedures, training and team member involvement activities.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

EDUCATION:

Bachelors degree in data science, Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, or related field.

EXPERIENCE:

  • 9+ years prior leadership experience managing teams of 4 or more resources
  • Deep Experience working with data structures, modeling, and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure).
  • Deep Experience with data profiling, mapping, cleansing, and quality assurance.
  • Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) and data cataloging tools (e.g. Collibra)
  • Experience with one or more databases such as Teradata, SQL Server, Oracle etc.
  • Experience with one or more ETL/Data Quality tools such as IBMs Data Stage/Quality Stage, Informatica Power Center etc.
  • Experience with one or more reporting/ad-hoc analysis tools such as MicroStrategy, Cognos, Business Objects, Tableau etc.
  • Experience with one or more data modeling tools such as Erwin, Embarcadaro etc.
  • Broad experience with data requirements, data modeling concepts, data integration, master data management, metadata management, enterprise data warehousing (EDW) and business intelligence/analytics, tools, protocols and practices.
  • Demonstrated ability to produce high quality documentation and presentations.
  • Strong knowledge of systems development and project management methodologies/processes.
  • Able to understand and interpret logical and physical data models.
  • Familiarity with customer identification and address standardization processes and tools such as Unica etc. a plus.
  • Familiarity with one or more statistical modeling tools by SPSS or SAS etc.
  • Familiarity with Big Data concepts, tools, utilities, protocols, and practices
  • Familiarity with Cloud Computing architectures, protocols, and practices
  • Demonstrated ability of strong customer relationship skills.

Your talent, skills and experience will be rewarded with a competitive compensation package.

The Designer, UXUI role will be a core member of the Global UXUI Experience Design team at Universal Destinations & Experiences, working with a cross functional team focused on identifying opportunities to enhance customer engagement by executing an elegant and seamless experience. Key member in creating opportunities for revenue growth through design executions, measuring demand and loyalty marketing across the customer buying process. Executes, participates or leads the entire process from inception to execution while working collaboratively with a cross functional team.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Support the holistic view of the product across integration (customer and technical) points to provide a superior, seamless experience from daily improvements to longer-term strategies. Strong domain knowledge in marketing, analysis, personalization and/or engagement across digital channels.
  • Synthesize product design and consumer trends and recommend clear, specific solutions to meet consumer needs. Execute and provide design artifacts that support UXUI best practices across integration (customer and technical) points to provide a superior, seamless experience from daily improvements to longer-term strategies.
  • Work closely with business, design and IT leaders as a point of contact for specific design initiatives.
  • Lead content design functions, collaborating with partners across the company to understand the needs of our teams and establishing end-to-end workflows designed to best serve those needs.
  • Understand and actively participate in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UO policy, procedures, training and team member involvement activities.

The Designer, UXUI role will be a core member of the Global UXUI Experience Design team at Universal Destinations & Experiences. We are responsible for global UXUI; design concept, development and delivery of digital web, app and other off channel products for all Universal vacation destinations worldwide.

EDUCATION:

  • High school degree is required; Bachelors degree is required Graphic Design, Human Centered Interaction and/or Interaction Design.

EXPERIENCE:

  • Minimum of 3-5 years of relevant experience in ecommerce sites, rewards/engagement and loyalty programs working with data-driven product development teams.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:

  • Demonstrated success creating end-to-end digital product designs in the consumer technology sector.

  • Strong foundational design skills: Typography, layout, composition, color theory, iconography, UXUI, motion/interaction design and branding.
  • Experience creating and documenting UI toolkits, style guides, and front-end frameworks for design and development teams.

  • Possess a strong technical acumen for translating design artifacts into code based solutions across many types of front end technologies.
  • Knowledge of front-end development and code across digital channels, including Websites, mobile apps and email templates.
  • Experience in building cross-channel experiences in growth marketing.
  • Experience utilizing user-centric design methodology: Gathering/shaping requirements, defining user stories, storyboarding features and iterating based on user feedback/testing.
  • Knowledge of current challenges in the marketing environment such as attribution of marketing touch points, understanding customer lifetime value, and the use of data science led personalization.
  • A desire to tackle and solve problems, from big picture strategy to granular details.

  • Mapping content to CMS page templates, email templates and components in collaboration with technology.
  • Knowledge of reviewing and applying accessibility best practices to solutions.
  • Passionately advocate for the user.
  • Comfortable with agile transformation.

JOB SUMMARY:

Responsible for providing day-to-day Environmental, Health & Safety (EHS) support to construction and capital project teams through implementation of the UO Contractor Safety Program, EHS standards, and associated processes. Serves as a technical resource to Project Teams, contractors, vendors, and internal stakeholders throughout project development, design, construction, and closeout phases. Supports contractor prequalification, construction safety oversight, design review, inspections, incident response, risk assessments, and regulatory compliance activities. Collaborates with EHS peer teams and Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to identify hazards, evaluate risks, implement controls, and support safe project execution while fostering a positive safety culture and alignment with organizational objectives.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

Pre-Construction Phase:

  • Review concept packages and support development of construction documents with Project Teams and Facility Management.
  • Coordinate and support the EHS contractor prequalification process and evaluate contractor performance against established EHS protocols.
  • Participate in pre-construction meetings and communicate UO EHS Contractor Safety expectations to contractors and Project Teams.
  • Conduct contractor safety orientations in alignment with established programs. Evaluate EHS logistics with general contractors, vendors, and Project Teams regarding site access, insurance, contractor safety requirements, and project-specific EHS expectations.

Design Phase:

  • Support Project Managers and Facility Management in reviewing design phase submittals impacting EHS programs and operational safety.
  • Review project design documents for corporate standards and regulatory compliance. Coordinate input from EHS subject matter experts and communicate recommendations to project stakeholders.
  • Evaluate existing facility conditions and operational impacts to identify potential EHS concerns requiring consideration during design.
  • Participate in design review and progress meetings to support safe and compliant project outcomes.

Demolition/Construction Phase:

  • Support implementation of the UO EHS Contractor Safety Program through active participation in project meetings, field observations, audits, and site inspections.
  • Monitor contractor conformance with regulatory requirements, corporate standards, and project-specific EHS requirements.
  • Document inspections, observations, corrective actions, and compliance activities in designated systems. Collaborate with contractors, vendors, Project Teams, and EHS business lines to facilitate communication regarding project schedules, change management activities, high-risk work, and construction safety requirements. Develop and track punch list items related to EHS compliance concerns.
  • Assist with incident investigations, concern reports, corrective actions, and emergent EHS issues.
  • Provide proactive technical guidance and support to Project Teams and contractors throughout project execution. Stop working immediately when imminent hazards are identified.

Project Closeout Phase:

  • Support completion of EHS punch lists and facility closeout activities. Participate in project post-mortem reviews and lessons learned discussions.
  • Assist in preparing documentation required for EHS project sign-off and turnover activities.
  • Verify completion of corrective actions and project EHS requirements prior to project closure.
  • Understands and actively participates in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UO policy, procedures, training and team member involvement activities.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Job requires active coordination with multiple departments/clients across property.Work is complex with both known and changing contexts and within broad but established standards.
  • Liaise with other EHS functional area experts related to environment, industrial hygiene, construction, fire, standards and assurance, training and safety operations
  • Experience conducting inspections, audits, plan reviews, incident investigations, contractor oversight, and risk assessments.
  • Experience supporting implementation of contractor safety programs and construction-related EHS standards.
  • Direct oversight of EHS management system elements, corrective action programs, performance measurement, compliance verification, and cross-functional coordination.
  • Experience interacting with contractors, project managers, Facility Management, and operational stakeholders.
  • Must be an initiative-taker with basic working knowledge of applicable health and safety regulations, possess basic business acumen and effective communication skills, ability to identify, analyze, and appropriately communicate and act on information in a range of workplace conditions and unpredictable situations.
  • Ability to influence and work on a team by applying communication, collaboration, engagement and listening skills to promote and support change.
  • Possess and utilize mentoring skills to develop capability of management team members related to EHS matters.
  • Basic ability to develop plans, identify trends, and create short term strategies to mitigate risk.
  • Strong computer skills, ability to prepare and deliver presentations, ability to work varied hours and days with most of the time being in the field.
  • Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  • Consistent attendance is a job requirement.

EDUCATION:

  • Bachelors degree in Safety, Occupational Health, Environmental Science, Construction Management, Engineering, Industrial Hygiene, Public Health, or a related discipline preferred.

EXPERIENCE:

  • 3+ years of EHS experience supporting construction, capital projects, contractor management, or related operational environments.

Your talent, skills and experience will be rewarded with a competitive compensation package.

Our Deloitte AI & Engineering team works to transform technology platforms, drive innovation, and help make a significant impact on our clients' success. You'll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and reengineering operations and processes that are critical to businesses. Your contributions can help clients improve financial performance, accelerate new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation.

Work you'll do

Requisition code: 372194

Job ID372194

Position Summary

AI & Engineering leverages cutting-edge engineering capabilities to help build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These insights are powered by engineering for business advantage, helping transform mission-critical operations.

As a Delivery Manager at Deloitte Consulting, you will oversee the technical delivery of an enterprise Azure managed services engagement for a US financial services client, lead cross-functional and global teams and mentor junior members. You will own the day-to-day service relationship, drive SLA and compliance performance, and support estimation, planning and change orders to ensure successful outcomes.

Work you'll do

We are looking for a Delivery Manager to own the delivery of a three-year Azure managed services engagement. You will be the accountable point of contact for the client, leading the teams that Migrate, transition, operate and secure a mix of Azure workloads, including compute and operating systems, containers, serverless services, backup and disaster recovery, patching, vulnerability and security monitoring, and cost optimization

As a Delivery Manager, you will be the onshore Service Delivery Manager for a multi-year Azure managed services contract covering a mix of IaaS (several hundred virtual machines across production, non-production and disaster recovery) and PaaS/serverless services. You will lead Level 2 and Level 3 operations teams across onshore and offshore Delivery centres, run service governance with the client, and ensure the Migrate, Transition and Operate phases are delivered against contractual SLAs, security standards and cost commitments.

Service Delivery & Contract Governance

  • Own end-to-end delivery across Plan & Define, Transition, and Operate (including the 90-day stabilization period), and maintain the Service Delivery Plan (SDP) as a living document.
  • Deliver against contractual SLAs — incident response/resolution, VM availability, and DR RTO/RPO — reporting monthly and running governance forums (service reviews, optimization reviews, steering committee).
  • Control scope and commercials: flag out-of-scope requests, raise change orders, and act as the escalation point for Priority 1 incidents.

Azure IaaS & PaaS Operations Oversight

  • Oversee Level 2/3 support for Azure IaaS (VMs, networking, storage, firewalls/WAF, load balancing) and PaaS/serverless services, including the shared-responsibility boundary with Microsoft.
  • Ensure golden, CIS-hardened images and IaC templates are maintained and used for all deployments, and oversee CI/CD, key/secrets management, and tagging standards.
  • Coordinate with Microsoft support and the client on CSP-side incidents and platform maintenance.

Incident, Problem & Change Management

  • Run ITIL-aligned incident, problem, and change management through ServiceNow — including the bidirectional eBonding integration — ensuring SLA-compliant prioritization (P1–P4) and root cause analysis for every P1.
  • Govern change requests (standard/normal/emergency) including CAB approvals, and maintain clear hand-offs across client Level 0/1, Deloitte Level 2/3, and third parties.

Security, Compliance & Risk

  • Ensure operational security controls are effective — IAM (SSO/MFA/PAM), credential rotation, and annual access reviews.
  • Oversee vulnerability management (daily scanning, risk prioritization, monthly reporting), SIEM/log monitoring, and security incident response.
  • Oversee cloud security posture management and compliance against NIST/CIS/CSA baselines, and support client audits and control requests.

Backup, Disaster Recovery & Patching

  • Oversee backup/restore policies across block, object, file, and PaaS data; plan and oversee the annual DR fail-over/fail-back test, reporting measured RPO/RTO.
  • Oversee the monthly OS patching cycle and CSP platform maintenance, communicating schedule and impacting the client.

Transition, Automation & Observability

  • Lead transition into managed services — design workshops, solution documentation, tool deployment, and knowledge transfer to steady-state operations.
  • Ensure monitoring/alerting/log management are configured to agreed thresholds, drive automation and continuous improvement (tracking MTTR and incident volume), and maintain client-facing reporting.

FinOps & Financial Management

  • Define budget thresholds and track alerts; oversee the quarterly cloud optimization analysis and reservation/savings-plan reviews.
  • Own delivery P&L inputs (utilization, productivity, revenue leakage) and partner with account leadership on renewals and extensions.

People & Team Leadership

  • Lead, mentor, and coach technical leads and engineers across onshore and offshore Global Cloud Operations centers, including 24x7 on-call coverage for Priority 1 incidents.
  • Manage capacity planning, staffing, and on-call models, and support career development, certification paths, and promotion readiness.

The Team:

At Hybrid Cloud Infrastructure, we deliver solutions spanning Hybrid Cloud, Advanced Connectivity, AI Data Centers, High-Performance Computing and AI Infrastructure to help clients achieve their desired outcomes. Our offerings include engineered transformation services for hybrid cloud infrastructure and platforms, prioritizing resiliency, optimization, and extensive automation. We integrate advanced connectivity with AI infrastructure and enterprise networks to boost operational efficiency and enable real-time data processing. Additionally, we provide comprehensive management of all facets of operations for hybrid cloud infrastructure and field operations.

This opportunity sits within our Deloitte US Delivery Center model, which is dedicated to driving impactful business services. It leverages Deloitte's scale and talent, as well as a center delivery model to provide high-quality, cost-effective service with standardized processes and procedures to service businesses across Deloitte.

The Deloitte US Delivery Center has a small-business feel with a big-business impact. With the resources of Deloitte and a community feel, the delivery center model provides high-quality services to our clients. USDC professionals work out of one of our specific delivery center locations, and each location presents dynamic career opportunities for professionals to focus on their work with nominal travel requirements.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years in IT infrastructure services delivery, including 5+ years delivering Azure solutions.
  • 3+ years as a delivery manager, service delivery manager or technical lead on an SLA-driven managed services engagement.
  • Strong working knowledge of Azure IaaS: Windows and Linux VMs, VMSS, virtual networks, NSGs, Azure Firewall/WAF, load balancers, managed disks and storage, Entra ID and Key Vault.
  • Working knowledge of Azure PaaS and serverless services (such as App Service, Functions and managed databases), including how operational responsibilities differ from IaaS.
  • Understanding of backup and disaster recovery on Azure (Azure Backup, Azure Site Recovery), RPO/RTO objectives and DR testing.
  • Strong command of ITIL and ServiceNow, including incident, problem and change management, SLA reporting and ticketing integrations.
  • Understanding of cloud security operations: vulnerability management, SIEM, endpoint protection, security posture management, IAM/PAM/MFA, and CIS and NIST controls.
  • Working knowledge of Infrastructure as Code and CI/CD (Terraform or Bicep; Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions) and Windows/Linux patch management.
  • Familiarity with monitoring and log management tools (such as Azure Monitor, Log Analytics or Datadog).
  • Experience with cloud cost management, including budget alerts, optimization reviews and reservations.
  • Commercial acumen across SOWs, SLAs, change orders and delivery financials.
  • Strong stakeholder and executive communication skills, including client governance and escalation handling.
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available
  • Ability to travel 25%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve

Preferred

  • Exposure to container platforms and Kubernetes operations (such as AKS).
  • Cloud certifications (Azure preferred) and ITIL 4 certification are an advantage.

Job.JobTitle: Delivery Consultant, Oracle HCM Cloud Functional Core HR
Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

Our Deloitte Human Capital team helps organizations create value through people performance. We work with clients to reimagine work, the workforce, and the workplace across the enterprise and to transform their HR functions with AI and emerging technology. With the rapid pace of change in today's world, you will help clients answer questions like: How do I access, develop, and motivate my workforce? What should my AI strategy be for the HR function? Do I have the right organization and culture to enable performance? Join our team to make work better for humans and humans better at work.

Work You'll Do

As a Delivery Consultant on the team, you will support Oracle Cloud HCM Core HR implementation and delivery activities by:

  • Supporting requirements-gathering and design workshops by documenting business needs and assisting with translating them into Oracle Cloud HCM Core HR configuration requirements
  • Assisting with configuration activities for Oracle Cloud HCM modules, including Employee Self-Service (ESS), Manager Self-Service (MSS), personnel action request (PAR) processing, position management, learning administration, time entry and approvals, absence plans, and related HR processes
  • Preparing and maintaining functional deliverables, including configuration workbooks, fit/gap documentation, security artifacts, integration touchpoints, process flows, and testing assets
  • Supporting fit-to-standard workshops by documenting process flows, business requirements, and design decisions for worker records, job and position management, assignments, person data, and HR transactions
  • Supporting data conversion and cutover activities, including worker and organizational-data mapping and validation, document checklists, and parallel-run activities
  • Collaborating with integration, payroll, reporting, and talent-management workstreams; supporting Oracle Transactional Business Intelligence (OTBI) and BI Publisher reporting activities; and maintaining action items and stakeholder communications
A successful candidate would possess these skills:
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The Team

Deloitte's Government & Public Services (GPS) practice – our people, ideas, technology and outcomes – is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our HR Strategy & Technology offering develops leading global HR strategies and implements HR technologies that drive transformation, maximize the workforce experience, and sustain HR effectiveness and value while navigating a world of disruption.

This opportunity sits within our Deloitte Center model, which is dedicated to driving impactful business services. It leverages Deloitte's scale and talent, as well as a center delivery model to provide high-quality, cost-effective service with standardized processes and procedures to serve businesses across Deloitte.

The Deloitte Center Model has a small-business feel with a big-business impact. With the resources of Deloitte and a community feel, the center model provides high-quality services to our clients. Center professionals work out of one of our specific Deloitte locations, and each location presents dynamic career opportunities for professionals to focus on their work with nominal travel requirements.

Qualifications

Required:

  • 1+ years Oracle Cloud HCM experience with configuration and support of Core HR module
  • 2+ years of experience supporting Oracle HCM implementations
  • Ability to obtain and maintain the required Public Trust clearance for this role
  • Bachelor's Degree
  • Center Location & Travel Requirements:
    • Hybrid Work Model: Operate under a hybrid system requiring residence within a commutable distance to one of the Center locations (Gilbert, Lake Mary, or Mechanicsburg)
    • Co-location Expectation: Spend up to 30% of working time co-located at an assigned office for orchestrated opportunities, including projects, practice sessions, training, and Moments That Matter at a Deloitte Center location, Geo-Hub location, approved site, or project location
    • Travel Requirement: Maximum of 10% overnight travel for client or project purposes
    • Relocation Requirement: If relocation is necessary, complete the move within 12 weeks from the start date to reside within a commutable distance
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future

Preferred:

  • Actively Oracle Cloud Implementation Professional certified
  • Experience with supporting or leading small functional teams in a hybrid delivery model
  • Experience with government/public sector projects

We're looking for a Senior Software Developer who wants more than just tickets to close. We want someone who thinks deeply about technical solutions, drives meaningful improvements, and takes ownership of their work.   • Strategic User Support: Provide high-level support and strategic guidance for resolving critical user issues.

• Growth

  • Drive Continuous Improvement and Foster Innovation: Lead efforts to adopt and integrate new technologies and methodologies to improve development efficiency and software quality. Explore and implement innovative solutions to complex technical challenges.

Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

If you are a technology visionary with a passion for transforming global tax business with digital technology, consider working with the US Tax Transformation technology team. This is an exciting opportunity to support global execution of Deloitte's tax strategy as we shift from “doing digital” to “being digital” by reimagining how we engage with our clients, deliver our services, operate our business, and create value.

What You'll Do

As a Deloitte Tax Enterprise Architect, Sr. Manager, you will be responsible to help our teams to build enterprise level web-based applications that exceed our standards.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and communicate clear technical vision for tax solutions that align with tax technology strategic objectives, leads the evolution of technology landscape to support future business needs.
  • Work with stakeholders to understand business challenges and opportunities, evaluate feasibility of requirements, determine priorities, and come up with enterprise architecture options and a technical roadmap.
  • Work directly with cross-functional teams to conceptualize, design and continuously improve architecture to meet and exceed resiliency standards.
  • Make high level design choices for the software structure, frameworks, protocols, and algorithms. Stay updated with the latest industry trends and technologies to ensure our systems are current and competitive.
  • Establish security best practices and duide architects to protect data and ensure compliance with relevant regulations.
  • Instill innovative AI solutions, and advanced development practices across tax technology organization
  • Implement standards, guidelines, and metrics aimed at delivering business value quickly and efficiently. Ensure performance, quality, and responsiveness of applications.
  • Work across architecture teams ensuring overall design and delivery standards and guidelines are followed. Enhance and maintain quality of tax applications and services.
  • Monitor and optimize the performance of tax systems, ensuring they are efficient, scalable and reliable.
  • Proactively identify, mitigate, and escalate Product-related risks.
  • Conduct design reviews and provide constructive feedback to team members.
  • Support and coach your team on best design practices, development trends, and pathfinding and surveys for technologies.
  • Develop and maintain technical documentation for architecture and design decisions.

The Team

Deloitte Tax LLP's Tax Transformation Office (TTO) is responsible for the design, development, and deployment of innovative, enterprise technology, tools, and standard processes to support the delivery of tax services. The TTO team focuses on enhancing Deloitte Tax LLP's ability to deliver comprehensive, value-added, and efficient tax services to our clients. It is a dynamic team with professionals of varying backgrounds from tax technical, technology development, change management, Six Sigma, and project management. The team consults and executes on a wide range of initiatives involving process and tool development and implementation including training development, engagement management, tool design, and implementation.

Job.JobTitle: Manager, Technical Product Owner - Tax Transformation
Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

If you are a technology visionary with a passion for transforming global tax business with digital technology, consider working with the US Tax Transformation technology team. This is an exciting opportunity to support global execution of Deloitte's tax strategy as we shift from “doing digital” to “being digital” by reimagining how we engage with our clients, deliver our services, operate our business, and create value.

Work you'll do

As a Deloitte Manager, Technical Product Owner, you will be responsible for managing vendor teams in building and delivering platform features according to prioritization. You will track and monitor progress, ensure timely reporting of milestone and dependency status, monitor risks and issues to escalate to leadership, and execute day-to-day coordination activities to support the technology transformation.

Additional responsibilities include:

  • Set development team's priorities and adherence to delivery standards.
  • Provide leadership coordination and oversight within one delivery team to deliver functionality on behalf of Tax.
  • Coordinate with business representatives when details are needed.
  • Partner on the design and ensure product meets specifications by conducting demos at Program Increment Sessions.
  • Follow standards, guidelines, and metrics aimed at delivering business value quickly and efficiently.
  • Proactively identify and mitigate product-related risks (escalate issues to the Delivery Lead and/or Portfolio Lead as needed).

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Clear, audience-centered communication — Ability to translate complex technical concepts, product decisions, and delivery risks into clear, actionable information for nontechnical business stakeholders.
  • Active listening and stakeholder empathy — Ability to understand business needs, ask effective questions, and tailor communication to different audiences, including tax professionals, technology teams, vendors, and leadership.
  • Influence and facilitation — Ability to build alignment, lead productive discussions, facilitate demos and working sessions, and influence decisions across teams without relying solely on formal authority.
  • Adaptability and sound judgment — Ability to remain composed in a fast-paced environment, adjust to changing priorities, manage competing demands, and escalate risks or issues with appropriate context and recommendations.

The team

Deloitte Tax LLP's Tax Transformation Office (TTO) is responsible for the design, development, and deployment of innovative, enterprise technology, tools, and standard processes to support the delivery of tax services. The TTO team focuses on enhancing Deloitte Tax LLP's ability to deliver comprehensive, value-added, and efficient tax services to our clients. It is a dynamic team with professionals of varying backgrounds from tax technical, technology development, change management, Six Sigma, and project management. The team consults and executes on a wide range of initiatives involving process and tool development and implementation including training development, engagement management, tool design, and implementation.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Ability to perform job responsibilities within a hybrid work model that requires US Tax professionals to co-locate in person 2 – 3 days per week
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, engineering, or a related field.
  • 5+ years' experience leading technical delivery teams and conducting product development using different software development. methodologies, like Agile and Scaled Agile.
  • Demonstrated experience working with and influencing as part of a team.
  • Knowledge of risk management and tracking techniques.
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.
  • Ability to travel up to 20%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • One of the following active accreditations obtained:
    • Licensed CPA in state of practice/primary office if eligible to sit for the CPA
    • If not CPA eligible:
      • Licensed attorney
      • Enrolled Agent
      • Alteryx Designer- Advanced Certification
      • CBAP® - Certified Business Analysis Professional
      • Certified SAFe® Advanced Scrum Master
      • Certified SAFe® Agile Software Engineer
      • Certified SAFe® Agilist
      • Certified SAFe® Architect
      • Certified SAFe® DevOps Practitioner
      • Certified SAFe® Lean Portfolio Manager
      • Certified SAFe® Practitioner
      • Certified SAFe® Product Owner / Product Manager
      • Certified SAFe® Scrum Master
      • Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO)
      • Microsoft Certified Solutions Developer (MCSD)
      • Program Management Professional (PgMP)
      • Project Management Professional (PMP)
      • Six Sigma (Green or Black Belt)

Preferred:

  • Azure DevOps experience
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills; strong listening, interpersonal, and facilitation skills
  • Able to interact effectively with professionals at all levels and communicate recommendations
  • Motivated, resourceful, and dependable
  • Well organized with the ability to multitask and prioritize multiple, ongoing projects
  • Able to respond quickly to high-priority deadlines with little lead-time and adaptable to direction changes

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $116,175 to $237,375.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

Job ID363531

Job.JobTitle: Adjunct Faculty - Game Business and Esports (Remote-FL)
Job.JobDescription:
If you're looking for the chance to learn, grow, and make a contribution to the community, look at employment opportunities with Full Sail University. You'll find your choice of career opportunities, great benefits, an environment that welcomes and values creativity, and a work experience that is both challenging and rewarding!

The Game Business and Esports BS program is seeking faculty to teach courses in game business. Topics range from the study of business monetization and operations, digital engagement, events, and community interactions. Students will learn to connect consumers to brands, generate revenue for businesses, and host events for various audiences. This position is part time working no more than 20 hours per week, on-campus OR online, and must be a resident in the state of Florida.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Create an environment of learning through effective teaching skills, maintain a student-centered focus, and update the curriculum to keep current and relevant to industry standards.
  • Utilize a variety of teaching strategies and encourage active learning.
  • Create learning activities, including assignments, tests, quizzes, and labs, and assess student outcomes in a timely manner through effective assessment and constructive feedback to students to support the learning process.
  • Perform lectures for campus courses, and hold scheduled virtual course meetings for online courses. Teaching will be conducted through on-campus and online delivery.
  • Interact positively with diverse student populations; provide all students with equal opportunities for learning.
  • Demonstrate a commitment to the industry, and maintain knowledge and skill relevancy through continuing education as defined in the faculty development plan.

Other Responsibilities:

  • Adheres to the policies and procedures of Full Sail University
  • Maintains strict confidentiality of student and company information
  • Demonstrates a strong commitment to the mission and values of the organization
  • Adheres to company attendance standards
  • Performs other duties as assigned

Supervisory Responsibilities: n/a

Competencies:

  • Strong organizational, analytical, and interpersonal skills
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including proofreading and editing for grammar and punctuation
  • Detail oriented
  • Ability to multi-task while working independently and collaboratively with other teachers and university staff
  • Ability to interact professionally and constructively with students and staff at all levels in an immersive, fast paced environment

Education and/or Experience:

The ideal candidate must have a minimum of four (4) years related and verifiable work experience and required to hold a Bachelor's or Master's (preferred), in digital media, marketing, business, broadcast production, management, etc. from an accredited college or university.

Certificates, Licenses, Registrations:

  • None.

Skills:

  • Experience in game business and operations
  • Knowledge of game product lifecycle
  • Experience with gaming cultures
  • Proficiency in event production
  • Proficiency using software programs such as MS Word, Excel, Keynote/PowerPoint and Outlook
  • Project Management
  • Proficiency in online learning, specifically ability to navigate, populate, manage, and assess materials in a learning management system
  • Ability to provide useful feedback

Environmental Factors/Physical Demands:

Work is performed in an office and classroom environment. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to have the ability to maintain active student and employee communication; access, input and retrieve information from the computer system. May be subject to; bending, reaching, kneeling, stooping and lifting up to thirty (30) pounds.

Full Sail is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Software Developer / Engineer, IT / Technology, Cybersecurity Analyst
Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

As a Full Stack Engineer Senior Consultant in Deloitte Cyber's Digital Trust & Privacy practice, you will operate at the intersection of client-facing advisory, product engineering, and hands-on technical delivery. You will help clients address complex challenges across digital trust, online protection, privacy, artificial intelligence governance, and data protection by translating business and regulatory requirements into scalable, production-grade technology solutions.

Full Stack Engineers work directly in client environments to architect, build, integrate, deploy, and improve solutions. Depending on the engagement, you may develop trust and safety capabilities, implement product compliance controls, operationalize privacy-by-design practices, build governance for generative or agentic AI, or deploy data protection and cryptographic solutions. These capabilities support Deloitte's broader Digital Trust & Privacy mission: helping organizations build confidence in their digital products, platforms, services, data practices, and customer interactions.

This role is designed for a technically strong consultant who can move from ambiguity to implementation, collaborate with product and engineering teams, and communicate effectively with business, security, privacy, legal, and compliance stakeholders.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/31/2026.

Work you'll do

As a Senior Consultant, Strategy, Growth and Transformation on the Digital Trust & Privacy team, you will be responsible for:

  • Translating client business objectives, risk requirements, and policy expectations into technical architectures, product requirements, engineering backlogs, and implementation plans
  • Designing, developing, integrating, deploying, testing, and troubleshooting production-grade solutions in client environments, including artificial intelligence (AI) and generative AI (GenAI)-enabled capabilities where applicable
  • Building application programming interfaces (APIs), automations, workflows, integrations, dashboards, and other technical components that enable scalable digital trust, privacy, and data protection capabilities
  • Embedding governance into software development and deployment workflows through automated checkpoints, controls-as-code, policy enforcement, and continuous monitoring
  • Collaborating with clients and cross-functional stakeholders to prototype solutions, resolve technical issues, and deliver solutions that meet regulatory and program objectives

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The team

Deloitte Cyber's Digital Trust & Privacy practice helps organizations build and sustain confidence in their digital products, platforms, services, data practices, and customer experiences. Our work brings together digital trust, online protection, privacy, AI governance, identity, data protection, cybersecurity, and regulatory compliance capabilities.

The Full Stack Engineer team is a multidisciplinary engineering group that turns these capabilities into practical solutions. We work alongside client product, engineering, security, privacy, data, risk, compliance, and business teams to move from strategy and policy to implementation and measurable outcomes.

Our work may include:

  • Helping digital platforms improve trust and safety and address online harms
  • Enabling product teams to meet privacy and product compliance expectations
  • Building technical governance and guardrails for generative and agentic AI
  • Protecting sensitive data across cloud, collaboration, application, and enterprise environments
  • Implementing data discovery, classification, data loss prevention (DLP), encryption, public key infrastructure (PKI), and related cryptographic capabilities
  • Developing Deloitte products and accelerators that make complex digital trust and privacy capabilities easier to deploy and operate

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or equivalent demonstrated experience
  • 4+ years of experience translating client requirements into solution architectures using Representational State Transfer (REST) application programming interfaces, microservices, event-driven architectures, or serverless components
  • 4+ years of experience building and deploying production-grade solutions using Python, Java, or Node.js, and 1+ years of experience delivering solutions on Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including containers, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines, and version control tools
  • 6 months+ of experience designing or deploying generative artificial intelligence (AI) or large language model (LLM) solutions in a client or production environment
  • Experience in one or more of the following: digital trust and online protection, trust and safety, security, product compliance, privacy, AI governance, data protection, or cryptography
  • Ability to travel 25-50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred:

  • Experience with JavaScript or TypeScript and React or Next.js for application or demo development
  • Experience developing or deploying technical controls for generative AI, LLM, or agentic AI applications
  • Experience with human oversight controls, tool access controls, prompt-injection mitigations, logging, monitoring, or controls-as-code
  • Experience in regulated industries such as financial services, healthcare, or public sector environments, including work aligned to Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX), Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS), Federal Financial Institutions Examination Council (FFIEC), Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA), or General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR)
  • Experience with Kubernetes, GitOps, Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, or Neo4j
  • One or more certifications such as Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), AWS, Azure, GCP, SailPoint, Okta, or OneTrust certifications

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $122,000 to $240,500.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

The Opportunity:

The Voice and Speech Informatics (VSI) Lab in The School of Communication Sciences and Disorders at the University of Central Florida is seeking a highly motivated Postdoctoral Research Associate with a strong engineering and computational background. This position is located at the UCF Main campus in Orlando, Florida, with an anticipated start date April 2027.


The postdoctoral scholar will work primarily on the development and application of computational methods for the analysis of high-speed laryngeal videoendoscopy recordings, with additional opportunities to contribute to projects involving acoustic, physiological, and wearable-sensor data. Research activities will involve computer vision, machine learning, deep learning, and multimodal data analysis. This is an exciting opportunity to work at the intersection of engineering, clinical science, and AI, contributing to NIH-funded research on vocal fold physiology and laryngeal imaging. The successful candidate will join a collaborative and interdisciplinary research environment with opportunities to develop novel computational methods, publish in leading journals, mentor student researchers, and contribute to ongoing NIH-funded projects.


The Voice and Speech Informatics (VSI) Lab develops computational methods that combine machine learning, computer vision, signal processing, and multimodal data analysis to study voice production, vocal physiology, and vocal health. We analyze laryngeal imaging, aerodynamic, electroglottographic, acoustic, physiological, and ambulatory monitoring data to address fundamental and translational questions related to voice function and disorders. The lab conducts NIH-funded research and collaborates closely with investigators across the Communication Technologies Research Collaborative (CTRC), providing access to diverse datasets, advanced instrumentation, and high-performance computing resources. The VSI lab and CTRC offer a highly interdisciplinary research environment at the intersection of engineering, artificial intelligence, and clinical science.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and evaluate computer vision, machine learning, and deep learning approaches for the analysis of laryngeal images and related biomedical data.
  • Analyze and integrate multimodal datasets, including laryngeal imaging, acoustic, aerodynamic, electroglottographic, physiological, and ambulatory monitoring data.
  • Prepare manuscripts for publication in peer-reviewed journals and present research findings at scientific conferences.
  • Mentor graduate and undergraduate researchers within the lab.
  • Contribute to collaborative research activities, including the development of grant proposals and new research initiatives.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • PhD in Biomedical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field
  • Proficiency in Python and/or MATLAB
  • Experience with deep learning, including PyTorch and/or TensorFlow
  • Experience developing, training, and evaluating computer vision and image segmentation models
  • Strong foundations in image processing and machine learning

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with video analysis, motion tracking, or object tracking.
  • Experience with medical image analysis
  • Experience with time‑series analysis
  • Experience with speech, voice, or acoustic signal processing
  • Experience with scientific software development, version control, and reproducible research practices.

Additional Application Materials Required:

UCF requires all applications and supporting documents to be submitted electronically through the Human Resources employment opportunities website, https://www.ucf.edu/jobs/. In addition to the online application, interested candidates should upload the following:

  • Curriculum vitae.
  • Brief statement (approximately 2 pages) describing the applicant's research interests, relevant experience, career goals, and potential research directions related to machine learning, computer vision, and multimodal analysis of high-speed videoendoscopy (HSV) and other voice-related datasets.
  • Up to two representative publications or preprints that best demonstrate the applicant's expertise and potential to contribute to research in computer vision, machine learning, medical image analysis, and multimodal data analysis.

NOTE: Please have all documents ready when applying so they can be simultaneously uploaded. Once the online submission process is finalized, the system does not allow applicants to submit additional documents later.


The selected candidate will be required to submit official transcripts (and, as applicable, U.S. degree equivalency evaluations) documenting the conferral of their qualifying academic credentials.

Job.JobTitle: Lecturer and Undergraduate Program Coordinator, Health Sciences
Job.JobDescription:
The Opportunity

The Department of Health Sciences in the College of Health Professions and Sciences (CHPS) at the University of Central Florida (UCF) invites applications for a 12-month, non-tenure earning, lecturer position. This is a face to face on campus position located at the UCF main campus with a start date in August 2027.

Candidates are required to be a Registered Dietitian Nutritionist (RDN) with substantial full-time teaching experience in an academic institution and a demonstrated commitment to high-quality instruction, student mentoring, curriculum development, and academic program administration.

The successful candidate will teach required undergraduate courses, including a General Education Program-approved nutrition course, an advanced, senior-level Health Sciences seminar or other courses consistent with departmental needs and the candidate's expertise. They will also contribute to instruction in the department's forthcoming graduate program in Nutrition Science and Dietetics.

In addition to teaching responsibilities, the selected candidate will serve as the Undergraduate Program Coordinator. This is a critical role that supports the quality, effectiveness, and continued development of the department's undergraduate curriculum. The coordinator will work collaboratively with department and college leadership, faculty, staff, and university partners to advance curricular best practices, facilitate continuous program improvement, support student recruitment and success, and ensure fulfillment of institutional and General Education Program requirements.

The successful candidate will be expected to:

  • Teach required undergraduate courses, including a General Education Program-approved nutrition course, an advanced, senior-level Health Sciences Seminar or other courses consistent with departmental needs and the candidate's expertise
  • Contribute to instructional and supervised practice aspects of our forthcoming Nutrition Science and Dietetics Coordinated Program.
  • Use evidence-based, inclusive, and student-centered teaching practices, including appropriate interprofessional education activities.
  • Mentor students in their academic, professional, and career development.
  • Coordinate undergraduate curriculum review and revision, prepare and manage curricular actions, including the development and submission of assessment plans, results, reports, and program improvement actions, and promote evidence-based curricular and pedagogical practices.
  • Coordinate the review and maintenance of General Education Program courses to ensure continued alignment with university standards, learning outcomes, assessment requirements, and reporting expectations.
  • Conduct transfer course evaluations and provide recommendations regarding course equivalencies, substitutions, and related curricular matters.
  • Conduct institutional effectiveness activities and contribute to academic program review, accreditation, and other institutional reporting activities, as applicable.
  • Collaborate with faculty, academic advisors, staff, and administrators to support the consistent implementation of undergraduate academic policies and procedures.
  • Coordinate and participate in undergraduate recruitment, outreach, orientation, and student engagement activities.
  • Participate in departmental, college, and university committees, governance activities, interprofessional education initiatives, and professional development.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Doctoral degree (i.e., PhD, DCN, DrPH, etc.) in Nutrition, Dietetics, Leadership, or a closely related field from an accredited institution at the time of application.
  • Credentialed as a Registered Dietitian Nutritionist (RDN) by the Commission on Dietetic Registration (CDR).
  • Minimum two academic years of college-level teaching experience as the instructor of record. Teaching experience gained as an instructor of record during doctoral study may be included.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Six or more years of full-time teaching experience as a faculty member and instructor of record at a baccalaureate-granting college or university.
  • Strong record of at least one of the following: teaching, mentorship, or program leadership.
  • Experience with curriculum development, curricular review, and academic program administration.
  • Excellent communication, organizational, and interpersonal skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively with diverse stakeholders.

Additional Application Materials Required:

UCF requires all applications and supporting documents be submitted electronically through the Human Resources employment opportunities website, https://www.ucf.edu/jobs/. In addition to the online application, candidates will be required to upload the following documents:

  • Cover letter addressing the applicant's qualifications with specific examples of how their experience will support high-quality instruction, student mentoring and success, curriculum management and continuous improvement, and the overall effectiveness of the undergraduate program.
  • Curriculum vitae
  • Teaching philosophy

NOTE: Please have all documents ready when applying so they can be simultaneously uploaded. Once the online submission process is finalized, the system does not allow applicants to submit additional documents later.


The selected candidate will be required to submit a list of references and official transcripts (and, as applicable, U.S. degree equivalency evaluations) documenting the conferral of their qualifying academic credentials.

Customer Service Coordinator - Part Time, Night Shift

Reports to: Customer Service Supervisor

FLSA Status: Non-Exempt | Supervisory Role: No

Why Join Us?

At Trustco Bank, we're committed to fostering a supportive and inclusive workplace where our employees can grow their careers. We believe that our people are our greatest asset and consider our employees as family. We value each team member's contribution and offer a supportive, collaborative work environment. Join Trustco Bank and be part of a team committed to excellence in mortgage lending. Apply today to help families realize their homeownership dreams with professionalism, integrity, and the highest standards of service!

We believe that investing in our employees means investing in the future of our company. As a valued team member, you will be eligible for a generous compensation and benefits package that includes: medical, dental and vision insurance, a health savings account with an annual employer contribution, a 401(k)-retirement plan with generous employer match, paid time off plus 11 paid federal holidays, training and professional development programs, tuition reimbursement, reduced fees and rates on certain loan products, and much more!

About the Customer Service Coordinator — Part Time, Night Shift Role

The Part-Time Customer Service Coordinator handles inbound calls during evening and weekend hours, providing account assistance, troubleshooting support, and customer guidance.

Key Responsibilities

  • Customer Interaction:
  • Respond to inbound calls promptly.
  • Provide accurate customer information.
  • Assist with navigation of online banking.
  • Operational Duties:
  • Process account inquiries.
  • Handle PIN/password reset tickets.
  • Recommend applicable bank services.
  • Stop Payments and ACH disputes
  • Assisting with Zelle transaction release and account suspensions
  • Debt card research, transactional inquiries and activation
  • Assist internal department with customer's research, verifications and follow-ups

This job description is not exhaustive; duties and responsibilities may change at any time with or without notice.

Qualifications

Required

  • High School Diploma or equivalent.
  • Customer service experience.
  • Strong communication skills.

Preferred

  • Call center experience.

Schedule

Part-time: Mon–Fri 4pm–8pm; Sat 11:30am–5pm; Sun Closed

Physical Demands:

Primarily sedentary; includes use of standard office equipment.

Reports to: Regional Vice President
FLSA Status: Non-Exempt | Supervisory Role: Yes

Why Join Us?

At Trustco Bank, we're committed to fostering a supportive and inclusive workplace where our employees can grow their careers. We believe that our people are our greatest asset and consider our employees as family. We value each team member's contribution and offer a supportive, collaborative work environment. In this role, you'll have the opportunity to lead a talented team, make a positive impact in our community, and be rewarded for your success.

We believe that investing in our employees means investing in the future of our company. As a valued team member, you will be eligible for a generous compensation and benefits package that includes: medical, dental and vision insurance, a health savings account with an annual employer contribution, a 401(k)-retirement plan with generous employer match, paid time off plus 11 paid federal holidays, training and professional development programs, tuition reimbursement, reduced fees and rates on certain loan products, and much more!

About the Branch Manager Role

We're looking for a dynamic and results-driven Branch Manager to lead the daily operations of a full-service branch. In this role, you'll oversee all aspects of branch performance—from sales and customer service to lending, operations, and security. You'll inspire and coach your team, foster strong customer relationships, and drive growth through new business development, referrals, and client retention.

The ideal candidate thrives in a leadership role, has a passion for delivering exceptional service, and can balance operational efficiency with strategic business growth.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and manage all branch operations, ensuring exceptional customer service and operational excellence.
  • Develop new deposit, loan, and business opportunities while achieving branch sales and retention goals.
  • Build and promote the branch's identity, fostering a sales-driven and customer-focused culture.
  • Supervise, coach, and evaluate team members including Assistant Branch Managers, Head Teller, and Tellers.
  • Conduct staff training, regular team meetings, and performance reviews.
  • Effectively execute the selling of new products, services, promotions, and incentive programs to drive growth.
  • Originate residential, home equity, and installment loans.
  • Ensure compliance with all bank policies, procedures, and security protocols.
  • Handle complex customer requests and resolve escalated issues in person or by phone.
  • Approve significant transactions such as large check cashing, bank checks, and general ledger tickets.
  • Maintain branch appearance and uphold operational performance standards.
  • Report regularly to senior management on branch performance, opportunities, and challenges.

This job description is not exhaustive; duties and responsibilities may change at any time with or without notice.

Qualifications

Required

  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Supervisory experience.
  • Strong customer service and cash-handling experience.
  • Excellent verbal communication and interpersonal skills in person, by phone, and via email.
  • Fluent in English; bilingual a plus
  • Access to reliable transportation
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Ability to work effectively in a collaborative team environment.
  • Willingness to participate in ongoing training and development.
  • Ability to lift 10–20 lbs., stand for extended periods.

Preferred

  • Bachelor's degree.
  • Previous banking or financial services experience.

Schedule

Full-time position with hours aligned to branch operations:

  • Mon–Wed: 8:30 AM – 5:00 PM
  • Thu–Fri: 8:30 AM – 6:00 PM
  • Sat: 8:30 AM – 12:00 PM (rotating schedule)
  • Sun: Closed

Employees may need to remain 15–30 minutes after closing. Occasional travel for training, meetings, or branch support.

The Direct Sales Agent Specialist is responsible for driving profitable growth by generating new business, cross-selling existing customers, and building lasting relationships. This role sells to local customers both in person and over the phone, while driving growth through community involvement, relationship building, and outside marketing efforts.

If you are ready to start working in a fun & exciting environment while making adifference, then apply to join our team today!

  • Develop relationships within the community (e.g., dealerships, events, local partners) to support business growth
  • Conduct outbound prospecting and follow-ups to convert opportunities into sales
  • Partner with leadership to support sales and local marketing initiatives
  • Stay informed on products, underwriting guidelines, and market competition

JOB POSITION:

  • Tech II, Rigging

JOB SUMMARY:

Provides the highly skilled, discipline specific technical skills needed for the successful operation and maintenance of the Rigging and Staging elements for assigned Entertainment venues, projects, events.

Responsible for the appropriate implementation of all policies and procedures, including high-risk, for assigned area and team, as defined by ANSI, ESTA, and Universal Orlando, governing the safe operation of all technical equipment.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Functions as the up rigger for installations and strikes within the assigned venue, project, event, or production. Assists with the operation of rigging and staging equipment. Assesses Hazards associated with rigging and staging equipment or systems. Immediately elevates identified hazards to Lead for mitigation determination. Responsible for the appropriate installation/setup, storage, strike, and transportation of Rigging and Staging equipment. Elevates any technical problems or concerns to Lead or management as they occur.
  • Operates large vehicles and heavy equipment. Lifts and places irregular objects and maneuvers equipment in all directions in challenging spaces. Acts as a spotter and provides correct hand signals for vehicles, heavy equipment, and hoist operation to ensure safety and to protect UOs assets.
  • Assists Tech I with inventory, maintenance, and inspection of rigging and stagging equipment. Submits proper paperwork for daily, weekly, monthly, and yearly inspections.
  • Responsible for effectively communicating pertinent information, both written and verbal, which pertains to the technical operation of the assigned entertainment venue/event, to other disciplines, entertainment tech management, and team members of the venue/event.
  • Understand and actively participate in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UO policy, procedures, training and team member involvement activities.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

EDUCATION: 

  • Technical school is preferred.

EXPERIENCE: 

Required:

  • 2-5 Years experience within the assigned technical discipline.

Preferred:

  • Prior experience within the professional theme park/theater industry in a technical capacity (Rigging and Staging); or equivalent combination of education and experience.

CERTIFICATIONS, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS:

  • Valid Florida Drivers License is required to operate company vehicles.
  • UO provided annual training is required for heavy equipment operation.

JOB POSITION:

  • Tech III, Rigging

JOB SUMMARY:

Provides the highly skilled, discipline specific technical skills needed for the successful operation, installation, and maintenance of the Rigging and Staging elements for assigned Entertainment venues, projects, events, and productions, to ensure highest levels of show quality and a positive guest experience.

Responsible for following all policies and procedures, including high-risk, for assigned area and team, as defined by ANSI, ESTA, and Universal Orlando, governing the safe operation of all technical equipment.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Will act as a ground rigger while assisting with installation / strike of the rigging and staging equipment within the assigned venue, project, or event.  Assists with the preparation, loading, unloading and transportation of rigging and staging gear and other equipment and materials.
  • Assisting with the use and operation of the rigging and staging equipment within the assigned venue, project, or event.
  • Responsible for the appropriate maintenance of rigging and staging equipment under the supervision of the Lead Tech.
  • Operates large vehicles and heavy equipment.  Acts as a spotter and provides correct hand signals for vehicles to protect UOs assets.
  • Assists in inspecting departments equipment inventory.
  • Understands and actively participates in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UO policy, procedures, training and team member involvement activities.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

EDUCATION: 

  • Technical school is preferred.

EXPERIENCE: 

Required:

  • 0-2 years experience within the assigned technical discipline. 

Preferred:

  • Prior experience within the professional theme park/theater industry in a technical capacity (Rigging and Staging); or equivalent combination of education and experience.

CERTIFICATIONS, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS:

  • A Valid Florida Drivers License is required to operate company vehicles. 
  • UO (Universal Orlando) provided annual training is required for heavy equipment operation.
