Job.CustomJobTypeName: Education / Training, Social Service / Non Profit
Job.JobDescription:
Calling all Lifeguards and/or Swim Instructors!

Come join our Oviedo YMCA as a Lifeguard or Swim Instructor to make a lasting impact & keep members/participates safe around water.

Our Lifeguards and Swim Instructors provide excellent customer service while maintaining safe swimming conditions in the pool, deck and surrounding areas. An Aquatics team member creates a safe and positive atmosphere that promotes member safety and engagement in accordance with the YMCA of Central Florida policies and procedures.

Why choose the YMCA?

  • Flexible scheduling that promotes work/life balance
  • Free/Discounted YMCA membership and other employee perks
  • Immediate openings, career growth, and year-round part-time positions available.
  • Opportunity to earn additional certification after hire
  • The Y is a cause-driven organization that provides a challenging and fun work environment with creative, talented and diverse individuals!

Our Culture

Our mission and core values are brought to life by our culture. In the Y, we strive to live our cause of strengthening communities with purpose and intentionality every day. We are hopeful: we believe in you and your potential to become a catalyst in the world. We are nurturing: we support you in your journey to develop your full potential. We are determined: above all else, we are on a relentless quest to make our community stronger beginning with you. We are the Y.

Job Responsibilities

  • Maintain constant surveillance of the pool area using constant scanning techniques to achieve a 10x10 reaction time and dealing with redirection and warnings in a timely manner. Remain alert and attentive to all swimmers while on guard.
  • Know and review all emergency procedures and responds to emergency situations immediately in accordance with the YMCA of Central Florida policies and procedures.
  • Know, understand and consistently apply safety rules, policies and guidelines for the pool and aquatic area.
  • Greet and develop effective relationships with the members, participants and other staff.
  • Assist in the retention of existing members and engagement of new members by informing them of the Family Center aquatic programs, including lap swimming, swim lessons, swim team and group exercise classes.
  • Ensure cleanliness of pool decks and aquatic areas. Check the pool for hazardous conditions.
  • Attend all staff meetings, monthly in-services and trainings as required.
  • Promote and represent the mission and core values of the YMCA of Central Florida in the Family Center and its programs.

Job Responsibilities specific to Swim Instructors:

  • Provides swimming and water safety instruction to students of all ages and abilities
  • Plans and implements program activities that are culturally relevant, developmentally appropriate, and consistent with YMCA values
  • Helps to create new approaches to serve the needs of program participants
  • Adheres to program standards, including safety and cleanliness standards, and ensures consistency with evidence-based practices
  • Maintains constant supervision of students, identifies students who need assistance, and supports students as necessary to ensure a positive learning environment

Requirements

  • Minimum age 16 years old.
  • Previous lifeguard or swim instructor experience a plus.
  • Current Lifeguard or Swim Instructor certification required by Hire Date. (For Lifeguards: YMCA Lifeguard certification preferred; Red Cross Lifeguard certification is acceptable but must receive YMCA certification within 60 days) (For Swim Instructors: YSL (YMCA) Certification or WSI (American Red Cross)–w/crossover training.
  • Previous customer service experience preferred.
  • Current CPR/AED and First Aid certifications required by Hire Date.
  • Current Oxygen Administration certification required by Hire Date.

Work Environment & Physical Demands

  • Must be willing to work a flexible schedule, which may include weekends and holidays as needed.
  • Must be willing to work an on-call schedule rotation as required.
  • The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate to loud.
  • Required to work outdoors for extended periods of time. May be exposed to extreme outdoor weather conditions and temperatures and to wet and/or humid conditions in swimming pool areas.
  • Must possess auditory, verbal and visual capabilities in order to adequately communicate via phone and in person. Talking is required for expressing or exchanging ideas by means of the spoken word. Hearing is required to perceive information at normal spoken word levels, with or without correction.
  • Must possess the physical ability to perform strenuous physical tasks necessary for a professional water rescue.
  • Must be able to work with hazardous chemicals (i.e., pool chemicals, cleaning solutions, disinfectants, etc.).
  • Must possess the physical ability to pass a lifeguard water test and perform strenuous physical tasks necessary for a professional water rescue.
  • Must be alert at all times, keeping safety in mind. Must possess acceptable hearing and visual capabilities in order to monitor environment and members' well-being.

Position Summary

Our Deloitte Strategy & Transactions team helps guide clients through their most critical moments and transformational initiatives. From strategy to execution, this team delivers integrated, end-to-end support and advisory services covering valuation modeling, cost optimization, restructuring, government operations modernization, business design and transformation, infrastructure and real estate, mergers and acquisitions (M&A), and sustainability. Work alongside clients every step of the way, helping them navigate new challenges, avoid financial pitfalls, and provide practical solutions at every stage of their journey—before, during, and after any major transformational projects or transactions.

Work you'll do

As a Program & Policy Delivery Consultant on the Operations Transformation team, you will provide analytical and operational support to project teams working on projects under the Rural Health Transformation Program, coordinating research, documentation, and day-to-day delivery. This is a client-facing role supporting teams in the day-to-day execution of program deliverables. The ideal candidate has a foundational interest and some experience in health policy or public sector work, strong organizational skills, and an eagerness to grow within a fast-paced consulting environment.

Role responsibilities include:

  • Conduct research on rural health policy topics, Medicaid regulations, and state government program developments, summarizing findings for internal team use
  • Assist in the preparation of internal and client-ready materials including PowerPoint presentations, meeting agendas, status reports, and program trackers
  • Maintain team calendars, meeting schedules, and action item logs to support project coordination
  • Support tracking of program milestones, deliverables, and deadlines across multiple workstreams
  • Assist senior team members with data gathering, documentation, and quality review of project outputs
  • Help maintain shared team resources including SharePoint sites, distribution lists, and filing systems

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The Team

Deloitte's Government & Public Services (GPS) practice – our people, ideas, technology and outcomes – is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our Operations Transformation offering provides NextGen core operational solutions and operating models, business-led technology support, and process optimization services, maximizing value to our government clients' missions.

This opportunity sits within our Deloitte US Delivery Center model, which is dedicated to driving impactful business services. It leverages Deloitte's scale and talent, as well as a center delivery model to provide high-quality, cost-effective service with standardized processes and procedures to service businesses across Deloitte.

The Deloitte US Delivery Center has a small-business feel with a big-business impact. With the resources of Deloitte and a community feel, the delivery center model provides high-quality services to our clients. USDC professionals work out of one of our specific delivery center locations, and each location presents dynamic career opportunities for professionals to focus on their work with nominal travel requirements.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree
  • 2+ years of professional experience in a public sector, healthcare, consulting, or related environment
  • Delivery Center Location & Travel Requirements:
    • Hybrid Work Model: Operate under a hybrid system requiring residence within a commutable distance to one of the US Delivery Center locations (Gilbert, Lake Mary, or Mechanicsburg) or Geo-Hub locations (Atlanta, Charlotte, Dallas, Houston, and Philadelphia)
    • Co-location Expectation: Spend up to 30% of working time co-located at an assigned office for orchestrated opportunities, including projects, practice sessions, training, and Moments That Matter at a Deloitte Delivery Center location, Geo-Hub location, approved site, or project location
    • Travel Requirement: Maximum of 10% overnight travel for client or project purposes
    • Relocation Requirement: If relocation is necessary, complete the move within 12 weeks from the start date to reside within a commutable distance
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future

Preferred:

  • Strong written communication skills, including the ability to summarize research and draft clear, organized documents
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams)
  • Demonstrated ability to manage tasks, meet deadlines, and stay organized across multiple priorities
  • Collaborative working style with a willingness to support teammates
  • Academic or professional background in Public Health, Health Administration, Public Policy, Business Administration, or a related field
  • Exposure to Medicaid, state health agency programs, or human services policy (through coursework, internships, or early career experience)
  • Experience using SharePoint or similar project coordination and document management tools
  • Familiarity with rural health issues, health equity, or underserved population health topics
  • Experience supporting meeting coordination, note-taking, or reporting in a professional set

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $71,300 to $140,600.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

Deloitte is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for people with disabilities. If you require a reasonable accommodation to participate in the recruiting process, please direct your inquiries to the Global Call Center (GCC) at USTalentCICInbox@deloitte.com.

Job ID372513

JOB OVERVIEW:

The Associate Manager, Digital Properties serves as a Digital Product Manager responsible for the strategy, roadmap, and execution of owned digital experiences across brand websites and mobile applications. This role partners closely with Brand, IT, and channel stakeholders (Organic Search, CRM, Paid Media, and Organic Social) to deliver high-performing, guest-centric digital experiences that drive engagement, conversion, and business growth. The role owns the prioritization and delivery of digital enhancements, ensuring seamless integration of marketing campaigns, technical capabilities, and data-driven optimizations across all digital touchpoints.

ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

Product Strategy & Roadmap

-Own and maintain the digital product roadmap for brand websites and mobile applications

-Translate brand strategies and marketing priorities into digital product features, enhancements, and experiences

-Evaluate and prioritize initiatives based on guest impact, business value, and technical feasibility

-Identify opportunities to improve the digital experience through innovation, industry trends, and competitive insights

Customer Journey Ownership

-Ensure seamless, consistent experiences across all entry points, including:

-Organic Search landing pages

-Paid media campaigns

-Email/CRM journeys

-Organic Social traffic

-Advocate for the guest by ensuring experiences are intuitive, performant, and aligned to brand standards

Marketing Campaign Enablement

-Partner with Digital Brand Managers to bring campaigns to life on digital properties

-Ensure all campaign experiences are:

-Technically sound

-Optimized for engagement and conversion

-Delivered on time and aligned to marketing objectives

-Provide strategic recommendations on digital experience design and execution for campaigns

Channel Partner Integration

-Serve as the primary digital product partner to Organic Search, Email/CRM, Paid Media, and Organic Social teams

-Ensure proper alignment across:

-Landing page strategy and experience design

-Campaign tagging and tracking

-Conversion optimization opportunities

-Act as the central intake and prioritization point for digital requests from channel teams

Performance, Analytics & Optimization

-Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) for digital products (e.g., engagement, conversion, traffic quality)

-Leverage Google Analytics to:

-Inform product decisions

-Identify optimization opportunities

-Lead or support A/B testing and experimentation efforts to improve digital performance

-Partner with analytics teams to ensure proper measurement frameworks are in place

Partner with IT as the product delivery team

-Partner closely with IT as the product delivery team to execute the digital roadmap

-Translate business needs into clear requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria

ADDITIONAL RESPONSIBILITIES:

-Monitor platform health, including site performance, speed, and functionality

-Lead identification and resolution of critical issues and defects impacting guest experience

-Continuously improve processes for cross-functional collaboration and execution efficiency

-Drive alignment between competing priorities (Brand vs. Tech vs. Performance)

-Takes on and completes special projects as requested

-Leads and develops direct reports as assigned

-Provide on-call support for critical digital incidents impacting guest experience or revenue

REQUIRED TECHNICAL SKILLS:

-5+ years of experience in digital product management, digital marketing, or web/mobile platforms

-Strong experience managing websites and/or mobile applications in a high-volume environment

-Experience working in cross-functional teams with Marketing, IT, and external partners

-Familiarity with Agile methodologies and product development processes

-Working knowledge of web technologies (HTML5, CSS, JavaScript, APIs)

-Strong understanding of digital analytics platforms (Google Analytics)

-Experience with CMS platforms (e.g., Contentstack & Commerce Tools)

-Knowledge of SEO fundamentals, tagging strategies, and campaign tracking

-Experience with product management tools (e.g., Wrike, Azure DevOps)

-Familiarity with testing and optimization tools (e.g., Optimizely) is a plus

-Solid understanding of mobile-first design principles and UX best practices

REQUIRED EDUCATION:

-Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Digital, Technology, or related field required

-MBA or advanced degree preferred

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

-Experience in restaurant, hospitality, retail, CPG, or agency environments

-Experience supporting multi-channel marketing ecosystems

-Passion for food, hospitality, and guest-centric experiences

ADDITIONAL EXPECTATIONS

-Provide on-call support for critical digital incidents impacting guest experience or business operations

-Demonstrate a strong sense of ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement

Job.JobTitle: Rural Health Program & Policy Senior Consultant
Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

Our Deloitte Strategy & Transactions team helps guide clients through their most critical moments and transformational initiatives. From strategy to execution, this team delivers integrated, end-to-end support and advisory services covering valuation modeling, cost optimization, restructuring, government operations modernization, business design and transformation, infrastructure and real estate, mergers and acquisitions (M&A), and sustainability. Work alongside clients every step of the way, helping them navigate new challenges, avoid financial pitfalls, and provide practical solutions at every stage of their journey—before, during, and after any major transformational projects or transactions.

Work you'll do

As a Rural Health Program & Policy Delivery Senior Consultant on the Operations Transformation team, you will provide analytical and operational support to project teams working on projects under the Rural Health Transformation Program, coordinating research, documentation, and day-to-day delivery. This is a client-facing role supporting teams in the day-to-day execution of program deliverables. The ideal candidate has a foundational interest and some experience in health policy or public sector work, strong organizational skills, and an eagerness to grow within a fast-paced consulting environment.

Role responsibilities include:

  • Conduct research on rural health policy topics, Medicaid regulations, and state government program developments, summarizing findings for internal team use
  • Assist in the preparation of internal and client-ready materials including PowerPoint presentations, meeting agendas, status reports, and program trackers
  • Maintain team calendars, meeting schedules, and action item logs to support project coordination
  • Support tracking of program milestones, deliverables, and deadlines across multiple workstreams
  • Assist senior team members with data gathering, documentation, and quality review of project outputs
  • Help maintain shared team resources including SharePoint sites, distribution lists, and filing systems

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The Team

Deloitte's Government & Public Services (GPS) practice – our people, ideas, technology and outcomes – is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our Operations Transformation offering provides NextGen core operational solutions and operating models, business-led technology support, and process optimization services, maximizing value to our government clients' missions.

This opportunity sits within our Deloitte US Delivery Center model, which is dedicated to driving impactful business services. It leverages Deloitte's scale and talent, as well as a center delivery model to provide high-quality, cost-effective service with standardized processes and procedures to service businesses across Deloitte.

The Deloitte US Delivery Center has a small-business feel with a big-business impact. With the resources of Deloitte and a community feel, the delivery center model provides high-quality services to our clients. USDC professionals work out of one of our specific delivery center locations, and each location presents dynamic career opportunities for professionals to focus on their work with nominal travel requirements.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree
  • 5+ years of professional experience in a public sector, healthcare, consulting, or related environment
  • Delivery Center Location & Travel Requirements:
    • Hybrid Work Model: Operate under a hybrid system requiring residence within a commutable distance to one of the US Delivery Center locations (Gilbert, Lake Mary, or Mechanicsburg) or Geo-Hub locations (Atlanta, Charlotte, Dallas, Houston, and Philadelphia)
    • Co-location Expectation: Spend up to 30% of working time co-located at an assigned office for orchestrated opportunities, including projects, practice sessions, training, and Moments That Matter at a Deloitte Delivery Center location, Geo-Hub location, approved site, or project location
    • Travel Requirement: Maximum of 10% overnight travel for client or project purposes
    • Relocation Requirement: If relocation is necessary, complete the move within 12 weeks from the start date to reside within a commutable distance
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future

Preferred:

  • Strong written communication skills, including the ability to summarize research and draft clear, organized documents
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams)
  • Demonstrated ability to manage tasks, meet deadlines, and stay organized across multiple priorities
  • Collaborative working style with a willingness to support teammates
  • Academic or professional background in Public Health, Health Administration, Public Policy, Business Administration, or a related field
  • Exposure to Medicaid, state health agency programs, or human services policy (through coursework, internships, or early career experience)
  • Experience using SharePoint or similar project coordination and document management tools
  • Familiarity with rural health issues, health equity, or underserved population health topics
  • Experience supporting meeting coordination, note-taking, or reporting in a professional set

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $91,100 to $163,100.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

Job ID372390

Job.JobTitle: Cyber ServiceNow SecOps/SIR – Senior Business Process Consultant
Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

Position Summary

Our Deloitte Cyber team understands the unique challenges and opportunities businesses face in cybersecurity. Join our team to deliver powerful solutions to help our clients navigate the ever-changing threat landscape. Through powerful solutions and managed services that simplify complexity, we enable our clients to operate with resilience, grow with confidence, and proactively manage to secure success.

Recruiting for this role ends on 05/31/2027.

Work you'll do

• Lead requirements & design workshops and stakeholder interviews with SOC, incident response, threat intelligence, and IT operations leaders

• Guide client stakeholders through migration considerations from current-state processes, tools, and data to ServiceNow-aligned architecture, including out-of-the-box adoption, customization trade-offs, and sequencing of capabilities

• Own the process design & development workstream: current-state assessment, future-state design, response runbooks, severity and escalation models, major incident procedures, RACI, SLAs, and KPIs (e.g., MTTD, MTTR, escalation rate, automation coverage)

• Develop epics and user stories, directly as output from workshops and process design sessions, working alongside other business process consultants and solution architects

• Drive functional design decisions for SIR, including alert-to-incident logic, playbooks and flows, Threat Intelligence Security Center (TISC) enrichment, assignment, post-incident reviews, dashboards, and access models, and document via user stories and design documentation

• Document requirements, RACI matrices, data flows, and integration needs with SIEM, EDR, Threat Intelligence Security Center (TISC) and other threat intelligence sources, as well as touchpoints the CMDB

• Produce project artifacts: process flows, functional designs, test scenarios, training materials, and release notes

• Identify where Now Assist and AI Specialists, including agentic incident response, can reduce manual triage and investigation work, and define the human-in-the-loop approval process around them

• Define integration and data requirements for SIEM, EDR, SOAR, TISC and other threat feeds, and the CMDB in partnership with technical leads

• Develop your workstream backlog, interacting directly with a team of technical consultants to configure ServiceNow to client specifics

• Manage day-to-day agile activities, including user story assignment, backlog grooming, sprint preparation, and story refinement

• Assist in project management reporting, understanding workstream and project wide dependencies and when to raise appropriate risks

• Review and own quality-check deliverables from Consultants; mentor and coach team members.

• Manage workstream scope, timeline, and risks; escalate early with a recommendation to engagement managers and senior leadership

• Lead show back demonstrations, UAT, defect triage training, cutover, and adoption planning

• Contribute to proposals, estimates, and reusable practice assets

A successful candidate would possess these skills

• Self-starter who takes ownership of a workstream and delivers without close supervision

• Sharp analytical thinker who cuts through complexity to the core issue

• Resourceful problem solver who builds workable solutions when there is no playbook

• Advisory mindset: explains trade-offs in plain language and recommends the ServiceNow-aligned path

• Collaborative leader who raises the performance of the people around them

• Confident client-facing communicator, comfortable with technical and executive audiences

• Meticulous attention to detail and quality

• Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment

• Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The team

Our Cyber Strategy & Transformation offering develops and transforms cyber programs in line with our client's strategic objectives, regulatory requirements, and risk appetite. We support capabilities across a broad suite of ServiceNow products across SecOps, Integrated Risk Management, and IT Asset Management. We are a growing team and are looking for our next generation of leaders to steer the direction of practice.

Qualifications

Required

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, Engineering, Information Technology, or Business Administration

• 4+ years supporting or leading ServiceNow implementation projects in a client-facing consulting role

• 4+ years gathering business requirements, leading workshops, and designing process flows and functional documentation

• 3+ years designing, configuring, or implementing ServiceNow Security Incident Response including at least one full implementation

• Working knowledge of SOC and incident response operating processes

• Experience leading a workstream and mentoring junior team members

• Experience guiding clients from legacy tools and processes to ServiceNow out-of-the-box aligned design and best practices

• ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA)

• Ability to travel 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve

• Limited immigration sponsorship may be available

Preferred

• ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD)

• ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist – Security Incident Response (CIS- SIR)

• Architecture Excellence (ArchX)

• Experience with Threat Intelligence Security Center (TISC)

• Experience applying NIST 800-61, NIST CSF, ISO 27001, or MITRE ATT&CK in process or platform design

• Experience integrating ServiceNow with SIEM, EDR, or SOAR tools

• Experience with Now Assist for Security Operations, AI Specialists, or Performance Analytics

• Experience migrating from another case management or SOAR platform

Compensation and Additional Information

Description & Requirements

Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.

We are looking for an organized, dependable, and proactive Billing Coordinator. Based within our Creative Studio, this role reports directly to the Director of Global Events while receiving day-to-day operational guidance and mentorship from our Billing Manager. You will drive day-to-day billing and purchasing operations across key marketing and communication disciplines.

In this role, you will partner closely with global stakeholders - including Event Producers, Talent and Community Managers, Communications Leads, Finance, Legal, and external suppliers. From handling purchase orders (POs) and vendor onboarding to routing invoices and maintaining weekly financial trackers, you will keep our payment operations moving smoothly, accurately, and on schedule across our portfolio of titles and experiences.

Responsibilities:

  • Create and process daily purchase order (PO) requests such as Oracle.

  • Vendor setups in EA's financial tools such as Tap Tool.

  • Review incoming invoices, match them to corresponding open POs, and submit them to Accounts Payable (A/P) for timely processing.

  • Maintain internal PO and invoice trackers daily with accurate, up-to-date payment status, account coding, and documentation.

  • Partner with the Billing Manager to conduct weekly audits of PO trackers to catch missing details or pending approvals early.

  • Proactively follow up with project managers and business owners on un-invoiced open POs to maintain budget accuracy.

  • Take ownership of billing discrepancies - work directly with Purchasing, A/P, and vendors to resolve payment holds or invoice mismatches with minimal supervision.

  • Serve as the dedicated billing point of contact for supported teams, responding promptly and professionally to vendor and internal payment inquiries.

  • Ensure all billing activities meet month-end and fiscal year-end deadlines in full adherence to EA payment policies.

  • Build strong, collaborative relationships across teams and proactively suggest workflow improvements and updates to team documentation.

Qualifications:

  • 2+ years of experience in billing, accounts payable, or operational purchasing support, managing a steady, high volume of POs, invoices, and vendor setups.

  • Systems & Spreadsheets: Hands-on experience with financial and purchasing systems (such as Oracle, Salesforce) and proficiency with Excel/Google Sheets for tracking, filtering, and organizing financial data.

  • Independent Problem Solver: Proven ability to take ownership of tasks, investigate discrepancies with Purchasing or A/P, and resolve billing issues independently with minimal supervision.

  • Organization & Detail: Exceptional organizational skills with the ability to track contracts, paperwork, and approval workflows across multiple teams simultaneously without missing deadlines.

  • Communication & Collaboration: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, a customer-service mindset, and a demonstrated ability to build strong relationships across diverse teams.

  • Adaptable & Coachable: Quick learner who embraces feedback, adapts well to changing priorities, and actively speaks up with ideas to improve processes.

About Evermore

Shape the Next Generation of Vacations!
Welcome to Evermore Orlando Resort, the resort that's redefining the Orlando vacation experience. Just steps away from Walt Disney World®, Evermore stretches across 1,100 acres and offers a one-of-a-kind blend of spacious, upscale vacation homes, flats, and villas alongside the luxurious Conrad hotel. Our Team Members are true trailblazers, reimagining the vacation experience for each guest. Here, guests create their own adventure, enjoying the best of both worlds: the space and comforts of vacation home rentals combined with the amenities and services of a world-class resort.

Evermore Orlando Resort is an expansive and technically complex property spanning 1,100 acres with multiple operational components. The resort integrates resort-owned vacation rental homes, large-scale water features, and extensive recreational infrastructure. The eight-acre Evermore Bay lagoon includes advanced water treatment, circulation, and safety systems that require continuous monitoring. Two championship golf courses, numerous pools, water sports facilities, and a wide range of amenities, including pickleball courts, event spaces, and dining venues, further enhance the offerings. This diverse environment demands sophisticated engineering oversight to ensure optimal performance, safety, and reliability across all systems.

If you're excited to help guests reimagine the Orlando vacation, join us! Become part of an energetic team bringing Evermore Orlando Resort to life!

  • Identify opportunities for differentiation and develop strategies to capture a larger share of the market.
  • Develop and maintain collaborative relationships with peers to drive revenue growth and enhance guest satisfaction.

Education, Skills and Experience

Physical Requirements

Job Summary

The Facilities Project Coordinator provides technical, administrative, and supervisory support to the Facility Manager across multiple City of Orlando venues including Kia Center, Camping World Stadium, Harry P. Leu Gardens, and the Mennello Museum of American Art.

This is a highly hands-on technical position responsible for supporting all aspects of facility operations, maintenance, repairs, troubleshooting, and building systems management. The role requires an individual who is comfortable working directly in the field using tools, diagnosing problems, performing minor repairs, coordinating corrective actions, and ensuring facilities remain safe, operational, and event-ready.

The Facilities Project Coordinator will work alongside maintenance staff, engineers, vendors, and contractors while also independently performing inspections, repairs, equipment adjustments, and operational support functions as needed. This position requires practical working knowledge of facility systems, mechanical equipment, hardware, tools, and life-safety systems including fire alarm panels and fire suppression systems.

This role requires the ability to respond to operational issues quickly, troubleshoot building-related problems, and support maintenance activities during nights, weekends, holidays, and special events as required

Locations Currently Supported

  • Kia Center
  • Camping World Stadium
  • Harry P. Leu Gardens
  • Mennello Museum of American Art

Additional support may include future City of Orlando venues, including a planned amphitheater and multipurpose sports facility

* PREVIOUS APPLICANTS DO NOT NEED TO REAPPLY *


Minimum Qualifications:
Associate's degree or trade school certification with coursework in Facility Management, Building Maintenance, Construction Technology, Mechanical Systems, or a related field, plus Four (4) years of experience in facility maintenance, building operations, construction, mechanical systems, or commercial/public venue operations. And two (2) years of supervisory or lead experience required. Or an equivalent combination of education, training, and hands-on technical experience.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Coordinate, supervise, and actively participate in maintenance and repair projects across assigned City of Orlando venues, including:
    • HVAC systems
    • Electrical systems
    • Plumbing systems
    • Structural and building systems
    • Mechanical equipment
    • Doors, hardware, locks, and facility infrastructure
    • Fire alarm panels and fire suppression systems
  • Perform hands-on troubleshooting, diagnostics, repairs, adjustments, and operational support for building equipment and facility systems.
  • Utilize hand tools, power tools, testing equipment, ladders, lifts, and maintenance hardware safely and effectively in daily operations.
  • Conduct routine inspections of facility systems and equipment to identify deficiencies, safety concerns, maintenance needs, and operational issues.
  • Assist with repairing and maintaining facility hardware, fixtures, equipment components, and operational systems as needed.
  • Support preventive maintenance programs by performing inspections, tracking repairs, and assisting with maintenance scheduling to improve system reliability and facility performance.
  • Monitor and assist with fire alarm systems, fire panels, fire suppression equipment, emergency systems, and life-safety compliance requirements.
  • Requisition equipment, tools, parts, materials, and supplies necessary for facility maintenance and operations.
  • Coordinate and oversee outside contractors, vendors, and service providers to ensure work is completed safely, efficiently, and in compliance with project scope and City standards.
  • Assist the Facility Manager with project planning, scheduling, budgeting coordination, reporting, operational logistics, and work order management.
  • Respond to facility emergencies, operational failures, equipment malfunctions, and event-related maintenance needs in a timely and professional manner.
  • Provide operational and technical support during events including evenings, weekends, holidays, and extended operational hours.
  • Collaborate with operations staff, event personnel, contractors, and City representatives to maintain safe, clean, and event-ready facilities.
  • Maintain accurate maintenance records, inspection reports, project documentation, operational logs, and work order tracking.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable building codes, safety standards, OSHA requirements, and operational procedures.

Supervision & Accountability

Work is performed under the general supervision of the Facility Manager.

Performance is evaluated through project completion, operational efficiency, responsiveness, facility condition, teamwork, technical knowledge, and written/verbal communication.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Facility Management, Construction Management, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Experience supporting stadiums, arenas, museums, entertainment venues, public assembly facilities, or multi-site operations.
  • Strong hands-on experience with building systems, facility repairs, tools, hardware, mechanical equipment, and preventive maintenance programs.
  • Working knowledge of:
    • Fire alarm panels
    • Fire suppression systems
    • Building automation systems
    • Electrical troubleshooting
    • Mechanical equipment operations
    • CMMS/work order systems
  • Experience coordinating contractors while also performing field-level operational support and repairs.
  • Experience in event-driven or fast-paced facility environments.

Additional Requirements

  • Ability to work a flexible schedule including nights, weekends, holidays, and extended hours based on operational and event needs.
  • Ability to respond to urgent facility issues and support live event operations.
  • Possession of a valid Florida Driver's License.
  • Strong organizational, communication, leadership, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, hands-on operational environment.
  • Ability to lift equipment, climb ladders, inspect systems, operate tools, and move throughout multiple facility environments as required.
  • Ability to safely use maintenance tools, testing devices, and operational equipment.

Why Join Our Team

This role plays a critical part in supporting some of Orlando's most iconic venues and public spaces. The Facilities Project Coordinator helps ensure facilities remain safe, functional, operationally efficient, and event-ready through a combination of technical expertise, hands-on repair work, project coordination, troubleshooting, and operational leadership.

This is an exciting opportunity for a facilities professional who enjoys solving problems, working with tools and equipment, supporting large-scale venues, and being actively involved in the daily operation and maintenance of high-profile facilities.

Important: To be eligible to proceed forward in the application process, applicants must meet the minimum qualifications listed in the position description. Please ensure your application provides details of all relevant experience related to the position. If you have questions or need clarification concerning the position or application process, please contact Human Resources at jobs@orlando.gov or 407.246.2062.

JOB SUMMARY

Responsible for all front office functions and staff as well as security staff functions. Areas of responsibility include Bell Staff, Switchboard Operations, Guest Services/Front Desk, Retail/Gift Shop, Concierge, Valets, and Security, as applicable. As a department head, directs and works with managers and employees to successfully execute all front office operations, including guest arrival and departure procedures. Works to establish a safe and secure environment for all guests and associates. Strives to continually improve guest and employee satisfaction and maximize the financial performance of the department.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Education and Experience

• High school diploma or GED; 6 years experience in the guest services, front desk, or related professional area.

OR

• 2-year degree from an accredited university in Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration or related major; 4 years experience in the guest services, front desk, or related professional area.

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

Leading Front Desk, Guest Services, and Security Teams

• Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound financial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.

• Encourages and builds mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.

• Serves as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.

• Supervises and manages employees. Manages all day-to-day operations. Understands employee positions well enough to perform duties in employees' absence.

• Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with employees and ensures employees do the same within the team.

• Ensures recognition of employees is taking place across areas of responsibility.

• Communicates performance expectations in accordance with job descriptions for each position and monitors progress.

• Celebrates successes and publicly recognizes the contributions of team members.

Managing Guest Services and Front Desk Teams

• Achieves and exceeds goals including performance goals, budget goals, team goals, etc.

• Manages day-to-day operations, ensuring the quality, standards and meeting the expectations of the customers on a daily basis.

• Develops specific goals and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish work.

• Keeps Front Office team focused on the critical components of operations to drive guest satisfaction and the desired financial results.

• Conducts department meetings and continually communicates a clear and consistent message regarding department goals to produce desired results.

• Supervises and coordinates all activities for luggage attendants, garage valets, door attendants, and concierge.

• Reviews staffing levels to ensure that guest service, operational needs and financial objectives are met.

• Understands the impact of Front Office operations on the Rooms area and overall property financial goals.

• Manages department controllable expenses to achieve or exceed budgeted goals.

• Provide recommendations and reports for capital expenditures, repairs and maintenance programs for all front office areas.

• Handle guest complaints and verify that all guest issues are resolved.

Managing Security Team

• Protects property and provides a safe environment for guests and staff.

• Oversees all on-duty security personnel, including dispatcher.

• Supervises and coordinates job assignments and verifies that each officer is briefed on the day's activities.

• Complies information and files written security reports.

Managing Projects and Policies

• Verifies compliance with all Front Office policies, standards and procedures.

• Verifies property policies are administered fairly and consistently, disciplinary procedures and documentation are completed according to Standard and Local Operating Procedures (SOPs and LSOPs) and support the Peer Review Process.

Providing Exceptional Customer Service

• Provides services that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention.

• Coordinates activities with other hotel departments in order to facilitate incrased levels of communication and guest satisfaction.

• Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed.

• Supervises and managing employees. Managing all day-to-day operations. Understanding employee positions well enough to perform duties in employees' absence.

• Acts as the “Service Champion” for the Front Office and creates a positive atmosphere for guest relations.

• Displays leadership in guest hospitality, exemplifies excellent customer service, and creates a positive atmosphere for guest relations.

• Strives to improve service performance.

• Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service.

• Verifies that all Front Office areas have an atmosphere that is conducive to the overall guest experience.

• Reviews comment cards, guest satisfaction results and other data to identify areas of improvement.

• Responds to and handles guest problems and complaints.

• Observes service behaviors of employees and provides feedback to individuals and/or managers.

Managing and Conducting Human Resource Activities

• Identifies the developmental needs of others and coaching, mentoring, or otherwise helping others to improve their knowledge or skills.

• Provides guidance and direction to subordinates, including setting performance standards and monitoring performance.

• Establishes challenging, realistic and obtainable goals to guide operation and performance.

• Solicits employee feedback, utilizes an “open door” policy, and reviews employee satisfaction results to identify and address employee problems or concerns.

• Verifies employees are treated fairly and equitably.

• Manages employee progressive discipline procedures for Front Office Staff.

• Administers the performance appraisal process for direct report managers.

• Interviews and hires managers and hourly employee team members with the appropriate skills and in a timely manner to meet the business needs of the operation.

Additional Responsibilities

• Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.

• Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.

• Informs and/or updates the executives, the peers and the subordinates on relevant information in a timely manner.

• Identifies and analyzes departmental operational challenges and facilitates the development of solutions to prevent reoccurrence.

POSITION SUMMARY

Our jobs aren't just about giving guests a smooth check-in and check-out. Instead, we want to build and experience that is memorable and unique. Our Guest Experience Experts take the initiative to deliver a wide range of services that guide guests through their entire stay. They are empowered to move about their space and do what needs to be done. Whether processing operational needs, addressing guest requests, completing reports, or sharing the highlights of the local area, the Guest Experience Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.

No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success – creating a safe work place, following company policies and procedures, maintaining confidentiality, protecting company assets, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional. Guest Experience Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 10 pounds without assistance). Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Experience Experts – to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.

Related Work Experience: No related work experience.

Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.

License or Certification: None

If you're looking for the chance to learn, grow, and make a contribution to the community, look at employment opportunities with Full Sail University. You'll find your choice of career opportunities, great benefits, an environment that welcomes and values creativity, and a work experience that is both challenging and rewarding!

The Public Relations Manager will work to develop strategic communication efforts that enhance the reputation, visibility, and credibility of Full Sail University. This role is responsible for developing and executing comprehensive public relations strategies, managing media relationships, with a key focus on producing high-quality written content that supports institutional goals. The Public Relations Manager is a strong storyteller, skilled writer, strategic thinker, and a proactive relationship-builder with experience in higher education or mission-driven organizations. Must have a proven ability to manage the development, implementation, and execution of successful public relations strategy and campaigns.

***Positions are located on and worked from campus in Winter Park, Florida.***

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

Strategic Communications & Media Relations

  • Develop and implement public relations strategies that align with institutional priorities and brand positioning
  • Serve as one of the primary media contacts for the institution, building and maintaining strong relationships with local, regional, and national media outlets
  • Manage media requests in a timely and professional manner
  • Pitch stories, respond to media inquiries, and coordinate interviews with faculty, staff, alumni, and leadership
  • Proven track record of ability to garner press/media coverage
  • Support crisis communications in coordination with director & senior leadership as needed
  • Manage and organize large scale events including ribbon cuttings, grand openings, degree program launches, etc.
  • Oversee measurement of PR impact through regular reporting

Writing & Content Development

  • Demonstrate ability to create strong written content for advertorials, op-eds, byline articles, and keynote presentations
  • Demonstrate ability to draft, edit, and distribute compelling and newsworthy press releases, media advisories, talking points, and statements
  • Ensure messaging is accurate, compelling, and aligned with institutional voice and standards
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to identify newsworthy stories and achievements
  • Maintain editorial standards and ensure consistency across all external communications
  • Collaborate with partners on strategic joint announcements, case studies, white papers etc.

Advertising & Budget Management

  • Plan, execute, and manage paid advertising buys across print, digital, broadcast, and other media channels
  • Manage the public relations advertising budget, including vendor negotiations and performance tracking
  • Monitor campaign effectiveness and adjust strategies to maximize reach and return on investment

Awards, Rankings & Reputation Building

  • A primary function of this role is the overall management of strategic rankings, awards and accolades efforts on behalf of the university including seeking out new/relevant awards/rankings opportunities, managing completion of surveys/submissions, tracking results and amplifying positive results to internal and external stakeholders and audiences.
  • Identify, pursue, and manage submissions for institutional awards, rankings, and accolades
  • Manage and execute the gathering of data, narratives, and supporting materials to strengthen award applications
  • Track and report earned recognition and leverage them in external communications

Collaboration & Leadership

  • Partner with marketing, internal teams including but not limited to Full Sail's creative agency and academic departments to support institutional initiatives
  • Collaborate with Full Sail's Partners to execute strategic communications initiatives
  • Manage external vendors as needed
  • Stay current on higher education trends, media landscapes, and best practices in public relations

Other Responsibilities:

  • Adheres to the policies and procedures of Full Sail University
  • Maintains strict confidentiality of company and personnel information
  • Demonstrates a strong commitment to the mission and values of the organization
  • Adheres to company attendance standards
  • Performs other duties as assigned

Supervisory Responsibilities: No

Competencies:

  • Exceptional oral and written communication skills
  • Strategic thinking and sound judgment
  • Strong organizational and project management skills
  • Proven ability to prioritize tasks and manage time effectively with ability to manage multiple priorities under deadlines
  • Professional presence and discretion when working with senior leadership and media
  • Collaborative, proactive, and detail-oriented approach
  • Exceptional writing, editing, and proofreading skills with a demonstrated ability to tailor messaging to diverse audiences
  • Familiarity with higher education governance, culture, and academic environments
  • Self-starter
  • Possess a deep understanding of public relations, digital reputation management, and project/campaign management skills

Education and/or Experience:

  • Minimum of a Bachelor's degree in Public Relations, Communications, Journalism, Marketing, or a related field
  • Minimum of 5 to 7 years of progressively responsible experience in public relations, or corporate communications, preferably in higher education or a complex organization
  • Proven experience with media relations, press release distribution, and advertising buys
  • Experience managing budgets and measuring campaign effectiveness
  • Experience working with rankings organizations, award programs, or accolades-related communications

Certificates, Licenses, Registrations: n/a

Computer/Equipment Skills:

  • Proficient in Microsoft 356 (Word, Outlook, OneDrive, Excel) Keynote, Zoom
  • Exceptional working knowledge of a variety of public relations / project management programs: (ex. CisionOne, PR Newswire, Monday, Workfront, etc.)
  • Working knowledge of a variety of AI Platforms

Environmental Factors/Physical Demands:

Work is performed in an office environment. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to have the ability to maintain active customer and employee communication; access, input and retrieve information from the computer system; enter alphanumeric data into a computerized system often while listening on the telephone. (May be subject to bending, reaching, kneeling, stooping and lifting up to thirty (30) pounds.) Ability to work nights and weekends as needed.

Full Sail is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

JOB SUMMARY:

Provides engineering support and moderate system redesigns to enhance the reliability and operational performance of building environmental systems, including HVAC, humidity control, lighting, and building management systems across both guest-facing and back-of-house facilities. Evaluates the condition and performance of critical infrastructure such as chiller plants and boilers, and recommends appropriate maintenance strategies, repairs, replacements, and capital improvements. Responsibilities include troubleshooting, root cause analysis, system redesign, programming of building automation systems, and overseeing testing and commissioning of implemented solutions. All work is performed in compliance with applicable codes, regulations, and industry standards, including ASHRAE, ASME, ASTM, ANSI, NEC, and OSHA.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Conduct evaluations of existing and proposed building environmental systems to enhance reliability, occupant comfort, and operational efficiency. Perform energy audits and retro-commissioning of facilities to identify opportunities for performance improvement and cost reduction. Supporting asset management programs by evaluating mechanical systems performance, identifying lifecycle needs, and prioritizing capital investments to ensure reliability, efficiency, and long-term value across facilities.
  • Manage assigned projects from concept through completion, including scope development, budgeting, scheduling, construction oversight, system testing, and stakeholder training. Ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and aligned with operational goals.
  • Provide technical troubleshooting and diagnostic support for HVAC systems across the facility, serving as a subject matter expert (SME) for the Duty Engineer program and supporting first responder operations to ensure timely resolution of mechanical systems issues.
  • Interface with Facilities Supervisors, Managers, technicians, and internal departments to resolve operational challenges and coordinate engineering activities. Facilitate effective communication and alignment across teams.
  • Collaborate with vendors and equipment manufacturers to address design issues and resolve technical problems. Prepare and review equipment specifications and conduct evaluations of emerging technologies and services.
  • Perform engineering calculations to support design analysis and system improvements. Develop and modify building management system (BMS) code and program system controllers to optimize performance and functionality. Provide regular updates on project status and task progress to internal stakeholders. Maintain accurate records and documentation in Maximo or other asset management systems.
  • Understands and actively participates in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UO policy, procedures, training and team member involvement activities.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

EDUCATION:

  • Bachelors degree from a four-year college or university (ABET accredited) in Mechanical, Structural or Civil Engineering, with a focus on Utility, Facility, or Asset Management specialty, or related field, required
  • Masters degree in Mechanical Engineering, preferred
  • Registered Professional Engineer in the State of Florida, preferred

EXPERIENCE:

  • 7 years of progressive project engineering experience, including at least 5 years in project management within an engineering environment focused on the design, implementation, and optimization of building environmental systems, required
  • Minimum of 7 years of hands-on experience in building management control systems (BMCS), including system optimization and programming
  • Or an equivalent combination of education and experience, preferred

Your talent, skills and experience will be rewarded with a competitive compensation package.

Job.JobDescription:
JOB SUMMARY:

The Workplace Operations WFM Analyst serves as the primary workforce management subject matter expert responsible for forecasting, capacity planning, scheduling, real-time management, reporting, and workforce optimization across TechLine operations. The role will be managing the full WFM lifecycle for a complex, global support organization.

The Workforce Management Analyst will partner closely with Operations leadership, HR, Finance, and regional stakeholders to develop data-driven staffing strategies, optimize workforce utilization, and ensure service level commitments are consistently achieved.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Lead long-term forecasting, capacity planning, staffing models, and hiring recommendations for global operations in alignment with balancing forecasted business needs against labor costs.
  • Own workforce forecasting and capacity planning processes for a global 24x7 IT support operation.
  • Develop optimized schedules balancing service requirements, employee experience, labor efficiency, language support, and regional coverage requirements.
  • Create and maintain short-term and long-term workforce models using historical data, business trends, seasonality, and operational drivers.
  • Analyze service level performance, abandonment trends, occupancy, utilization, adherence, productivity, and staffing effectiveness.
  • Lead workforce optimization initiatives to increase efficiency, improve customer experience, and support organizational growth, while partnering with cross-functional teams on major business initiatives, operational changes, and workforce planning efforts, and developing training schedules to meet cross-functional development needs.
  • Produce recurring and ad hoc workforce reports, executive dashboards, and strategic recommendations. Monitors real-time schedule adherence and reports to Managers and Team leads.
  • Understand and actively participate in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UDX policy, procedures, training, and team member involvement activities.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities (KSAs) required.

  • Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  • Consistent attendance is a job requirement.

EDUCATION:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Business, Operations Management, Analytics, Mathematics, Information Systems, or related field preferred.

EXPERIENCE:

  • 4+ years of workforce management, capacity planning, forecasting, or workforce analytics experience.
  • Experience supporting medium to large contact centers, service desks, operations centers, or other 24x7 support environments.
  • Demonstrated expertise in forecasting methodologies, staffing models, scheduling, shrinkage planning, and real-time workforce management.
  • Advanced Excel skills including Pivot Tables, Power Query, complex formulas, scenario modeling, and data analysis.
  • Experience developing staffing recommendations and presenting workforce insights to operational and executive leadership
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to transform complex data into actionable business decisions.
  • Proven ability to work independently with minimal direction and manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Preferred:
    • Experience supporting global, multilingual, or geographically distributed operations.
    • Experience within IT Service Management (ITSM), Service Desk, Help Desk, Technical Support, or Contact Center environments.
    • Experience with workforce management platforms such as CommunityWFM, Zoom WFM, NICE/IEX, Verint, Calabrio, Amazon Connect WFM, Genesys, or similar solutions.
    • Experience creating workforce dashboards using Power BI, Tableau, or similar business intelligence platforms.
    • Working knowledge of ITIL principles and service operations.
    • Experience leading workforce planning projects, process improvement initiatives, or automation efforts.
    • ; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:

  • This role supports a 24x7 global operation and requires flexibility to support critical business needs outside standard business hours when necessary.
  • Occasional participation in cross-functional operational planning sessions and leadership reviews is required.
  • This position is expected to operate independently and provide strategic workforce management guidance with limited day-to-day supervision.

Your talent, skills and experience will be rewarded with a competitive compensation package.

Description

Comparion Insurance Agency, a Liberty Mutual company, is seeking a Regional Small Commercial Sales Manager to lead, coach, and grow a high-performing team of small commercial producers. In this role, youll drive regional sales, retention, and customer satisfaction by developing agents, strengthening carrier partnerships, and promoting excellence across sales and service. Youll also have the opportunity to help shape Comparions growing small commercial business while advancing your leadership career.

Territory and travel
This role supports the Southeast region, covering Tennessee, South Carolina, North Carolina, Georgia, Florida, Alabama, Arkansas, Kentucky, Mississippi, Virginia, and West Virginia. Youll recruit, onboard, coach, and support commercial sales professionals across the region and help drive commercial growth.

The position involves approximately 60% travel within the territory. Travel may include visits to team locations, recruiting events, agent or client meetings, carrier partners, and regional business or community events. Candidates should be comfortable with frequent regional travel.

We are seeking candidates based in Tennessee, South Carolina, North Carolina, Georgia, Florida, Alabama, Arkansas, Kentucky, Mississippi, Virginia, or West Virginia.

The successful candidate will be eligible to earn variable compensation of up to 50% of base salary in 2026, contingent upon achieving designated key performance measures.

Key responsibilities:

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of small commercial producers to meet or exceed new-business, retention, premium growth, and profitability goals.
  • Provide strategic guidance to expand and optimize the agency, identifying and evaluating new market and business opportunities
  • Support agents through the sales cycle: advise on policy types, effective coverage, renewals, policy changes, and complex submissions/renewals.
  • Drive new business development by coaching agents on lead follow-up, cross-selling, prospect cultivation, and referral strategies.
  • Act as a primary liaison among agents, clients, and internal teams to ensure clear communication and timely resolution of post-enrollment issues.
  • Maintain and strengthen carrier relationships in partnership with Relationship Managers to enhance product access and service.
  • Oversee local marketing and community networking initiatives to ensure strong market penetration.
  • Ensure high service levels (on-time renewals, prompt certificate issuance, timely responses to client inquiries) and instill accountability for SLAs across the team.
  • Recruit, staff, and manage personnel levels to align with business needs.
  • Monitor and analyze performance metrics (retention, premium growth, loss ratios, revenue per producer) to identify opportunities, trends, and obstacles; provide data-driven coaching and action plans.
  • Mentor, conduct performance reviews, and deliver ongoing feedback to support career development and goal attainment.
  • Stay current on small commercial industry trends, products, and regulatory changes affecting clients and carriers.

What we offer:

  • Competitive base salary with meaningful performance-based upside (variable compensation up to 50% of base salary).
  • Comprehensive benefits: medical, dental, vision; 401(k) with company match; paid time off
  • Eligibility for a company fleet vehicle for qualified employees
  • Professional development, ongoing training, and tuition assistance.
  • Employee assistance and wellness programs, employee discounts and other voluntary benefits.
  • Opportunity for career growth within Comparion and a collaborative, inclusive culture that values diverse perspectives.
  • A leadership role with visible impact, autonomy, and the ability to influence product, process and market strategy.
Qualifications
  • Bachelor`s degree or equivalent experience required.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of commercial lines products and services; proven success with prior sales or related experience required.
  • Must possess highly effective oral and written communication skills, including group and individual presentation, persuasion, negotiation and customer service skills.
  • Requires excellent organizational skills, effective time management, strong leadership, interpersonal and analytical skills.
  • Incumbents must have, or be able to secure, a current state license, in property, casualty and life insurance.
  • Prior supervisory experience helpful
About Us

Pay Philosophy: The typical starting salary range for this role is determined by a number of factors including skills, experience, education, certifications and location. The full salary range for this role reflects the competitive labor market value for all employees in these positions across the national market and provides an opportunity to progress as employees grow and develop within the role. Some roles at Liberty Mutual have a corresponding compensation plan which may include commission and/or bonus earnings at rates that vary based on multiple factors set forth in the compensation plan for the role.

In 2022, Comparion Insurance Agency was created to transition former Liberty Mutual exclusive agents to an agency that delivers a unique value proposition to carriers with over 2,000 agents in approximately 180 cities in 44 states. We offer customers 50 insurance companies with product breadth including auto, home, life, pet, renters, umbrella, jewelry and much more. We use our scale to deliver a first-rate customer experience through consultative insurance experts located in their communities.

Our Leadership team has over 200 years of cumulative insurance experience. At Comparion, we have a philosophy of staying close to our customers and agents, so sales leadership is located throughout the country in our larger storefronts. Comparion is owned and backed by Liberty Mutual Group, a Fortune 100 company, founded in 1912

Liberty Mutual is an equal opportunity employer. We will not tolerate discrimination on the basis of race, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, age, disability, veteran's status, pregnancy, genetic information or on any basis prohibited by federal, state or local law.
