Job.JobTitle: Casualty Claims Adjuster, Attorney Represented - Hybrid
Job.JobDescription:
Description

Advance your career with our Personal Lines Casualty Team!

Apply now to learn and grow with us.

The Casualty Claims Adjuster, Attorney Represented will investigate, manage and resolve Bodily Injury claims assigned directly with injured parties, as well as assist in providing service to policyholders.

All qualified applicants will reside within a 50-mile radius of our Lake Mary, FL and Suwanee, GA office.

The start date for the role is January 11, 2027.

Hybrid Work Arrangement: There may be several in-office days per month for the first few months following initial virtual training to support your learning and to build relationships with leaders and others in the department. This position requires a minimum of two days in office per month as the standard beyond the training period, with occasional additional days for special meetings a few times a year.


Training is a critical component to your success and that success starts with reliable attendance. Attendance and active engagement during training is mandatory.


In a high performing culture,WEin PL Core:

  • Strive to be better tomorrow than today; little improvements lead to big ones!
  • Embrace change.We may need to let go of what's familiar in order to embrace and try something new.
  • Understandhow our individual work contributes to our teams, our organizations and the company
  • Are adaptable and resilient. Change is imperative to being better tomorrow and resiliency allows us to handle unexpected challenges
  • Are an exporter of Talent.We maintain a focus on development and growth.
  • Contribute positively; We come to work every day with the intent to make a positive impact on our work and on everyone around us. One positive interaction with you can turn someone's day around.

Responsibilities:

  • Investigates and evaluates coverage, liability, damages, and settles Bodily Injury claims directly with injured parties, within prescribed authority levels.
  • Pursues proactive contact with injured parties through various creative means to connect, listen, empathize and make early settlement offers whenever appropriate to resolve injury claims.
  • Identifies potential suspicious claims and refers to SIU and identifies opportunities for third party subrogation.
  • Communicates with policyholders, witnesses, and claimants in order to gather information regarding claims; refers tasks to auxiliary resources as necessary and advises as to proper course of action. Sends and responds to various written, telephone and SMS text inquiries to pursue resolution of the claim.
  • Ensures adequacy of reserves.
  • Accountable for security of financial processing of claims, as well as security information contained in claims files.
  • Makes effective use of loss management tools and techniques to ensure accuracy in decision making.
  • Keeps files updated with clear documentation for ease in understanding the status of investigations, evaluations and negotiations throughout the claim life cycle.
Qualifications
  • Strong written and oral communication skills required.
  • Good interpersonal, analytical, investigative, and negotiation skills required.
  • Growth mindset; adapts well to change including new standard work and new tools
  • Basic knowledge of legal liability, general insurance policy coverage and State Tort Law preferred.
  • Liability experience or policy and claims knowledge preferred.
  • Bachelors degree preferred.
  • Ability to obtain proper licensing as required.
About Us

Pay Philosophy: The typical starting salary range for this role is determined by a number of factors including skills, experience, education, certifications and location. Job.JobTitle: Senior Casualty Claims Specialist, Attorney Represented - Southeast
Job.JobDescription:
Description

Advance Your Career with Liberty Mutuals

Personal Lines Casualty Team!

Our Casualty Attorney Represented team is currently hiring for Senior Claims Specialists to manage attorney represented and litigated auto and homeowner's bodily injury claims. This role will manage, investigate and resolve claims as well as assist in providing prompt and quality service to policyholders for mild to moderate severity and/or complexity claims.

Work Arrangement

Hybrid: Candidates who live within 50 miles of a Liberty Mutual Claims office are expected to work on-site at least two days per month.
Remote: Candidates who live more than 50 miles from a Liberty Mutual Claims office are eligible to work fully remote.

The start date for the role is January 11, 2027.

This position operates on an Eastern time schedule.

Responsibilities:

  • Manages, investigates, and resolves claims. Investigates and evaluates coverage, liability, damages, and settles claims within prescribed authority levels.
  • Identifies potential suspicious claims and refers to SIU and identifies opportunities for third party subrogation.
  • Prepares for and attends trials, hearings and conferences and reports to Home Office and local management on status.
  • Confers with trial counsel and prepares trial reports.
  • Communicates with policyholders, witnesses, and claimants in order to gather information regarding claims, refers tasks to auxiliary resources as necessary, and advise as to proper course of action.
  • Responds to various written and telephone inquiries including status reports.
  • Ensures adequacy of reserves.
  • Accountable for security of financial processing of claims, as well as security information contained in claims files.
  • Updates files and provides comprehensive reports as required.
  • Responsible for managing the practices and billing activities of outside and in-house counsel.
  • Training is a critical component to your success and that success starts with reliable attendance. Attendance and active engagement during training is mandatory.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 1+ years Personal Lines Third-Party Auto Casualty Experience.
  • 1+ years Attorney Represented Experience.
  • Experience handling Litigated Third-Party Auto Casualty Claims.
  • Experience handling Uninsured and Underinsured Motorist (UM/UIM) Claims.
Qualifications
  • Strong written and oral communications skills required.
  • Good interpersonal, analytical, investigative, and negotiation skills required.
  • Customer service experience preferred.
  • Demonstrated competency of legal liability, general insurance policy coverage and State Tort Law.
  • The capabilities, skills and knowledge required is normally acquired through a Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience and at least 12-18 months of directly related experience.
  • Ability to obtain proper licensing as required.

Applicants residing in Washington state, California, or the District of Columbia are not eligible at this time.

Job.JobTitle: Auto Claims Desk Adjuster Hybrid - Lake Mary, FL
Job.JobDescription:
Description

Launch Your Auto Claims Career with a Fortune 100 Company!

No Claims Experience Needed, Paid Training & Licensing Included!

Location: Orlando, FL
Applicants must live within 50 miles of the office.

  • Minimum 2 in-office days per month
  • Additional in-person training during the first 6 months
  • Start Date: January 11, 2027

Career Opportunity:

Do you thrive in a high-volume, fast-paced environment? Do you enjoy the challenge of a role where no two days are alike? We are looking for positive, high-energy, passionate customer service professionals. Qualities like these cannot be taught, but they can be sharpened, strengthened and appropriately compensated when you join Liberty Mutual Insurance as an Auto Claims Representative.

As a licensed claims adjuster, you will be fulfilling the promise we made to our customers when they purchased their policy by working with those who have been in an auto accident and need our help. In this role, you will guide our insureds and claimants through the auto claims process from start to finish. There are many moving pieces you will manage. You need to have strong organizational skills and be a time management expert, love problem solving and helping others. Your job is speaking to and engaging customers who have just been in an accident and need your help, this is where the passion for service comes into play. We strive to treat our customers as we would want to be treated!

Learn more about this role:A Day in the Life of an Auto-Physical Claims Adjuster

Youd be a great fit if you are:

An Empathetic Service Professional:When a claim is received, you skillfully pick up the phone and use your customer centricity and problem-solving skills to confidently assure our customers that you are there to guide them through the process.

A Front Lines Liaison:You rise to the role of representing the Liberty brand, you believe in delivering on our promise.

A Reliable Teammate:Whether you work at the office or from home, you adapt well to different environments, schedules and the varying needs of our customers.

A Customer-Centric Claims Representative:Integrity is in your nature. That means you sincerely care that customers get exactly what they paid for and need to embrace today and confidently pursue tomorrow.

Qualifications

Qualifications

  • An engaging, outgoing personality and passion for helping customers
  • Able to think critically, use resources and seek answers when needed in virtual environment
  • Excellent oral, written, decision-making and organizational skills
  • Strong typing and multi-tasking capabilities in a structured paperless work environment
  • Requires strong working knowledge and ability to utilize multiple systems during virtual training and to handle/process claims.
  • General understanding of overall claim operations and key stakeholders.
  • College degree preferred, and/or 1-3 years of related customer service experience or applicable insurance knowledge.
  • Only open to US based employees.

As part of the application process, you'll complete an assessment related to the skills needed for this role please allow approximately 35 minutes, although there is no time limit.

Launch Your Auto Claims Career with a Fortune 100 Company!

No Claims Experience Needed, Paid Training & Licensing Included!

Career Opportunity:

Do you thrive in a high-volume, fast-paced environment? Do you enjoy the challenge of a role where no two days are alike? We are looking for positive, high-energy, passionate customer service professionals. Qualities like these cannot be taught, but they can be sharpened, strengthened and appropriately compensated when you join Liberty Mutual Insurance as an Auto Claims Representative.

As a licensed claims adjuster, you will be fulfilling the promise we made to our customers when they purchased their policy by working with those who have been in an auto accident and need our help. In this role, you will guide our insureds and claimants through the auto claims process from start to finish. There are many moving pieces you will manage. You need to have strong organizational skills and be a time management expert, love problem solving and helping others. Your job is speaking to and engaging customers who have just been in an accident and need your help, this is where the passion for service comes into play. We strive to treat our customers as we would want to be treated!

Learn more about this role:A Day in the Life of an Auto-Physical Claims Adjuster

Youd be a great fit if you are:

An Empathetic Service Professional:When a claim is received, you skillfully pick up the phone and use your customer centricity and problem-solving skills to confidently assure our customers that you are there to guide them through the process.

A Front Lines Liaison:You rise to the role of representing the Liberty brand, you believe in delivering on our promise.

A Reliable Teammate:Whether you work at the office or from home, you adapt well to different environments, schedules and the varying needs of our customers.

A Customer-Centric Claims Representative:Integrity is in your nature. That means you sincerely care that customers get exactly what they paid for and need to embrace today and confidently pursue tomorrow.

Qualifications

Qualifications

  • An engaging, outgoing personality and passion for helping customers
  • Able to think critically, use resources and seek answers when needed in virtual environment
  • Excellent oral, written, decision-making and organizational skills
  • Strong typing and multi-tasking capabilities in a structured paperless work environment
  • Requires strong working knowledge and ability to utilize multiple systems during virtual training and to handle/process claims.
  • General understanding of overall claim operations and key stakeholders.
  • College degree preferred, and/or 1-3 years of related customer service experience or applicable insurance knowledge.
  • Only open to US based employees.

Job.JobTitle: US Senior Consultant, Customer Success, Deal Desk, & Pricing and Packaging Lead – Converge for Life Sciences_Products & Platforms
Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

The Team

The Innovation & Delivery Transformation (I&DT) team is building the future of Deloitte's business through new AI-native platforms and products. The team is responsible for identifying, nurturing, scaling, and winning in new markets through new capabilities. Rather than relying on what the firm has historically done, I&DT looks ahead and invests in areas where growth is expected three, five, and ten years into the future.

This role is aligned to the Converge for Life Sciences portfolio, Deloitte's AI-enabled platform portfolio for the modern life sciences enterprise. Converge by Deloitte combines proprietary data assets, advanced analytics, and AI-driven decision intelligence to help pharmaceutical, biotech, and medical product organizations accelerate the pace of discovery, development, and commercialization, while improving compliance and operational visibility across the enterprise.

Rather than being aligned to a single product, this role sits within the Converge for Life Sciences commercial operations function and supports deal structuring, contracting, and client success activities across the portfolio's full suite of software and AI-enabled offerings.

Position Summary

As the Senior Consultant for Customer Success, Deal Desk, and Pricing and Packaging, you will serve as the commercial engine behind the Converge for Life Sciences go-to-market motion. You will own the full lifecycle of software license transactions, including all software license order renewals, partner with commercial strategy to design creative and innovative pricing and packaging models for software, technology, and IP offerings, and help ensure clients realize ongoing value from the platforms they adopt. Working across Product, Engineering, Finance, Legal, Risk, and Sales leadership, you will bring commercial structure and discipline to a growing, multi-product portfolio.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/01/2026.

Work you'll do

Deal Desk, Contracting & License Renewals:

  • Own end-to-end management of all software license order renewals, ensuring accurate, on-time execution and continuity of client subscriptions across the portfolio.
  • Lead the full commercial contracting lifecycle: drafting offering summaries, securing internal approvals, engaging clients, drafting license agreements, routing risk and legal reviews, and executing signed agreements.
  • Build and maintain the commercial artifact(s) of record used to track deal status, payment milestones, and renewal timing across a staggered, multi-client portfolio.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for ad hoc contracting questions, coordinating with Legal/Risk on approvals so deals move cleanly from shaping through execution.

Pricing & Packaging Strategy:

  • Support the design of creative, innovative commercial models for new and existing software, technology, and IP offerings, including tiering structures, usage- and overage-based mechanics, margin targets, and contract exit terms.
  • Partner with Product Management to establish a consistent point in the product development lifecycle at which pricing and packaging work begins, so commercial readiness keeps pace with new product launches.
  • Build repeatable pricing frameworks and playbooks that scale as the software and AI-enabled product portfolio grows.
  • Evaluate and recommend licensing structures (e.g., subscription, consumption-based, transitional/migration licensing) that balance client adoption with long-term revenue durability.

Cross-Functional Commercial Alignment:

  • Act as the connective tissue across Finance, Legal/Risk, Product, and Leadership on commercial and contractual matters, ensuring the right stakeholders are engaged at the right time.
  • Partner with Finance on forecasting and cost modeling tied to commercial offerings, and support Legal/Risk in an advisory capacity on structural deal questions.
  • Identify and help resolve cross-functional commercial issues that don't have a natural owner, bringing structure and follow-through to ambiguous, multi-stakeholder situations.

Customer Success & Adoption:

  • Partner with Account, Product, and Practice teams to support client adoption, stakeholder engagement, and client-facing messaging once a product is live, without duplicating relationship-management work already owned by those teams.
  • Coordinate cross-functional resources, including practice expertise, product teams, and leadership, to resolve client-facing adoption issues and maintain a consistent client experience post-sale.
  • Monitor client health signals tied to commercial terms, such as renewal risk or usage against contracted tiers, and proactively flag concerns to the broader account team.

The successful candidate would possess these skills:

Cross-Functional Leadership & Collaboration:

  • Comfortable operating as both a leader and a connector across Sales, Product, Engineering, Finance, Legal/Risk, and Account teams.
  • Strong organizational and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage a staggered portfolio of concurrent deals, renewals, and client engagements at different stages simultaneously.
  • Clear, confident communicator, able to bring structure to ambiguous, multi-stakeholder situations without a predefined playbook.
  • Self-directed ownership mindset; comfortable being accountable for outcomes that span multiple functions with no single predefined owner.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience defined as an additional 4+ years of relevant work experience in lieu of a degree.
  • 4–6 years of combined experience in deal desk, commercial contracting, pricing and packaging, sales operations, or customer success roles, ideally within a SaaS or enterprise software environment.
  • Demonstrated experience owning end-to-end commercial contract lifecycles, including drafting, approvals, execution, and renewal tracking.
  • Experience designing or supporting pricing and packaging models for software, technology, or IP-based offerings (e.g., tiered, usage-based, or subscription licensing structures).
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience using commercial or contract-tracking tools to manage a portfolio of active deals.
  • Demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally across Finance, Legal, Product, and Sales/Account teams to move commercial work forward.
  • Ability to travel 20-25%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred:

  • Experience in life sciences technology environments (e.g., CRM, field engagement, patient services, R&D, supply chain, manufacturing, or market access).
  • Familiarity with software licensing and contracting norms in a SaaS or enterprise technology business, including subscription, consumption-based, and transitional licensing models.
  • Experience supporting or partnering with customer success functions on client adoption and stakeholder engagement for newly launched products.
  • Comfort engaging with Legal/Risk teams in an advisory capacity on structural deal questions (e.g., demo licensing, exit/refund terms).
  • Proficiency in commercial or product management tools (e.g., JIRA, Confluence, Salesforce, Aha!).

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $105,400 - $207,800.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

Deloitte is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for people with disabilities. If you require a reasonable accommodation to participate in the recruiting process, please direct your inquiries to the Global Call Center (GCC) at USTalentCICInbox@deloitte.com.

Recruiting tips

From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

Benefits

At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. We value our people and offer employees a broad range of benefits. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.

Our people and culture

Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas, and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients' most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.

Our purpose

Deloitte's purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities. Learn more.

Professional development

From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe there's always room to learn. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership opportunities and connect and grow through mentorship. From on-the-job learning experiences to formal development programs, our professionals have a variety of opportunities to continue to grow throughout their career.

Requisition code: 371042

Job ID371042

Position Summary

Our Deloitte Cyber team understands the unique challenges and opportunities businesses face in cybersecurity. Join our team to deliver powerful solutions to help our clients navigate the ever-changing threat landscape. Through powerful solutions and managed services that simplify complexity, we enable our clients to operate with resilience, grow with confidence, and proactively manage to secure success.

The Lead Product Engineer is the senior technical owner for one of Deloitte's product lines as a hands-on lead spanning across spacecraft hardware, embedded software, AI/ML, ground systems, and cyber operations. This role holds final technical authority over what ships and release readiness, while defining and evolving the system architecture, including how the Deloitte product integrates into new spacecraft buses and mission profiles, so it remains scalable, coherent, and strategically aligned across a growing set of host platforms and customer programs.

Work You'll Do

As a Lead Product Engineer on the Enterprise Security team, you will be responsible for…

  • Serving as the senior technical owner for a Deloitte product line across spacecraft hardware, embedded software, AI/ML, ground systems, and cyber operations.
  • Defining and evolving system architecture, integration patterns, and technical standards to support deployment across new spacecraft buses, mission profiles, and host platforms
  • Making release readiness decisions and owning final technical authority over product quality, system integrity, and what is approved for shipment
  • Leading technical tradeoff decisions for adaptation to unfamiliar bus architectures, interfaces, and orbital environments while maintaining schedule, performance, and mission outcomes.
  • Partnering with product, engineering, manufacturers, bus partners, and government and commercial customers to drive technical vision, delivery, and interoperability of Deloitte's products.
  • Lead integration engineering for each new host platform: define interface control documents (ICDs), adapt Silent Shield to mission-specific bus protocols (e.g., CAN, MIL-STD-1553, SpaceWire) and message structures, and manage the non-recurring engineering required to onboard a new bus, satellite manufacturer, or mission profile.
  • Lead multidisciplinary delivery across cyber, software, hardware, AI, and systems: unblock teams, ensure implementation consistency across bus types and mission profiles, and bridge research to production.
  • Translate compliance frameworks (NIST, CNSSP-12, ATO, STIGs as applicable) into executable delivery controls and compliance-ready designs, consistent across Deloitte-owned and customer-owned deployments.
  • Own system-level test strategy and execution, including FlatSat and hardware-in-the-loop (HWIL) integration testing, security validation, mission-readiness, and operational acceptance across host platforms; own system failures and root-cause resolution.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective technical written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Strong leadership skillset.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Strong technical acumen
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong grasp of security architecture.
  • Ability to lead and influence without direct authority.
  • Ability to meet deadlines

The Team

Deloitte's Government & Public Services (GPS) practice – our people, ideas, technology and outcomes – is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our Enterprise Security offering embeds security in all aspects of digital transformation by securing a client's technical backbone while enabling secure digital transformation. Includes security architecture, secure development and deployment, end-to-end cyber cloud capabilities, application security, and security for emerging technologies and connected products.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree

  • Active TS/SCI or SCI eligibility is required.

  • 8+ years of experience in product engineering, systems engineering, software engineering, or embedded systems engineering.

  • 8+ years of experience working in the space industry with a strong understanding of systems architecture.

  • 5+ years of experience with spacecraft systems, embedded software, cyber operations, ground systems, or artificial intelligence/machine learning-enabled products.

  • Proven leadership capabilities delivering complex, multidisciplinary cyber and/or space systems through production and operations.
  • Deep experience designing secure architecture across cloud, on-premises, hybrid, and space/embedded constraints, with strong systems-thinking and integration background (interfaces, bus protocols, constraints, failure modes).
  • Demonstrated experience integrating a payload, subsystem, or capability across multiple satellite bus architectures or host platforms, including interface definition (ICDs), non-recurring engineering, and acceptance testing with external manufacturers or bus partners.
  • Experience defining system architecture and technical requirements for integrated hardware and software products.
  • Experience supporting technical integration with external partners, manufacturers, or customers
  • Experience operating under compliance constraints (NIST, ATO, STIGs, as applicable) and translating them into executable delivery controls and compliance-ready designs.
  • Expertise in Cyber Governance and Policies and Product Management.
  • Ability to travel 10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred:

  • Master's degree or PHD in engineering, computer science, cybersecurity, or a related technical field.
  • Cyber technical skillset.
  • Experience with satellite mission operations, telemetry/tracking/command (TT&C), or aerospace delivery environments.
  • Background in embedded systems integration across multiple bus protocols (CAN bus, MIL-STD-1553, SpaceWire, real-time protocols).
  • Experience working with satellite manufacturers or bus partners on payload integration, radiation qualification, or SWaP-constrained design.
  • Familiarity with AI/ML model deployment pipelines in constrained environments (e.g., ONNX).
  • Background in SPARTA (Space Attack Research and Tactic Analysis) threat frameworks.
  • Working fluency across the platform tech stack, enough to guide design decisions in each domain: embedded/space (C, POSIX, CAN bus, real-time OS); AI/ML (Python, ONNX, PyTorch, Isolation Forest, autoencoders); ground segment (Docker, Grafana, MQTT, Node.js); CI/CD and DevOps (GitHub Actions, automated security scanning, containerized deployments, Prometheus, Fluent Bit).

Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

Our Deloitte AI & Engineering team works to transform technology platforms, drive innovation, and help make a significant impact on our clients' success. You'll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and reengineering operations and processes that are critical to businesses. Your contributions can help clients improve financial performance, accelerate new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation.

Work you'll do

As a Delivery Consultant, Data Engineering and Conversion Solutions on the AI & Data team, you will be responsible for…

  • Designing, developing, and supporting data pipelines, conversion processes, and integration workflows across client systems
  • Performing data mapping, transformation, validation, and reconciliation activities to support conversion and migration requirements
  • Collaborating with cross-functional teams to analyze source and target data structures, document technical requirements, and resolve data issues
  • Developing and executing unit tests, supporting defect triage, and maintaining documentation for data engineering and conversion deliverables
  • Contributing to project delivery by supporting sprint activities, status reporting, and implementation tasks across the data lifecycle

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines

The team

Deloitte's Government & Public Services (GPS) practice - our people, ideas, technology and outcomes - is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our AI & Data offering provides a full spectrum of solutions for designing, developing, and operating cutting-edge Data and AI platforms, products, insights, and services. Our offerings help clients innovate, enhance and operate their data, AI, and analytics capabilities, ensuring they can mature and scale effectively.

This opportunity sits within our Deloitte US Delivery Center model, which is dedicated to driving impactful business services. It leverages Deloitte's scale and talent, as well as a center delivery model to provide high-quality, cost-effective service with standardized processes and procedures to service businesses across Deloitte.

The Deloitte US Delivery Center has a small-business feel with a big-business impact. With the resources of Deloitte and a community feel, the delivery center model provides high-quality services to our clients. USDC professionals work out of one of our specific delivery center locations, and each location presents dynamic career opportunities for professionals to focus on their work with nominal travel requirements.

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Information Systems, Mathematics, or Statistics
  • 4+ years of experience with Python, machine learning, artificial intelligence (AI) testing, data testing, and AI agent development or implementation
  • 3+ years of experience designing, developing, and supporting data pipelines, data integration workflows, data conversion solutions, SQL, data analysis, and data mapping
  • Experience with data validation, reconciliation, defect resolution, and implementation support for migration or conversion activities
  • Ability to obtain a Public Trust clearance
  • You must reside within a commutable distance of your assigned office with the ability to commute daily, if required, without the need for overnight accommodations.

  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

  • Experience with ETL tools, data warehousing platforms, or lakehouse technologies
  • Experience working in Agile delivery environments
  • Experience creating technical documentation, source-to-target mappings, and test evidence for project deliverables
  • Experience with risk modeling and predictive modeling

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead a wide variety of strategic, operational, technical, and non-technical initiatives across Oracle Health Support/AMS, from initial problem definition through implementation and sustained results.

  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex, cross-functional initiatives without relying solely on formal authority.
  • Experience with process improvement, operational assessments, quality programs, auditing, governance, or continuous improvement.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to move from identifying a problem to determining root cause, recommending solutions, and driving implementation.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and initiatives simultaneously while maintaining attention to detail and accountability for outcomes.
  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity and creating structure where processes, requirements, or solutions may not yet be clearly defined.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with senior leaders, technical teams, operational teams, and subject matter experts.
  • A proactive, ownership-oriented mindset with a demonstrated ability to identify opportunities and drive work forward without requiring extensive direction.

Job.JobTitle: Sr Specialist - Security Analytics & Operations - IAM
Job.JobDescription:
Your opportunity


At Schwab, you're empowered to make an impact on your career. Here, innovative thought meets creative problem solving, helping us challenge the status quo and transform the finance industry together. We believe in the importance of in-office collaboration and fully intend for the selected candidate for this role to work on site in the specified location(s).

The Senior IAM Control Sustainability and Assurance Specialist will strengthen the long-term effectiveness, resilience, and audit readiness of controls across Schwab's Identity and Access Management program. You will translate audit, regulatory, policy, and standards-based requirements into practical control and evidence expectations while independently assessing control design, execution, and operating effectiveness.

In this role, you will partner with control owners, technical teams, auditors, and leaders to identify risks, evaluate evidence quality, recommend corrective actions, and monitor remediation. You will help establish repeatable procedures, validation checks, health indicators, and assurance practices that improve consistency and identify control degradation early.

Your work will also advance automation and process improvements across IAM control and audit workflows, reducing manual effort and strengthening accuracy, traceability, and resilience. Success requires sound judgment, thoughtful challenge, clear communication, and the ability to adapt priorities based on risk and business needs.

What you have


Required Qualifications

  • 4+ years of experience in Identity and Access Management, technology risk, control assurance, control sustainability, audit, compliance, or a related discipline
  • Demonstrated knowledge of risk and control concepts, control design, operating effectiveness, evidence sufficiency, assurance testing, and issue remediation
  • Working knowledge of identity lifecycle management, access provisioning and deprovisioning, periodic access certifications, exception management, and remediation processes
  • Experience improving processes through workflow design, reporting, scripting, orchestration, analytics, or other automation capabilities
  • Ability to analyze complex requirements, ask effective challenge questions, and provide clear recommendations to technical, audit, regulatory, control, and leadership stakeholders
  • Strong judgment, attention to detail, ownership, and ability to manage multiple priorities in a deadline-driven environment
  • Ability to work independently and proactively with minimal guidance
  • Bachelor's degree

Preferred Qualifications

  • CISSP, CISA, CISM, CRISC, or an equivalent certification
  • 3+ years of experience in technology risk, supervision and controls, compliance, or audit
  • 2+ years of experience in financial services
  • Knowledge of NIST, ISO, FFIEC, GLBA, PCI, or related risk, regulatory, and industry requirements
  • Experience using governance, risk, and compliance or workflow platforms such as IBM OpenPages or RSA Archer

Job.JobTitle: Sr. Manager, Business Unit Risk, Product Governance
Job.JobDescription:
Your opportunity


At Schwab, you're empowered to make an impact on your career. Here, innovative thought meets creative problem solving, helping us “challenge the status quo” and transform the finance industry together.

The Wealth and Product Risk & Governance team supports the Wealth Advisory, Banking & Trust Services business in understanding and executing its responsibilities across key risk programs. Within this organization, the Governance and Business Operations team strengthens governance practices through forums, metrics and reporting, product governance, and disclosure management.

As Sr. Manager, Business Unit Risk, Product Governance, you will play a critical role in supporting Schwab Wealth Advisory and strategic initiatives designed to enhance capabilities and experiences for Ultra High Net Worth clients. You will guide product and offer teams through risk assessment and product review obligations across the pre-launch, launch, and post-implementation lifecycle, helping the business grow while managing risk thoughtfully and effectively.

This is an opportunity to become a trusted advisor in product governance, influence risk-based decisions, and collaborate with business, risk, compliance, legal, and governance partners. You will join a team that leads with integrity and service, succeeds together as One Schwab, and empowers employees to own their tomorrow through meaningful work, continuous learning, and broad exposure to strategic initiatives.

What you'll do

  • Facilitate risk assessment processes to identify, assess, and mitigate risks associated with product launches, modifications, and ongoing operations.
  • Guide product and offer teams on risk identification, approval requirements, and governance considerations throughout the product lifecycle.
  • Support the development of mitigants and metrics that address new or evolving risks associated with product launches or modifications.
  • Engage partners across Wealth Advisory Risk & Governance to evaluate potential impacts to risk programs, including conflicts of interest, disclosures, policies, and supervision practices.
  • Establish and maintain roadmaps and timelines for required approvals and governance forum appearances.
  • Consult on and help prepare clear, decision-ready materials for governance forums.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert and trusted advisor on the product review process, including pre-launch, launch, and post-launch obligations.
  • Build strong partnerships with business leaders and stakeholders involved in the Product Review Process to support a collaborative and effective governance approach.
  • Support product review reporting and governance updates for leadership.
  • Help implement processes and practices that improve operational efficiency and strengthen the product review experience.
  • Design and develop practical, business-guided resources for Wealth Advisory Services.
  • Execute risk or regulatory projects, as needed, through partnership with internal stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional partners to improve the product review process and support other product- or governance-related initiatives.

Location & Work Arrangement: This hybrid role requires four days per week in the office and one remote workday. This position is only available in Westlake (DFW), TX; Austin, TX; and Orlando, FL and candidates must reside in, or be willing to relocate on their own to one of the listed locations.

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis without employer sponsorship.

In addition to the salary range, this role is also eligible for bonus or incentive opportunities.

What you have


To ensure that we fulfill our promise of “challenging the status quo,” this role has specific qualifications that successful candidates should have.

Required qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in product governance, risk management, or compliance, preferably within a diversified financial services environment.
  • Experience applying enterprise risk frameworks and risk management practices related to risk identification, assessment, response, measurement, monitoring, and reporting.
  • Experience facilitating product risk assessments and guiding stakeholders through governance or approval processes.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to identify risks, assess business impact, and recommend practical mitigation strategies.
  • Experience preparing governance reports, risk assessments, and executive-level presentations.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, facilitation, organization, and project management skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to engage senior stakeholders and collaborate effectively across business, risk, compliance, legal, and governance teams.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience with risk identification, measurement, monitoring, and reporting for financial products and offers.
  • Knowledge of regulatory developments affecting financial products.
  • Understanding of product governance frameworks, industry standards, and best practices.
  • Knowledge of retail, advisory, brokerage, banking, or trust products and services.
  • Experience structuring and facilitating governance forums, developing agendas and content, tracking action items, and driving accountability and decisions.
  • Ability to translate data into actionable insights using effective charts, graphs, and visual storytelling techniques.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, Excel, and Outlook.

What's in it for you

At Schwab, you're empowered to shape your future. We champion your growth through meaningful work, continuous learning, and a culture of trust and collaboration—so you can build the skills to make a lasting impact. Job.JobTitle: Cyber Identity - PlainID/PBAC Engineering Manager II
Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

Our Deloitte Cyber team understands the unique challenges and opportunities businesses face in cybersecurity. Join our team to deliver powerful solutions to help our clients navigate the ever-changing threat landscape. Through powerful solutions and managed services that simplify complexity, we enable our clients to operate with resilience, grow with confidence, and proactively manage to secure success.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/31/2026.

Position Summary
As an experienced PlainID professional at Deloitte Consulting, you will be responsible for delivering high-quality work products within defined timelines while providing delivery and technical leadership to the PBAC engagement team who delivers the PBAC/ABAC authorization tools including PlainID. This role combines deep technical ownership with engineering expertise, governance, and stakeholder management.

Work you'll do

As a PlainID professional, you will:

  • Configure and implement the PlainID Authorization Platform within client environments, including policy modelling and decision-point/information-point setup.
  • Lead technical discussions with Enterprise architects and IAM stake holders.
  • Lead a PBAC team for successful and seamless delivery.
  • Design fine-grained, attribute-based access policies (PBAC/ABAC) that translate business rules into technical controls, including row- and column-level data access restrictions where needed.
  • Integrate PlainID with client identity providers (Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, Ping Identity, ForgeRock), API gateways, microservices, and data platforms such as Snowflake or Big Query.
  • Support the full policy lifecycle — authoring, testing, versioning, and deployment — using PlainID's visual policy modeling and policy-as-code capabilities.
  • Run requirements sessions with client stakeholders to document current-state access patterns and design the target-state authorization model.
  • Troubleshoot policy conflicts, integration issues, and authorization-decision errors across the client's technology stack.
  • Lead the testing, validation, and go-live activities, including access-decision auditing and performance checks.
  • Lead the team to produce clear technical documentation — policy catalogs, integration diagrams, runbooks — for both the client and the internal delivery team.
  • Partner with engagement leads and architects to keep delivery on track and surface risks early.
  • Stay current on PlainID's platform roadmap, including emerging capabilities for AI agent and machine-identity authorization.
  • Lead the team to establish and maintain runbooks, SOPs, knowledge articles, and documentation standards for repeatable and governed support operations.
  • Lead the conversation with client stakeholders, internal teams, and third-party vendors to resolve defects, manage dependencies, and improve service outcomes.

The Team

Enables trust and safety of online communications and digital products, protecting users, consumers, and patients from harm. Enables clients to provide consumer confidence in knowing with whom they are dealing and ensuring the integrity of access to data.

Qualifications

Required:

• 7+ years of total experience, including strong hands-on experience in PlainID and access management implementation.

• 3+ years with access control models — specifically PBAC — and how each maps to real enterprise use cases.

• 3+ years of experience integrating and supporting complex integrations and connectors for PIP integration.

• Must have strong knowledge of ensuring compliance with internal and external regulations, including SOX, GDPR, and ISO standards.

• Experience integrating with identity providers and standard protocols: OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SAML, JWT.

• Comfort with policy-as-code concepts and reading/writing structured policy logic (e.g., Rego or similar rules-based languages).

• Working knowledge of APIs and microservices architectures, plus experience with at least one API gateway (Apigee, Kong, Azure API Management, or similar).

• Proven ownership of CAB/change governance, release management, and stakeholder management.

• Advanced troubleshooting capability with strong knowledge of PlainID integration.

  • Ability to travel 25–50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred:

Your opportunity


Your Opportunity

At Schwab, you're empowered to make an impact on your career. Here, innovative thought meets creative problem solving, helping us challenge the status quo and transform the finance industry together. We believe in the importance of in-office collaboration and fully intend for the selected candidate for this role to work on site in the specified location(s).

As a Senior Application Security Engineer focused on AI security, you will help protect Schwab's predictive, generative, and agentic AI capabilities throughout the software development lifecycle. You will design scalable security standards, architectures, testing capabilities, monitoring solutions, and guardrails that strengthen AI-enabled applications, models, APIs, and software supply chains.

Working across development, architecture, platform engineering, and security teams, you will assess emerging threats, evaluate risk, and translate complex findings into practical security solutions. Your problem-solving, adaptability, and cross-functional collaboration will enable teams to make informed decisions, remediate vulnerabilities, and build secure AI capabilities at scale. This role offers the opportunity to advance Schwab's AI security practices while expanding your expertise in emerging technologies, automation, and modern application protection.

What you have


Required qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in application security, security engineering, software engineering, or a related cybersecurity discipline
  • Experience implementing and governing secure Software Development Life Cycle practices
  • Experience with application security, API security, authentication and authorization, threat modeling, vulnerability management, and software supply chain security
  • Experience with cloud platforms, continuous integration and continuous delivery pipelines, automation, and modern application architecture
  • Proficiency in Python, Java, C#, Go, JavaScript, or another programming language

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience securing Generative AI, Large Language Models, Agentic AI platforms, or machine learning systems
  • Experience performing penetration testing on web, mobile, and thick client applications.
  • Experience working with LLMs to create agents, create AI harnesses, and solve business problems.
  • Knowledge of prompt injections, model abuse, model poisoning, data leakage, excessive agency, and related AI threats
  • Familiarity with the OWASP Top 10 for Large Language Model Applications, NIST AI Risk Management Framework, or MITRE ATLAS
  • Experience with security testing, observability, and production monitoring
  • Ability to evaluate complex risks, make sound decisions, and develop scalable solutions
  • Ability to communicate technical risks and collaborate across development, architecture, platform engineering, and security teams
  • CISSP, CSSLP, cloud security, AI security, or another relevant industry certification

In addition to the salary range, this role is eligible for bonus or incentive opportunities.


What's in it for you

At Schwab, you're empowered to shape your future. We champion your growth through meaningful work, continuous learning, and a culture of trust and collaboration—so you can build the skills to make a lasting impact. Our Hybrid Work and Flexibility approach balances our ongoing commitment to workplace flexibility, serving our clients, and our strong belief in the value of being together in person on a regular basis.

We offer a competitive benefits package that takes care of the whole you – both today and in the future:

  • 401(k) with company match and Employee stock purchase plan
  • Paid time for vacation, volunteering, and 28-day sabbatical after every 5 years of service for eligible positions
  • Paid parental leave and family building benefits
  • Tuition reimbursement
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance

Job.JobTitle: Assistant Chief Engineer - Embassy Suites by Hilton Orlando LBV South
Job.JobDescription:
Scope of Position

The Assistant Chief Engineer plays a vital role in ensuring the functionality, safety, and efficiency of our facilities. He/she is responsible for the ongoing maintenance, projects, repair, and preventative maintenance of the hotel with a focus on improving efficiency, profitability, and service levels.

Position Requirements

  • Minimum 3 years of progressive management experience in a hotel preferred.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in hotel/building services or other appropriate engineering fields.
  • Knowledge of carpentry, plumbing, and electrical, is required.
  • Knowledge of hotel fire standards and procedures.
  • Knowledge on water treatment, hydraulics, mechanics, chillers, air flows, H.V.A.C., electronics, sound, TV, lighting, elevators, boilers, pumps, etc.
  • Ability to work independently and exercise judgment to resolve personnel and production concerns that arise, with minimal supervision.
  • Possess outstanding guest service skills and leadership capability.
  • Ability to operate a motor vehicle.

Responsibilities

  • Supervises the day-to-day operations of Engineering.
  • Maintains and operates equipment at optimum effectiveness, efficiency, and safety.
  • Assist the staff and management in handling requests for service calls, evaluating requests, and dispatching appropriate staff and contractors.
  • Assists in effectively planning, scheduling, and evaluating preventative maintenance programs.
  • Ensures compliance with all Engineering departmental policies, standards, and procedures.
  • Manages department's controllable expenses to achieve or exceed budgeted goals.
  • Participate in the procurement and management of engineering supplies, parts, and equipment.
  • Inspect and evaluate the physical condition of facilities to determine the type of work required.
  • Recommend or arrange for additional services such as painting, repair work, renovations, and the replacement of furnishings and equipment.
  • Knowledge of Safety Data Sheets, product labeling, proper storing, and handling of materials.
  • Follows Occupational Health & Safety regulations.
  • Ensure all daily standup meetings are conducted.
  • Actively participate in training and continuing education of Engineering staff.
  • Ensure Associates receive ongoing training to understand their job tasks and guest expectations.
  • Assist in recruiting, interviewing, and hiring Associates; conduct performance appraisals, coach and counsel, progressive corrective action, motivate, develop, and train.
  • Supervises associate's ability to execute departmental and property emergency procedures.
  • Perform any other reasonable duties as required by management.

Education

  • High school diploma or GED; 2 years' experience in engineering and maintenance or related professional area; experience in HVAC-R/electrical/plumbing.

Skills and Abilities

  • Ability to communicate in the English language. Second language is a plus.
  • Must be a team player.
  • Able to work flexible schedules including holidays and weekends and able to perform multiple tasks.
  • Experience using software programs such as Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, and Outlook).
  • Able to work with and understand financial information and data, and basic arithmetic functions.

Physical Requirements

  • Must be able to work in a fast-paced environment.
  • Must be physically fit to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects and push carts weighing 50 pounds or more.
  • Requires standing/walking/reaching and bending throughout shift.

JOB OVERVIEW

This position conducts audit, advisory and consulting services that provide assurance on critical Company enterprise risks. It executes Internal Audit's engagement activities over financial reporting/SOX 404 processes utilized to prepare Darden's consolidated financial statements and/or operational processes that relate directly to the Company's strategic priorities and enterprise risks. Audit and or consulting coverage includes various financial reporting, Company/functional policies and procedures, operational, vendor, compliance, fraud, and governance-related matters.

ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

- Perform financial audits of Darden business functions to assess compliance with technical accounting and financial reporting guidance, Company/functional policies and procedures, and other regulatory requirements, including SOX and PCAOB standards

- Perform operational, vendor, compliance, fraud and governance-related audits and advisory services

- Utilize a risk-based approach to set the scope engagements that considers cross-functional input and leverage of second lines of defense

- Help develop and execute test plans that assess the design and operating effectiveness of controls needed to address operational/compliance objectives and/or internal controls over financial reporting guidance

- Work collaboratively and cross-functionally to identify enterprise opportunities, process mapping and other improvement recommendations that drive value for the business function

- Provide audit and liaison assistance to independent auditors in the performance of their external audits of Darden's financial statements (e.g., integrated audit, employee benefit plan audits, etc.)

- Research technical accounting or regulatory guidance as needed

- Ensure the nature, extent and timing of audit procedures allows for effective and efficient audit of assigned areas, including leveraging technology, data analytics and continuous audit techniques where appropriate

- Prepare audit work papers, final reports and other deliverables in accordance with relevant audit standards

- Assist in communicating engagement results/recommendations to management, independent auditors, vendors, etc.

- Tailor communications and engagement findings/recommendations to various audiences

- Evaluate the adequacy of management action plans needed to address engagement recommendations and follow up regularly with action item owners to help ensure eventual remediation

- Prepare financial reporting-related materials for Disclosure Committee purposes members

- Support Darden ERM facilitation activities designed to proactively identify and respond to evolving enterprise risks/opportunities

- Help prepare and/or coordinate Audit Committee meeting materials for distribution to Audit Committee and senior management

- Provide thought leadership and personal development for team and business partners

- Utilize appropriate benchmarking, technology and similar tools (such as continuous auditing, data analytics, sampling and audit management software, etc.) that enhance the audit efficiency and effectiveness of the Internal Audit function

- Use technology (continuous auditing, analytics, RPA, TeamMate, etc.) to enhance the effectiveness of the Internal Audit function

- Participate in periodic Internal Audit function quality assessment and improvement initiatives

- As necessary, travel domestically/internationally to perform/lead select engagement projects (expected to be less than four weeks per year)

REQUIRED TECHNICAL SKILLS

- Certified Public Accountant

- Minimum of three (3) to four (4) years in public accounting and auditing, consulting or equivalent experience

- Experience in executing and documenting audit work associated with SOX/operational audit objectives

- Proven financial, analytical and risk assessment skills

REQUIRED EDUCATION

- Bachelor's in Accounting, Finance, or Business Administration (or related field)

OTHER KEY QUALIFICATIONS

- Self-starter, with good organizational skills

- Strong project management, agile thinking and self-leadership skills

- Ability to work independently and produce accurate, descriptive and timely results

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills

- Strong interpersonal, facilitation and consulting skills necessary to challenge the status quo

- Demonstrated flexibility and teamwork capabilities

- Strong documentation and executive report writing/presentation skills that drive strategic insights

- Critical thinking capacity, specifically with consideration to internal controls and their application to business processes and risk assessments

- Ability to work on multiple projects simultaneously and manage competing priorities

- Strong Microsoft Office skills

- Experience in developing and executing data sampling and analysis strategies

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

- CIA, CFE and/or similar certifications

- Master's in Accounting, Finance, Engineering or Business Administration (or related field), a plus

- Proficiency in TeamMate, Oracle, PeopleSoft, MicroStrategy Business Intelligence, Hyperion, and Discoverer applications, as well as data retrieval, sampling and analysis tools a plus

- Restaurant, hospitality, and retail industry auditing experience a plus

- Experience applying emerging technology/tools (such as GenAI) to enhance audit efficiency, process improvement, analysis, and reporting, a plus

POSITION SUMMARY

Our jobs aren't just about mixing drinks. Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique. Our bartenders have the basics down, but are constantly on the look-out for new trends, micro-local offerings, and guests' evolving needs. They are not just a beverage enthusiast, but also the host of the space. Their role goes beyond the bar itself to take ownership of guest service more broadly and do what needs to be done. JOB SUMMARY:

Manage all sales enablement projects lifecycle, including scoping projects and timelines, and facilitating the execution of tactics and deployments. Facilitate consistent communication among all stakeholders including Brand, Trade Marketing, Legal, IP Management, Comms Planning, and others as applicable, assuring the on-time deployment of launches, announcements and programs to ensure they remain on-budget, on-time and on-quality (tactical).

The Project Manager works closely with creative and business resources (including vendors/contractors) assigned to their projects, managing them within scope, as well as assuring their elements are executed on-quality (tactical) and on-time in support of the overarching program deliverables. An effective problem solver on a day-to-day basis, the Project Manager must be adept at anticipating problems and recognizing opportunities to realize efficiencies and minimize scope creep.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • UPC, Training, and Youth Project Lifecycle Management
    • Leads Project kickoff, presenting key deliverables, objectives, budget, and timelines
    • Monitors project schedules daily, flagging any bottlenecks and identifying project scope creep
    • Manages and updates project work using Planner or other MS365 PM application
    • Identifies and proactively resolves any deliverables that might fall behind schedule
    • Manages tactical quality of deliverables (specs for UPC and LMS, program presentation needs for YP)
    • Ensures thorough documentation of progress and final files
  • Project/Program Administration
    • Responsible for the consistent successful facilitation of project(s) from estimation through launch and maintenance
    • Manages all projects on-quality (tactical), on-time and on-budget
  • Brand Management
    • Ensures all projects are accurately represented in WorkFront and necessary changes are made based on internal partner feedback.
    • Supports the deployments for UPC, training, and youth to ensure deliverables are launched on time and on brand.
  • Deliverable Management
    • Alert Director team of any potential concerns or issues with meeting key deliverables due to resourcing.
    • Monitor day to day project activities.
    • Contribute to weekly meetings with direct working team to discuss all active projects, potential risks as well as to stay informed of potential issues such as resource and change control matters.
    • Facilitates estimate requests and confirmation of vendor(s) selection and final production schedules with the Director
  • Understand and actively participate in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UO policy, procedures, training, and team member involvement activities.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities (KSAs) required.

  • Candidate must be proficient in Microsoft Office Suite programs, including but not limited to Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint.
  • Strong understanding and proven experience with creative workflows for video & digital production required.
  • Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  • Consistent attendance is a job requirement.

Job.JobDescription:
JOB SUMMARY:

The Program Manager has overall responsibility for the successful planning and execution of complex attraction technology and sustainment initiatives. This role requires an understanding of attraction systems, including emerging platforms such as guest interface systems, gaming systems, facial recognition, machine vision, and AI applications. The Program Manager collaborates with Engineering, Maintenance, Creative, Attraction Technology, business partners, and external vendors to define scope, coordinate resources, manage project information, and support successful program execution in alignment with approved schedules, budgets, quality standards, and business objectives.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Lead the planning and execution of projects for complex attraction systems. Drive innovation through integration of emerging technologies such as guest interface systems, gaming platforms, facial recognition, machine vision, and AI applications. Collaborate cross-functionally with internal teams and external vendors to conduct comprehensive ride system assessments, including obsolescence studies and prioritized recommendations. Oversee project implementation schedules, ensuring alignment with deliverables, budgets, and deadlines. Facilitate stakeholder engagement and subject matter expert input to define scope, develop roadmaps, and maintain timeline integrity. Navigate and resolve conflicting feedback to achieve consensus and maintain project momentum. Ensure sustainment projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to established quality standards, while maintaining alignment across leadership and partner teams.
  • Lead or actively participate in project kickoffs, presenting key deliverables, initial specifications, timelines, and budget frameworks. Oversee and manage assigned capital projects related to technical systems, ensuring alignment with budget estimates, cash flow forecasts, and milestone commitments. Conduct regular reviews with project managers to assess risks, track progress, and ensure achievement of quarterly targets. Collaborate with Finance and leadership to communicate budget changes and secure necessary approvals. Maintain accountability for staying within agreed-upon budgets, proactively informing stakeholders of any changes to scope, assumptions, or emerging issues. Monitor project budgets and schedules daily, manage work-back schedules, and process all project change orders. Identify and resolve potential delays or compliance risks, ensuring tactical quality across all client partner deliverables and facilitating smooth handoffs from vendors.
  • Drive effective communication and informed decision-making by developing and maintaining detailed project plans that promote awareness while preserving project scope. Facilitate cross-functional collaboration across Engineering, IT, Creative, Ride & Show, and Operations teams to ensure strategic alignment and seamless execution. Prepare and deliver program status updates and strategic recommendations to senior leadership, ensuring transparency and accountability. Document all project opportunities with comprehensive scope definitions, visuals, and technical specifications.
  • Understand and actively participate in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UDX policy, procedures, training, and team member involvement activities.
  • Support broader team initiatives by performing additional duties as assigned.

EDUCATION:

  • Bachelors degree in Technology, Themed Entertainment, Film, Interactive & Games, Technical Theater, Engineering or Business Management is preferred
  • Or equivalent education and experience

EXPERIENCE:

  • 5+ years of experience working in theme park and resort projects
  • Experience dealing with large scale technology projects along with experience in estimating, budgeting, and bidding
  • Field experience dealing with all aspects of theme park and resort development and sustainment projects

Your talent, skills and experience will be rewarded with a competitive compensation package.

JOB SUMMARY:

Composite Technicians are responsible for fabricating and repairing fiberglass and carbon fiber items. This includes designed modifications, both structural and cosmetic of ride vehicles, show figures and other props and products as directed by both Engineering and Management directives. This position is detailed orientated and involves crafting, cutting, trimming, sanding, assembly, vacuum bagging among other operations involved in the successful production of composite materials. It is essential to have a complete understanding of Lay Up Charts, drawings, blueprints, and engineered speciations to insure the quality and structural integrity of parts that are being repaired and manufactured.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Performs structural and cosmetic fiberglass and carbon fiber repairs to ride vehicles which may include direction of Management, Quality Control and the engineering group. Suggests optional procedures for repairs on new and damaged parts and implements changes as needed or directed.
  • Performs structural and cosmetic fiberglass and carbon fiber repairs to a variety of props, show figures and miscellaneous animation parts. Determines type of resin and catalyst and accurately measures predetermined amounts required for saturation and adhesion of material for the application.
  • Selects precut layers of mat, cloth, carbon fiber and wood bracing if required for projects being repaired or manufactured.
  • Applies multiple layers of mat / fiber to surfaces assuring adhesion and repeating the process until the desired thickness, contour and strength is achieved.
  • Performs gel coating as needed on ride vehicles, props, materials, and miscellaneous parts using spray and brush techniques which may include direction of Management, Engineering and the Quality Control Dept.
  • Hand lays sections of saturated mat or cloth into place on molds, using proper tooling to insure placement of material is correct. Uses brushes, rollers and squeegees as needed to smooth out air pockets, air bubbles and wrinkles to achieve full contact and proper adhesion.
  • Design, manufacture and repair both hard and soft molds for composite material products that are used throughout the venues.
  • Performs hand sculpting of different materials for a variety of props, show figures and miscellaneous parts utilizing catalyzed foam, clay, latex and foam sheets and blocks.
  • Safely and properly create a vacuum bag barrier on repaired parts and operate a vacuum pump to evacuate all air from the repair area.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.
  • Understands and actively participates in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UO policy, procedures, training and team member involvement activities.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

EDUCATION:

  • High school degree or GED is required while a completion of a related technical school course is preferred
  • Previous training in automotive body work, marine or aerospace industries is essential

EXPERIENCE:

  • 5-7 Years: Structural lay up of composite matting materials as well as grinding and prep for repairs of finished products required
  • Additional experience of properly preparing indications and feathering composite materials to insure all affected areas of discrepancies have been removed
  • Knowledge of spraying and brushing of gel coatings is required

CERTIFICATIONS, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS:

Valid Florida Drivers License/ required to operate company vehicles
