JOB SUMMARY:

The Director, Principal Data Architect shapes the data foundation for Universal Destinations & Experiences (UDX) growth, innovation, and AI transformation. Leading the data architecture pillar, this role translates the Enterprise Data & AI vision into an executable strategy and target-state architecture that modernizes platforms and enables advanced analytics, intelligent automation, and AI-powered solutions.

The role leads the design of end-to-end data solutions, including data models, integration patterns, and data platform architecture. Partnering with business and technology leaders, the role connects architecture decisions to measurable improvements in guest experience, revenue, and operations. This hands-on leader develops the data architecture team, owns data governance design and architecture standards, and leads the Data Architecture Review Boardproviding clear direction and decisive recommendations that enable teams to build trusted, secure, and reusable data capabilities at enterprise scale.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Data Strategy, Vision & Target-State Design: Treat data as a strategic business asset, ensuring architecture decisions are grounded in measurable business value, including guest experience, revenue, cost, and risk. Translate the enterprise data and AI strategy into the data architecture strategy, guiding principles, and multi-year target-state design aligned to UDX business priorities across guest, commercial, and operational domains. As part of target-state design, evaluate and recommend data platform capabilities, tools, and patterns (e.g., cloud data warehouse and lakehouse, streaming, integration, cataloging, observability), including build/buy/reuse decisions and rationalization of redundant capabilities. Work directly with business and technology stakeholders to translate needs into clear architectural direction, documented as architecture decisions.
  • Data Architecture Standards & Alignment: Author, publish, and continuously evolve UDX data architecture and data governance standards, including data modeling, integration and interoperability, metadata and lineage, master and reference data, and security and access patterns. Chair the Data Architecture Review Board (DARB), UDXs decision-making body for data architecture, and own its charter, entry criteria, review cadence, decision rights, and escalation paths. Review solution designs from internal teams, delivery partners, and vendors, issue clear recommendations (approve, approve with conditions, or reject) in adherence with UDX standards, and govern exceptions and architectural debt through to closure.
  • Data Governance Design Ownership: Serve as the enterprise owner of data governance design, defining the governance framework, operating model, data ownership and stewardship structures, data domain definitions, data quality standards and controls, classification, lineage, and retention policies. Embed privacy-by-design, regulatory, and data residency requirements into architecture in partnership with Information Security, Privacy, and Legal. Define governance-by-design patterns so controls are built into platforms and pipelines, and partner with platform and engineering teams to ensure governance designs are implemented and adopted.
  • Data Readiness for AI: Define the architecture that makes enterprise data AI-ready, including canonical data models, semantic layers, ontologies and knowledge graphs, data contracts, and feature and vector data patterns supporting ML, generative AI, and agentic use cases. Establish standards for AI data quality, lineage, observability, and responsible use. Assess data readiness for proposed AI initiatives and define remediation paths before build commitments are made.
  • Practice Leadership & Development: Lead, coach, and develop data architects, including team members and partner resources, setting clear expectations and quality bars. Build a consistent, repeatable data architecture practice with standard artifacts, maturity metrics, and a community of practice. Communicate architecture strategy and decisions to executive, technical, and non-technical audiences.
  • Understands and actively participates in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UO policy, procedures, training and team member involvement activities.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities (KSAs) required.

  • Proven experience in data architecture, data engineering, enterprise data platforms, including significant experience leading architecture for complex enterprise environments.
  • Enterprise data architecture: expert command of conceptual, logical, and physical data modeling (relational, dimensional), data product and domain design, lakehouse and cloud data warehouse patterns, batch and real-time/streaming integration, APIs, and event-driven architecture.
  • Data governance design: deep expertise designing enterprise data governance frameworks and operating models, including ownership and stewardship, data domains, data quality controls, classification, metadata, lineage, and master data management, aligned to DAMA-DMBOK or equivalent.
  • Privacy & regulatory: working knowledge of privacy, security, and regulatory requirements such as GDPR/UK GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, Japan APPI, and PCI DSS, including cross-border data residency and sharing.
  • Cloud data platforms: deep knowledge of Snowflake and AWS/Azure data and AI services, ELT and transformation tooling (e.g., dbt), orchestration, cataloging, and data observability; ability to evaluate platforms objectively on capability, cost, performance, and scalability.
  • AI & advanced analytics: working knowledge of ML platforms and MLOps, feature stores, vector databases, retrieval-augmented generation, semantic layers, ontologies/knowledge graphs, and AI data governance patterns.
  • Decision-making & governance leadership: proven ability to lead architecture review forums and make timely, defensible decisions, balancing standards with pragmatic delivery and managing exceptions transparently.
  • Data as a strategic business asset: demonstrated ability to connect data architecture to business outcomes, articulate and measure the value of data assets, and prioritize architecture investments based on business impact.
  • Communication & influence: executive presence and exceptional written and verbal communication; distills complex technical options into clear recommendations; influences without authority and resolves conflict across competing priorities.
  • Tools: proficiency with SQL, data modeling tools, data catalogs, and architecture diagramming/repository tools.
  • Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  • Consistent attendance is a job requirement

EDUCATION:

  • Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field required.
  • Masters degree in a related field preferred.

EXPERIENCE:

  • Required: 12+ years of proven experience in data, technology, or engineering roles, including 10+ years in data architecture, data engineering, or data platform leadership.
  • Required: 5+ years in an enterprise, principal, or lead data architect role setting architecture strategy and standards across multiple domains and platforms.
  • Required: experience designing and implementing an enterprise data governance framework and operating model in a large, complex organization.
  • Required: demonstrated experience chairing an architecture review board or equivalent governance forum and issuing binding architectural decisions.
  • Required: experience designing and delivering cloud-scale data platforms (Snowflake, AWS, and/or Azure), including platform evaluation and selection.
  • Required: 3+ years leading, coaching, or managing architects or senior technical staff, including directing external partners and vendors.
  • Preferred: experience architecting data foundations for AI/ML and generative AI solutions running in production.
  • Preferred: experience in global, multi-region organizations with data residency and cross-border data sharing requirements.
  • Helpful but Not required: experience in hospitality, theme parks, travel, entertainment, or retail;
  • or equivalent combination of education and experience.

CERTIFICATIONS, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS:

Relevant certifications preferred, such as TOGAF, DAMA Certified Data Management Professional (CDMP), SnowPro Advanced: Architect, AWS Certified Solutions Architect Professional, or Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:

  • Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organizations policies and applicable laws.
  • Travel up to approximately 10% may be required, including domestic and international travel to UDX destinations and partners (e.g., Japan, United Kingdom).
  • Flexibility to collaborate across global time zones, including early-morning or evening meetings with international teams, is required.

Your talent, skills and experience will be rewarded with a competitive compensation package.

Job.JobTitle: Senior Complex Casualty Claims Resolution Specialist - Northeast Region
Job.JobDescription:
Description

Grow Here. Go Further.

Senior Complex Casualty Claims Resolution Specialist - Northeast Region

At Liberty Mutual, we do more than offer a job in claims. We offer the opportunity to build a lasting career. Through ongoing development, coaching, technical training, mentoring, and internal mobility, we help high-performing and motivated claims professionals continue growing throughout their careers. Whether your long-term goals include people leadership, technical claims, litigation, specialty operations, quality, strategy, or another area of the business, we provide opportunities to expand your expertise and take on greater responsibility.

Trusted to Decide. Empowered to Lead.

Complex claims require experience, judgment, confidence, and the ability to make thoughtful decisions in uncertain and high-stakes situations. At Liberty Mutual, we trust our claims professionals to lead their work. In this role, you will be empowered to make timely decisions within your authority, while having access to experienced leaders, technical specialists, legal partners, and other resources when collaboration is needed.

About the Role

As a Senior Complex Casualty Claims Resolution Specialist, you will manage high-severity personal lines auto and homeowners liability claims involving significant injuries, complex liability questions, attorney representation, and litigation.

Responsibilities

  • Manages, investigates, and resolves claims. Investigates and evaluates coverage, liability, damages, and settles claims within prescribed procedures and authority.
  • Recommends ultimate resolution on assigned cases in excess of their authority to local claims management and Home Office.
  • Identifies potential suspicious claims and refers to SIU and identifies opportunities for third party subrogation.
  • Prepares for and attends trials, hearings and conferences as required.
  • Communicates proactively and clearly with policyholders, witnesses, and claimants in order to gather information regarding claims.
  • Responds to various written and telephone inquiries including status reports in a timely and professional manner.
  • Ensures adequacy of reserves. Recommends reserve increases on cases in excess of authority.
  • Contributes to a culture of innovation, positivity, and engagement through collaboration, continuous improvement, and active participation in team initiatives.
  • Effectively prepares and delivers presentations by gathering and organizing key information, identifying relevant facts and insights, tailoring content to the audience, and communicating information clearly, concisely, and professionally.
  • Accountable for security of financial processing of claims, as well as security information contained in claims files.
  • Responsible for managing the practices and billing activities of outside and in-house counsel.
  • May assist in the absence of the Claims Unit Manager, representing the company on matters involving state or federal regulatory agencies.
  • May be involved in special projects and/or mentoring at the direction of local management.

Ideal Experience Includes:

  • 5+ years managing complex and litigated casualty claims
  • Homeowners experience
  • Deep expertise handling severe to catastrophic injuries and fatalities
  • Strong analytical thinking, negotiation skills, and sound judgment
  • Ability to thrive in a fastpaced, highstakes environment
  • Professionalism, empathy, and exceptional communication skills

Competitive Bonus Opportunity

External candidates with an active FL or TX AllLines Adjuster License (CEs current) may qualify for a $2,500 signon bonus.

Where You Can Work:

If you live within 50 miles of one of our hub locations, the role is hybrid (2 days in office). Otherwise, it may be fully remote. Candidates located in the Eastern or Central time zones would be most ideal as this position supports claims located in the Eastern Time Zones.

Hub Locations:


Chandler, AZ
Clifton Park, NY
Columbus, OH
Indianapolis, IN
Lake Mary, FL
Liberty Lake, WA
Marlton, NJ
Plano, TX
Suwanee, GA
Naperville, IL
Westborough, MA

Travel:10% for mediations, arbitrations, trials, or inperson events.

Your Expertise Opens Doors

The work you do here can be the foundation for what comes next. As you build technical depth, demonstrate leadership, and expand your impact, you will have opportunities to pursue new challenges and advance within the organization.

At Liberty Mutual, growth is not limited to one job title and trust is not limited to one decision. We give you the opportunity to build your career and the authority to make a difference.

Training That Sets You Up for Success:

Your growth begins on day one.Active engagement and reliable attendance during training are mandatoryand crucial to your success in this highimpact role.

Qualifications
  • Must have an expert knowledge of coverage, liability, and complex claims handling procedures.
  • Must be able to effectively handle claims at the highest technical and complexity level.
  • Must be knowledgeable of state and federal laws in the adjuster's jurisdiction.
  • A full working knowledge of claims operations and procedures is required.
  • Excellent written and oral communications skills required as well as strong interpersonal, analytical, investigative and negotiation skills.
  • The capabilities, skills and knowledge required is normally acquired through a Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience and at least 7 years of directly related experience.
  • Ability to obtain proper licensing as required.
About Us

Pay Philosophy: The typical starting salary range for this role is determined by a number of factors including skills, experience, education, certifications and location. The full salary range for this role reflects the competitive labor market value for all employees in these positions across the national market and provides an opportunity to progress as employees grow and develop within the role. Some roles at Liberty Mutual have a corresponding compensation plan which may include commission and/or bonus earnings at rates that vary based on multiple factors set forth in the compensation plan for the role.

At Liberty Mutual, our goal is to create a workplace where everyone feels valued, supported, and can thrive. We build an environment that welcomes a wide range of perspectives and experiences, with inclusion embedded in every aspect of our culture and reflected in everyday interactions. This comes to life through comprehensive benefits, workplace flexibility, professional development opportunities, and a host of opportunities provided through our Employee Resource Groups. Each employee plays a role in creating our inclusive culture, which supports every individual to do their best work. Together, we cultivate a community where everyone can make a meaningful impact for our business, our customers, and the communities we serve.

We value your hard work, integrity and commitment to make things better, and we put people first by offering you benefits that support your life and well-being. To learn more about our benefit offerings please visit: https://www.libertymutualgroup.com/about-lm/careers/benefits

Liberty Mutual is an equal opportunity employer. We will not tolerate discrimination on the basis of race, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, age, disability, veteran's status, pregnancy, genetic information or on any basis prohibited by federal, state or local law.

Fair Chance Notices

  • California
  • Los Angeles Incorporated
  • Los Angeles Unincorporated
  • Philadelphia
  • San Francisco

Job.JobTitle: Integrated Eligibility Business Analyst - Human Service Transformation
Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary


We are seeking a Business Analyst to support the planning, analysis, testing, and implementation of technology and business transformation solutions for Deloitte's Government and Public Services practice. In this role, you will work closely with clients, project teams, and technology stakeholders to gather requirements, analyze business needs, improve processes, and support successful project delivery. The ideal candidate brings foundational business analysis experience, strong analytical and communication skills, and the ability to support initiatives throughout the project lifecycle.

Work You'll Do

As a Project - Integrated Eligibility Business Analyst (Delivery Engineer II) on the Government and Public Services team, you will be responsible for:

  • Support analysis and documentation of eligibility policies, business rules, and operational processes for public sector health and human services programs, including Medicaid, SNAP, TANF, and related benefit programs.
  • Collaborate with eligibility workers, policy staff, and program stakeholders to translate legislation, policy guidance, and operational requirements into system requirements and business processes.
  • Support eligibility determination design, case management workflows, notices, enrollment processes, interfaces, and program operations within integrated eligibility environments.
  • Assist with development and execution of user acceptance testing (UAT), scenario-based testing, and validation of eligibility outcomes against policy requirements.
  • Analyze defects, operational issues, and enhancement requests to identify business impacts and support resolution planning.

A Successful Candidate Would Possess These Skills

  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team-oriented environment
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships with clients and team members
  • Ability to facilitate discussions and gather information from diverse stakeholder groups
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills
  • Ability to lead project tasks or workstreams with limited supervision
  • Ability to mentor and provide guidance to junior team members
  • Ability to meet deadlines while balancing competing priorities

The Team

Deloitte's Government and Public Services practice brings together people, ideas, technology, and outcomes to help clients make an impact. Serving federal, state, and local government clients, as well as public higher education institutions, the team helps organizations anticipate disruption, rethink what is possible, and advance their mission.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Public Administration, Information Systems, Health & Human Services, Social Sciences, Computer Science, or a related field
  • 2+ years of professional experience supporting business analysis, system implementation, technology modernization, or business process improvement initiatives
  • 2+ years of experience gathering, documenting, and validating business requirements, user stories, business processes, workflows, and functional specifications
  • Experience supporting Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) activities including requirements management, design reviews, testing, defect triage, and implementation readiness
  • Experience using Microsoft Office Suite, including advanced Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Visio, or comparable business analysis tools
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to translate business needs into actionable requirements
  • Ability to travel 0-20%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve

Preferred

  • Experience supporting Integrated Eligibility and Enrollment (IE&E) systems within Medicaid, SNAP, TANF, CHIP, Child Care, or other public assistance programs.
  • Experience interpreting federal or state eligibility policy and translating policy requirements into business rules, workflows, and system requirements.
  • Experience supporting eligibility determination, benefits issuance, case maintenance, renewals, notices, or enrollment functions.
  • Experience developing test scenarios, expected results, and UAT materials for complex eligibility and enrollment programs.
  • Experience working directly with eligibility workers, policy teams, and state agency stakeholders.
  • Familiarity with CMS, HHS, Medicaid, SNAP, TANF, or other human services policy environments.

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $71,300 to $118,900.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

Deloitte is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for people with disabilities. If you require a reasonable accommodation to participate in the recruiting process, please direct your inquiries to the Global Call Center (GCC) at USTalentCICInbox@deloitte.com.

Recruiting tips

From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

Benefits

At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. We value our people and offer employees a broad range of benefits. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.

Our people and culture

Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas, and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients' most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.

Our purpose

Deloitte's purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities. Learn more.

Professional development

From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe there's always room to learn. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership opportunities and connect and grow through mentorship. From on-the-job learning experiences to formal development programs, our professionals have a variety of opportunities to continue to grow throughout their career.

As used in this posting, "Deloitte" means Deloitte Consulting LLP, a subsidiary of Deloitte LLP. Please see https://www.deloitte.com/us/about for a detailed description of the legal structure of Deloitte LLP and its subsidiaries.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability or protected veteran status, or any other legally protected basis, in accordance with applicable law.

Position Summary

We are seeking a Business Analyst to support the planning, analysis, testing, and implementation of technology and business transformation solutions for Deloitte's Government and Public Services practice. In this role, you will work closely with clients, project teams, and technology stakeholders to gather requirements, analyze business needs, improve processes, and support successful project delivery. Work You'll Do

Description & Requirements

Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.

Please note: this role is on-site hybrid (3x per week) in Orlando, FL. Relocation assistance is not provided for this role.

EA SPORTS is one of the leading sports entertainment brands in the world, with top-selling videogame franchises, award-winning interactive technology, fan programs, and cross-platform digital experiences. EA SPORTS creates connected experiences that ignite the emotion of sport through industry-leading sports video games, including Madden NFL football, EA SPORTS FC soccer, NHL® hockey, and EA SPORTS UFC.

As a Technical Game Designer on EA SPORTS Madden NFL Football, you'll be a hands-on creator who builds new presentation features and complex systems. You'll partner closely with design, engineering, and content teams to prototype, implement, iterate, and polish—from early concept through live tuning. If you're passionate about game design and thrive working with a collaborative team, we'd love to hear from you.

Responsibilities:

  • Work with designers, engineers and other creatives to develop the vision and innovate on compelling gameplay systems.
  • Implement and drive gameplay systems and/or modes from concept to ship quality.
  • Align and collaborate with multiple disciplines and communicate the vision of gameplay features.
  • Ensure a high-quality release by bug fixing, balancing, and creating a fun gameplay experience.
  • Pitch ideas, provide feedback and rapid iteration with the team
  • Build all-new innovative Madden experiences (mechanics, modes, progression, meta systems, tuning frameworks, etc.) that integrate cleanly into the core game.
  • Quick prototype building of new features
  • Create robust scripting-driven implementations (logic, state machines, event flows, data setup) that are scalable and maintainable.

Requirements:

  • Experience with scripting languages (such as Lua, Python, Javascript, and/or other scripting languages).
  • Worked on multiple shipped titles as a Technical Designer
  • Passion for crafting gameplay systems, mechanics and game modes.
  • Familiarity, passion and knowledge of American Football and football products.
  • Expertise in comprehending the game design process, specifically with game mechanics and design theory.
  • Experience with content-driven game engines (Unreal, Frostbite, Unity, GtkRadiant).
  • Ability to read and understand C++
  • Experience developing and in a multiplayer live service environment

Regional Administrative Assistant

Based in Orlando, Florida, Massey Services is one of the nation's largest and most respected service companies, with a history of providing quality service for more than three decades. Celebrating consecutive years of profitable growth since 1985, Massey Services and its subsidiary organizations employ over 2,800 team members and operate over 2,400 vehicles that provide Residential and Commercial Pest Prevention, Termite Protection, Landscape and Irrigation Services to over 800,000 customers from 180+ Service Centers throughout Florida, Georgia, Louisiana, Texas, South Carolina, North Carolina, Virginia, Tennessee and Oklahoma.

Job Functions and Duties

  • Maintain a professional image in both appearance and work area.
  • Answer all phone calls for Regional/Division Managers and respond to caller's request by researching information and responding, taking messages, or routing calls. Ensure messages are delivered in a timely and accurate fashion.
  • Receive all incoming mail for Regional/Division Managers. Sort, open and respond accordingly. Ensure outgoing mail is processed daily.
  • Compose all correspondence for Regional/Division Managers. This could include correspondence with customers or team members, interoffice memorandum, or others.
  • Maintain schedule for Regional/Division Managers and ensure immediate access to them at all times.
  • Attend meetings and take notes on behalf of Regional/Division Managers. Follow-up as necessary to all relevant concerns, issues, or requests for information, reports, or data, following each meeting.
  • Act as liaison between Service Centers, Corporate Office, Regional/Division Managers and Executive Office. Ensure lines of communication are open and all appropriate information is communicated accurately and professionally.
  • Make all arrangements for regional meetings and handle the set-up and clean-up of regional functions. This includes everything from hotel accommodations, reservation of corporate training room space, ordering of food, pick-up of food or groceries, arrangement of items, refreshing items during meetings, and clean-up after meetings. Job.JobTitle: Senior, Full Stack Engineer - Tax Transformation
Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

If you are a technology visionary with a passion for transforming global tax business with digital technology, consider working with the US Tax Transformation technology team. This is an exciting opportunity to support global execution of Deloitte's tax strategy as we shift from “doing digital” to “being digital” by reimagining how we engage with our clients, deliver our services, operate our business, and create value.

Recruiting for this role ends on May 31, 2027.

What You'll Do

As a Deloitte Tax Full Stack Engineer, Senior you'll design, develop, and deploy cutting-edge web applications and features that solve key business challenges. You'll work hands-on across the entire technology stack, collaborating closely with other engineers, data scientists, and business stakeholders to deliver robust, scalable solutions and integrate AI components into modern web applications.

Responsibilities:

  • Participate in requirements analysis.
  • Collaborate with US colleagues and Vendors' teams to produce software design and architecture.
  • Write clean, scalable code using .NET programming languages.
  • Test and deploy applications and systems.
  • Revise, update, refactor and debug code.
  • Develop, support, and maintain applications and technology solutions.
  • Ensure that all development efforts meet or exceed client expectations. Applications should meet requirements of scope, functionality, and time and adhere to all defined and agreed upon standards.
  • Become familiar with all development tools, testing tools, methodologies, and processes.
  • Become familiar with the project management methodology and processes.
  • Encourage collaborative efforts and camaraderie with on-shore and off-shore team members.
  • Demonstrate a strong working understanding of the industry best standards in software development and version controlling.
  • Ensure the quality and low bug rates of code released into production.
  • Work on agile projects, participate in daily SCRUM calls and provide task updates.

The Team

Deloitte Tax LLP's Tax Transformation Office (TTO) is responsible for the design, development, and deployment of innovative, enterprise technology, tools, and standard processes to support the delivery of tax services. The TTO team focuses on enhancing Deloitte Tax LLP's ability to deliver comprehensive, value-added, and efficient tax services to our clients. It is a dynamic team with professionals of varying backgrounds from tax technical, technology development, change management, Six Sigma, and project management. The team consults and executes on a wide range of initiatives involving process and tool development and implementation including training development, engagement management, tool design, and implementation.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Ability to perform job responsibilities within a hybrid work model that requires US Tax professionals to co-locate in person 2 – 3 days per week.
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science or a relevant discipline.
  • 3+ years experience in full stack web development and strong hands-on experience on C#, SQL Server, OOPS Concepts, Micro Services Architecture.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in modern front-end frameworks (e.g., Angular, React).
  • Proven hands-on experience on .NET Core, ASP.NET Core Web API, SQL, NoSQL, Entity Framework 6 or above, Azure, Database performance tuning, Applying Design Patterns, Agile.
  • Ability to travel up to 10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Limited sponsorship may be available.
  • One of the following active accreditations obtained, in process, or willing and able to obtain:
    • Licensed CPA in state of practice/primary office if eligible to sit for the CPA
    • If not CPA eligible:
      • Licensed Attorney
      • Enrolled Agent
      • Technology Certifications:
        • AWS Certified Solutions Architect
        • Certified SAFe® Advanced Scrum Master
        • Certified SAFe® Agile Software Engineer
        • Certified SAFe® Agilist
        • Certified SAFe® Architect
        • Certified SAFe® DevOps Practitioner
        • Certified SAFe® Practitioner
        • Certified SAFe® Scrum Master
        • Certified Scrum Developer (CSD)
        • MCSD: Application Lifecycle Management Solutions Developer
        • MCSD: Web Applications
        • Microsoft Azure
        • Microsoft Certified Solutions Developer (MCSD)
        • Microsoft Certified Solutions Expert (MCSE)
        • Microsoft MCSD Certification
        • Professional Scrum Developer™ (PSD)
        • Professional Scrum Product Owner™(PSCPO) – SCRUM.org

Preferred:

  • Practical experience integrating and utilizing AI/ML features in web applications, including prompt engineering and working with Gen AI models.
  • Familiarity with designing and integrating databases (SQL, NoSQL) and working with vector databases, RAG, and hybrid search approaches.
  • Prior experience developing agentic AI applications or GenAI-powered modules.
  • Experience with Azure (cloud hosting, DevOps/build/release pipelines), MongoDB, and Entity Framework.
  • Excellent troubleshooting and communication skills.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills; strong listening, interpersonal, and facilitation skills.
  • Knowledge on Angular, Mongo DB, NPM and Azure Devops Build/Release configuration.
  • Self-starter with solid analytical and problem-solving skills.

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. Position Summary

Join our AI & Engineering team in transforming technology platforms, driving innovation, and helping make a significant impact on our clients' success. You'll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and re-engineering operations and processes that are critical to businesses. Your contributions can help clients improve financial performance, accelerate new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation.

AI & Engineering leverages cutting-edge engineering capabilities to build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These solutions are powered by engineering for business advantage, transforming mission-critical operations. We enable clients to stay ahead with the latest advancements by transforming engineering teams and modernizing technology & data platforms. Our delivery models are tailored to meet each client's unique requirements.

Work you'll do

As an Industry Solutions Manager specializing in Life Sciences Patient Services, you will play a pivotal role in helping Patient Services clients achieve their transformation goals. Leveraging your expertise in patient services, you will interface between pharmaceutical, biotech or medical device clients and cross-functional implementation teams to identify and implement digital health solutions that improve patient outcomes.   • Advanced degree (e.g., MHA, MBA)

  • Experience implementing Salesforce Health Cloud or Life Sciences Cloud
  • SAFe, PMP, PMI, or Agile certifications

JOB SUMMARY

Assists with the direction and management of the Security&Safety Services function, to include Convention Services, ensuring compliance with federal, state, local and company policies and procedures. Participates in meetings with customers (Planning Meetings) to proactively sell Special Event Security to Meeting Planners and recommends additional Security and Hotel services. Coordinates VIP and Dignitary visits, liaises with Government agencies and Group Corporate Security as appropriate, and monitors upcoming location group and special event activity to provide a safe environment for employees and guests. Monitors the activities of Vendors and Outside Companies operating within the facility to ensure guest safety and asset protection..

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Education and Experience

• Bachelor's Degree in a related field or equivalent experience.

OR

• 5 years Safety and Security Administration, knowledgeable of NFPA Regulations, OSHA standards.

• Licenses/Certificates: Valid driver's license and a satisfactory driving record. Must be CPR/AED certified or capable of getting certified within 90 days of employment. Must be registered in accordance with state law (timeframe / requirements vary by state).

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

Monitoring Property Operations

• Participates in meetings with customers (planning meetings) to proactively sell special event security to meeting planners and recommends additional Security and Hotel services.

• Inspects location-provided security services and interacts with on-site meeting planners to promote satisfaction and the safe enjoyment of the facility.

• Coordinates VIP and dignitary visits, liaisons with government agencies and Group Corporate Security as appropriate, and monitors upcoming location group and special event activity to ensure that the location maintains a safe environment for employees and guests.

• Monitors the activities of vendors and outside companies operating within the facility to provide guest safety and asset protection.

• Assists in the development of loss prevention / safety programs by analyzing available data and keeps management advised on preventive measures needing implementation and makes recommendations.

• Determines the type of materials, supplies, machinery, equipment or tools to be used or merchandise to be bought, stocked and sold.

Supporting Profitability and Revenue Goals

• Assists with the preparation and implementation of departmental budget and cost controls. Monitors department payroll for accuracy.

• Develops and maintains programs that reduce location losses and aids in creating new procedures that physically secure the property and its assets.

• Assists in the response and resolution of all guest issues received directly from guests or from Guest Relations.

• Controls the flow and distribution of materials or merchandise and supplies.

Managing and Conducting Human Resources Activities

• Promotes participation in property safety-related programs.

• Conducts mandatory training with all Safety Service agents. Provides documentation in compliance with state and federal mandates.

• Establishes standards, oversees training, and schedules Special Event Security Officers and Badge Checkers to fulfill customer and location needs.

• Mentors and develops direct reports to ensure line of succession for future opportunities.

• Interviews, selects and trains employees.

• Appraises employees' productivity and efficiency for the purpose of recommending promotions or other changes in status.

Design Project Manager– Job Description

JOB OVERVIEW

The Design Project Manager is responsible for managing the execution of prototype restaurant design projects from concept adaptation through construction documentation, consultant coordination, bidding support, and store opening. This role ensures brand standards, prototype requirements, schedule commitments, and construction objectives are achieved while coordinating architects, engineers, consultants, landlords, and internal stakeholders.

The ideal candidate enjoys design from an efficiency and production standpoint. True design in the concept of interior finishes is limited. The individual will be required to travel to some openings, design review meetings and sign variance requests. Being able to have multiple projects under various stages and enjoying a fast-paced environment.

ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Project Design Management

-Lead project design execution from site assignment through construction.

- Adapt prototype designs to site-specific conditions.

- Coordinate internal and external design resources.

- Ensure alignment with brand standards and operational requirements.

Consultant Management

-Manage architects, engineers, and specialty consultants.

-Direct consultant scope, schedules, deliverables, invoices for services and agreement review against established budget.

-Review design documents for quality, completeness, and compliance for every project. Compare drawing completeness to specific project standards and make sure they are up to date.

-Coordinate multidisciplinary design efforts including alignment and coordination with internal Food Service Team.

Design Development

-Oversee schematic, design development, and construction document phases.

-Coordinate design review meetings with key stakeholders.

-Incorporate operational, development, and construction feedback into designs.

-Manage document revisions and approvals.

Landlord Coordination

-Obtain landlord plan approvals for our submitted drawings.

-Review and approve LL drawings that relate to our location and check and coordinate for accuracy.

-Coordinate responses to landlord review comments.

-Ensure landlord requirements are incorporated into project documents.

-Facilitate approval processes to maintain project schedules.

Construction Documentation

-Lead production and issuance of construction documents.

-Verify accuracy and constructability of plans.

-Ensure permit submissions meet jurisdictional requirements.

-Maintain document control throughout the project lifecycle.

Bidding & Procurement Support

-Support contractor bidding activities.

-Oversee and manage all owner provided items, including partnering with purchasing, timing of purchase orders and quantities in relation to the project.

-Respond to bidder questions and requests for information.

-Evaluate design-related value engineering opportunities.

-Coordinate issuance of bid revisions and addenda.

Construction Support

-Provide design support during construction.

-Review and respond to RFIs, substitutions, and design clarifications.

-Coordinate consultant responses to field issues.

-Support resolution of construction-related design conflicts.

-Support Brand Design Manager with Brand goals and Design Directives while projects are in design and construction.

-Support Site Development Manager when permit closeout and transfer is needed.

Project Closeout & Turnover

-Verify completion of design deliverables.

-Support punch list and turnover processes. Travel to 2 sites a year and participate in the punch process.

-Coordinate as-built documentation.

-Capture lessons learned and support continuous improvement initiatives.

Qualifications

Required

-Bachelor's degree in Architecture, Interior Design, Construction Management, Engineering, or related discipline.

5–8 years of project management experience in retail, restaurant, or commercial design.

-Experience managing architecture and engineering consultants.

-Proficiency in design and construction documentation processes.

-Strong understanding of permitting and construction practices.

-CAD or Revit / Bluebeam / sketch up Windows suite

-Current Building Codes and applications.

Preferred

-Licensed Architect or NCIDQ certification.

-Retail rollout or prototype program experience.

-Restaurant operational experience

-Remodel, conversion or Facility experience.

Key Competencies

-Design management

-Consultant leadership

-Construction documentation

-Project delivery and maintaining schedules

-Budget awareness

-Cross-functional coordination

-Vendor management

-Quality assurance

-Stakeholder communication

-Construction Knowledge

Success Metrics

-Design milestone achievement

-Consultant performance

-Permit-ready document quality

-Landlord approval cycle time

-Construction RFI / CO volume

-On-time project delivery

-Brand standards compliance

-Store opening readiness

Location and travel

-Position is in the Orlando RSC Office

-Travel requirement 20% - domestic only

-Must be able to travel without assistance

  • #LI-LE1

Site Development Manager – Job Description

Position Summary

The Site Development Manager is responsible for leading all site development activities from real estate approval through permitting, landlord coordination, pre-construction readiness, construction support, and project turnover for 2 +/- acre sites within an assigned regional area. This role serves as the primary accountable leader for ensuring sites progress efficiently through entitlement, approval, permitting, and development milestones while coordinating cross-functional teams, landlords, consultants, and contractors to meet schedule, cost, and quality objectives.

The ideal candidate can effectively public speak and sell certain aspects of a Darden Restaurant while being the face of the company in a public setting. The individual will be required to travel to zoning, planning and public hearings/ meetings when needed and would need to be able to perform under these conditions. Being able to have multiple projects under various stages and enjoying a fast paced environment.

Key Responsibilities

Site Due Diligence & Feasibility

-Works closely with the assigned Real Estate Director for smooth transition and project kick off.

-Lead site feasibility reviews following real estate approval.

-Coordinate site investigations and due diligence activities.

-Evaluate site constraints, utility availability, access requirements, and permitting risks.

-Review survey, environmental, geotechnical, and civil engineering findings.

-Assess project readiness prior to development commitment.

Entitlements & Government Approvals

-Mange Site Consultants, engineers agreements within estimated budget and timelines.

-Manage zoning, subdivision, and governmental approval processes.

-Coordinate entitlement strategies with consultants and municipal agencies.

-Lead development reviews, planning board submissions, and approval meetings.

-Ensure compliance with jurisdictional requirements and development conditions.

Landlord & Third-Party Coordination

-Serve as primary liaison with landlords throughout development.

-Negotiate development-related requirements and site obligations.

-Coordinate landlord approvals for plans, utility work, and site modifications.

-Manage lease-related site development deliverables by working closely with internal legal department, the lease terms and timelines.

Permitting Management

-Direct preparation and submission of permit applications.

-Monitor permit review processes and agency comments.

-Coordinate consultant responses to permit review feedback.

-Secure all permits required for construction commencement.

Pre-Construction Management

-Lead project handoff from permitting into construction.

-Verify permit issuance and development readiness.

-Coordinate utility applications and service requirements.

-Ensure site-related conditions are resolved before construction start.

Construction Support

-Support construction teams in resolving site and jurisdictional issues.

-Coordinate responses to field conditions that could impact schedule

-Manage and support budget related to site challenges

- Support development-related change requests and approvals.

-Facilitate communication between contractor, landlord, consultants, and internal teams.

Project Closeout

-Oversee final jurisdictional approvals and closeout activities.

-Support turnover requirements and utility transfer to Darden.

-Review all change orders and project learnings for Future Development.

Qualifications

Required

-Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, Architecture, Real Estate Development, or related field.

-5–10 years of experience in site development, retail development, construction management, or entitlement management.

-Experience managing permitting and municipal approval processes, included but not limited to: Zoning, Code Compliance, inspections, utility management and application, permitting, REA and PUD compliance, platting.

-Knowledge of civil engineering, site planning, utilities, and development regulations.

-Strong project management skills.

-High aptitude for multi project work with fast paced work environment

-Ability to work with team and align with over arching goals.

-Restaurant operational experience.

-Current version of Bluebeam operational skills.

Preferred

-Restaurant development experience.

-Multi-site program management experience.

-Professional certifications such as PMP or related credentials.

-CAD / Revit experience Ability to draw site plan.

Key Competencies

-Site development expertise with soil management and mitigation.

-Entitlement management

-Permit administration

-Landlord coordination

-Contract and lease interpretation

-Risk assessment

-Schedule management

-Stakeholder communication

-Problem solving

-Cross-functional leadership

Success Metrics

-Permit cycle times

-Development approval timelines

- On-time construction starts

-Landlord approval performance

-Schedule adherence

-Development budget compliance

Location

-At RSC if in the Orlando Area

-Remote possible with skill set (If remote travel to the RSC monthly for 3 days minimal during monthly meetings to maintain team cohesiveness.)

-Travel up to 50% for project meetings. Must be able to travel independently within the company parameters.

Job.JobTitle: Associate Director of Financial Aid Communications
Job.CustomJobTypeName: Accounting / Finance / Banking, Marketing / Communications / PR
Job.JobDescription:
If you're looking for the chance to learn, grow, and make a contribution to the community, look at employment opportunities with Full Sail University. You'll find your choice of career opportunities, great benefits, an environment that welcomes and values creativity, and a work experience that is both challenging and rewarding!

Assist in overseeing financial aid operations having to do with student contact and communications as part of the oversight of the Financial Aid Active and Post Enrollment teams. Assists in the planning, development, and administration of services, policies, programs, and activities in an effort to promote access to higher education as part of the university's mission and strategic outcomes. Assists in the review of the efficiency and accuracy of the university's current systems and practices. Relies on experience and judgment to plan and accomplish goals. Leads and directs the work of others. Reports to the Senior Director of Financial Aid- Active Student Services and Student Loan Management.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Behave as a Full Sail University ambassador embracing our unique educational model, while maintaining the highest level of integrity, professionalism, and customer service.
  • Responsible in assisting in ensuring institutional policies and procedures are adhered to in daily processes
  • Assist in ensuring accurate and timely communication with students regarding financial aid needs and requirements as it applies to awarding packaging and loan repayment.
  • Assist in overseeing the Exit Interview process and default resolution outcomes.
  • Assists in the innovation of efficiencies in the financial aid department.
  • Ensures financial aid compliance with all federal, state, and institutional financial aid regulations, policies, and procedures as applicable to Student Advising and Student Loan Management.
  • Maintains leadership work schedules including assignments, job rotation, training, vacations, paid time off, and cover for absenteeism.
  • Administrative Workday responsibilities, including timecards, payroll, recruiting, and termination for direct reports.
  • Oversees the assignment of workflow activities to designated teams and/or designated employees as directed.
  • Works with Leadership and Human Resources staff to recruit, interview, complete reference checks, and select, hire, employ, and retain an appropriate number of employees.
  • Leadership training and development.
  • Create, update, and archive approved policies, procedures, and training.
  • Provide effective performance feedback for the leadership team through recognition, rewards, reviews, calibration, and disciplinary action, with the assistance of Human Resources and Leadership, when necessary.
  • Responsible for motivation, camaraderie, recognition, and professionalism for leadership and teams.
  • Coaching and mentoring the leadership team members to resolve day-to-day concerns while creating a sense of ownership and urgency.
  • Reporting team metrics and evaluating both internal and external data sources to report outcomes and trends for leadership.
  • Maintain quality service by enforcing quality and customer service standards; analyzing and resolving quality and customer service problems; identifying trends; and recommending system improvements.
  • Audits day-to-day workflow and outcomes of the leadership team.
  • Provide Leadership with team workflow, process, and training updates.
  • Communicate and assist with enforcing team and department policies.
  • Organize and facilitate leadership meetings.
  • Provide floor assistance by answering questions and providing guidance as needed.
  • Responsible for resolutions of identified workflow errors of the leadership team.
  • Provide recommendations to Management regarding policy and procedures.
  • Provide feedback for budgetary requests, as needed.
  • Assist with the financial objectives by forecasting requirements; scheduling expenditures; and initiating corrective actions for the teams.
  • Partner with other Teams and Departments to promote and facilitate a world-class level of customer service, and to identify and resolve issues to achieve daily and long-term goals.
  • Function as a Financial Aid Manager when needed.
  • Attend training as necessary to keep knowledge current.

Other Responsibilities:

  • Assist with the direct leadership of the Financial Aid Advisor team
  • Assist with the leadership for all active and post-enrollment Financial Aid Communication Teams
  • Must be able to secure and maintain access to the National Student Loan Data System (NSLDS).
  • Adhere to the policies and procedures of Full Sail University, including attendance and accessibility standards
  • Maintains strict confidentiality of company and personnel information
  • Demonstrates a strong commitment to the mission and values of the organization
  • Maintain a full-time status by working a minimum of 40 hours
  • Consult with Leadership to research, address, and advise on compliance concerns, as needed
  • Attend training as necessary
  • Attend and facilitate meetings as assigned
  • Any other tasks, projects or duties as assigned

Supervisory Responsibilities: Yes

Competencies:

  • A friendly, professional demeanor, verbal and written communication skills, as well as proven excellence in customer service are essential
  • Must have a solid background in Financial Aid with a comprehensive knowledge of Title IV aid in higher education, including student loan repayment
  • A high degree of discretion due to the volume of sensitive and confidential issues
  • Ability to manage multiple, competing tasks and deliver accurate and courteous service in a fast-paced, time-sensitive, and deadline-driven environment
  • Strong decision-making and analytical abilities
  • Strong attention to detail
  • Ability to instruct, coach, and mentor while respecting different learning styles and comprehension levels
  • Ability to analyze, interpret, and explain task-related data.
  • Ability to handle complaints and diffuse difficult conversations
  • Speak effectively to both large and small groups of people
  • Demonstrates time management and organizational skills
  • Demonstrate initiative and adaptability to change
  • Ability to work within the scope of Title IV regulations
  • Excellent interpersonal and written communication skills required
  • Must be highly motivated and work well within a team
  • Knowledge of CampusVue, COD & NSLDS required

Education and/or Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree required
  • Minimum of 3-5 years in financial aid, including experience with fed aid processing systems or
  • Equivalent combination of education and Financial Aid work experience
  • 3-5 years of experience mentoring Team Members.

Certificates, Licenses, Registrations: N/A

Computer/Equipment Skills:

  • Expert user level of all Microsoft Office Suite programs, including Outlook, Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
  • Experience with National Student Loan Database, CampusVue/Anthology, Salesforce and Workday is a plus.

Environmental Factors/Physical Demands:

  • Must be capable of finishing tasks assigned in a given 40-plus-hour scheduled work week, which may include nights and some weekends.
  • Accessible to staff and leadership during and after working hours.
  • Able to work at a computer desk for long periods of time and for the majority of the workday.
  • The work environment must be free of distractions and can maintain FERPA standards.
  • An initial visit to the campus of Full Sail University in Winter Park Florida, will be required for New Employee Orientation, to present documents to Human Resources, and to pick up a Work from Home Kit from the IMT department.
  • Work is performed in an office environment. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to have the ability to maintain active customer and employee communication; access, input, and retrieve information from the computer system; and enter alphanumeric data into a computerized system often while listening on the telephone. May be subject to bending, reaching, kneeling, stooping, and lifting up to thirty (30) pounds.

Full Sail is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

The University Operations division at UCF is committed to creating a supportive and welcoming environment for our faculty, staff, students, and the broader community. The Opportunity:

Join our dynamic Facilities Maintenance Department on UCF Main Campus as a Plumber I providing essential plumbing support in the operational maintenance, installation, repair, of sanitation components of campus facilities. This position will troubleshoot and respond to customer requests to provide a safe, functional, clean, efficient, and attractive living and learning environment.

Responsibilities:

  • Perform scheduled and assigned preventive maintenance (PM) and predictive maintenance (PDM) to identify or prevent potential plumbing failures.
  • Conduct preventive maintenance repairs (PMR) by addressing defects found during PM or PDM activities.
  • Complete corrective repairs in response to reported issues to restore functionality.
  • Carry out planned work related to heating and plumbing trades.
  • Install, maintain, test, and calibrate plumbing components connected with water, gas, air, and sewer systems in bathrooms, laboratories, and kitchens.
  • Maintain and operate equipment such as pumps, faucets, valves, traps, pipes, water heaters, and emergency showers.
  • Operate and monitor sewage systems using recording equipment to troubleshoot problems.
  • Locate and repair plumbing failures and malfunctions; install, maintain, and repair backflow preventers; make emergency plumbing repairs as needed.
  • Assist with work performed by central shops, contractors, other zones, departments, and campus events.
  • Perform routine recurring work, as well as project work associated with facilities and capital improvement programs.
  • Complete work orders in a timely manner, recording labor hours, action codes, shop stock, and detailed trade notes.
  • Report special conditions, deficiencies, or issues that need further attention to the supervisor.
  • Ensure compliance with maintenance, health, sanitation, university, state, and federal regulations and policies.
  • Support inventory control, maintain security of tools and materials, and participate in required safety training.
  • Collaborate with other Facilities Operations teams and departments to support campus operations.
  • Assist other Facilities Operations zones during personnel shortages or emergencies.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Minimum Qualifications:

Completion of an approved apprenticeship program in plumbing; or a high school diploma and two years of appropriate experience; or an equivalent combination of education and experience pursuant to Fla. Stat. 112.219.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Working knowledge of plumbing trades classifications and functions including tools, equipment, materials, and task-specific sequencing required for maintenance, sanitation, and repairs.
  • Familiarity with operation and powered drain-cleaning machine, water, and gas shut-off points campus-wide.
  • Ability to communicate in conversational English to work effectively with customers and team members, operate electronic equipment (iPad for AiM PM checkpoints), comprehend standard safety procedures, and utilize telecommunication devices.
  • General facilities experience within areas of carpentry, HVAC, or similar and possess painting knowledge and skills.
  • Team player with excellent interpersonal skills.
  • Demonstrated proficiency using standard office software applications for work order systems (IWMS).
  • Capable of understanding and following written/oral instructions with a strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Ability to use approved EH&S chemicals to perform essential job functions.
  • Able to operate a vehicle, as necessary.
  • Demonstrated capabilities in the following: memory, calculation, reading, and evaluating.
  • Experience reading blueprints, use various electrical meters and construct and install power supplies.
  • Flexibility for utilization by trade for most urgent requirements and adaptable in assignments.

Health Assessment Required:

UCF policy requires completion and passing of a physical exam for this position.

Special Instructions to the Applicants:

The anticipated hourly rate range for this position is $23.33 - $31.21. The final hourly rate will be determined based on the candidate's qualifications, experience, and internal equity considerations.

University Operations is seeking an ServiceNow Developer IV. This role serves as the technical subject matter expert for the university's ServiceNow platform, responsible for the design, development, administration, support, and continuous improvement of enterprise service management solutions. This position utilizes an AI-first and configuration-first approach, leveraging low-code and no-code capabilities whenever feasible to deliver scalable, maintainable, and upgrade-safe solutions while developing custom applications and integrations when business needs require advanced functionality.


Responsibilities:

Service Management & Strategic Portfolio Management (SPM)

  • Design, implement, and support IT Service Management (ITSM) processes, including Incident, Request, Change, Problem, and Knowledge Management, aligned with ITIL best practices.
  • Configure and enhance Strategic Portfolio Management (SPM) solutions to support demand, project, portfolio, and resource management processes.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on process optimization, automation, operational efficiency, and user experience.

ServiceNow Development & Platform Engineering

  • Design, develop, configure, and maintain ServiceNow applications, workflows, forms, portals, workspaces, and user experiences.
  • Utilize platform capabilities including Flow Designer, Next Experience, JavaScript, Glide APIs, HTML, and CSS to deliver effective solutions.
  • Prioritize native low-code and no-code functionality to minimize technical debt and maximize platform sustainability.
  • Develop custom solutions when business requirements extend beyond standard platform capabilities.

Integrations, CMDB & Data Governance

  • Design, develop, and maintain integrations using REST APIs, IntegrationHub, web services, ETL processes, and legacy integration methods.
  • Support Configuration Management Database (CMDB) and Common Service Data Model (CSDM) initiatives through service modeling, data governance, and data quality management.
  • Ensure the integrity, reliability, and usability of platform data and service relationships.

Platform Administration, Reporting & Continuous Improvement

  • Monitor platform performance, availability, security, and user adoption, proactively identifying opportunities for enhancement.
  • Develop and maintain reports, dashboards, metrics, and data analyses to support operational and strategic objectives.
  • Create advanced queries and reporting solutions using GlideRecord and SQL-based tools.
  • Evaluate emerging ServiceNow capabilities, AI features, and automation technologies to improve service delivery and operational effectiveness.

Business Analysis & Solution Design

  • Collaborate with stakeholders to gather, analyze, and document business, functional, and technical requirements.
  • Translate business needs into scalable, secure, and upgrade-safe ServiceNow solutions.
  • Provide technical guidance and recommendations to support strategic decision-making.

Minimum Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree and 4 years of relevant experience; or High School Diploma (or equivalent) and 8 years of relevant work experience in lieu of degree or an equivalent combination of education and experience pursuant to Fla. Stat. 112.219(6).


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Demonstrated experience with ServiceNow application development, including Flow Designer, Next Experience, Workspaces, Service Portals, JavaScript, Glide APIs, REST APIs, HTML, and CSS.
  • ServiceNow certifications, such as Certified System Administrator (CSA), Certified Application Developer (CAD), Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS), or other relevant certifications.
  • Experience implementing and optimizing ITIL-based service management processes, including Incident, Request, Change, Problem, and Knowledge Management.
  • Experience leveraging low-code/no-code development methodologies to deliver scalable, maintainable, and upgrade-safe solutions while minimizing technical debt.
  • Knowledge of ServiceNow CMDB and Common Service Data Model (CSDM), including service mapping, data governance, data quality, and service ownership practices.
  • Knowledge of AI-enabled platform capabilities, automation technologies, and emerging ServiceNow features that enhance operational efficiency and user experience.
  • Experience working in a complex higher education, public sector, or large enterprise environment supporting multiple business units and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Analytics, or a related field. Master's degree preferred.

  • Position requires a valid Class E driver's license.This position may involve driving to various locations on and off campus to conduct University business.

  • All applicants must be authorized to work for any U.S. employer. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position, and the university cannot accommodate H‑1B transfers or employment-based visa processing for individuals currently sponsored by another employer.

The Opportunity:

The Utilities and Engineering Services at University Operations is seeking to hire an HVAC Specialist I to help maintain a safe, functional, clean, and efficient living and learning environment on campus. In this role, you will be responsible for troubleshooting HVAC issues, providing maintenance services, and responding to service requests from customers and staff.

This position requires prompt response to emergencies and unexpected situations, with rotating assignments to support departmental needs and foster cross-training. The ideal candidate will have foundational skills in maintenance, repair, and replacement of building systems, including chilled and hot water pumps, electrical, and plumbing systems. On-call responsibilities will be assigned by your supervisor.

Responsibilities:

  • Perform corrective repairs in response to customer‑reported issues to restore functionality of HVAC and refrigeration systems.
  • Install, maintain, test, and calibrate refrigeration and HVAC components across campus.
  • Conduct scheduled preventive maintenance (PM) and predictive maintenance (PDM) to identify and prevent equipment failures.
  • Complete PM‑related repairs for defects discovered during routine inspections.
  • Assist central shops, contractors, other zones, and campus departments with support work as needed.
  • Perform routine and project‑based work, including tasks related to facility improvements or campus upgrades.
  • Complete work orders accurately and promptly, documenting labor hours, parts used, trade notes, and job status updates.
  • Report maintenance, health, or sanitation deficiencies and follow all university, local, state, and federal guidelines.
  • Maintain inventory control, secure equipment/materials, and participate in all required safety training.
  • Collaborate with campus partners to support departmental and university operational needs.
  • Assist other Facilities Operations zones during emergencies, staffing shortages, or special circumstances.
  • Perform other duties as assigned by the supervisor.

Minimum Qualifications:

Completion of an approved apprenticeship program in heating, ventilation and/or air conditioning; or a high school diploma and 2 years of relevant experience; or an equivalent combination of education and experience pursuant to Fla. Stat. 112.219.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience performing preventative and predictive maintenance on HVAC systems.
  • EPA Certification or training in HVAC maintenance practices.
  • Practical experience in checking refrigerant charges and pressures, as well as handling and disposing of refrigerants safely.
  • Skilled in conducting repairs on a wide range of HVAC components, including air systems, compressors, and controls.
  • Familiarity with various computer programs, including Microsoft Office and the Integrated Work Management System (IWMS) or similar software.
  • Basic communication skills in English to work effectively with customers and operate electronic equipment.
  • Ability to work in extreme environments and collaborate with individuals from varied backgrounds and experiences.

Health Assessment Required:

UCF policy requires completion and passing of a physical exam for this position.

This position provides crucial support for the operational maintenance and sanitation of our campus. Some responsibilities include troubleshooting electrical issues, performing preventive and corrective maintenance, and responding to service requests from customers and staff. Responsibilities:

  • Conduct planned maintenance to proactively identify and prevent failures.
  • Perform PM repairs (PMR) and corrective repairs to restore functionality.
  • Install, maintain, and alter wiring, power appliances, light machinery, electrical circuits, motors, generators, and other electrical components.
  • Locate and rectify power failures and electrical malfunctions.
  • Maintain and repair fire alarm systems as needed.
  • Assist with work performed by central shops, contractors, and other departments.
  • Participate in Facilities Improvement and Capital Improvement projects.
  • Complete work orders promptly, recording labor hours, action codes, shop stock, and trade notes.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Minimum of 3 years of relevant experience in maintaining and repairing electrical systems within a commercial or institutional setting.
  • Experience with university or large facility maintenance operations is highly desirable.
  • Proficiency in preventative maintenance and repair tasks, with the ability to interpret electrical blueprints, schematics, and technical manuals.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills with attention to detail, and understanding of low and medium voltage systems, transformers, controls, and some fire alarm systems.

The Opportunity:

The Broadcast Engineer I leads the engineering, maintenance, and development of all broadcast and instructional media systems within the Nicholson School of Communication and Media (NSCM). This position is responsible for broadcast information technology including IP digital transmission hardware, internet streaming devices, IP based hardware/software for audio/video recording and playout systems, non-linear editors, production switchers, encoders, decoders, power infrastructure, UPS systems, and automation systems. The Broadcast Engineer I independently manages the lifecycle of technical systems and infrastructure, ensuring optimal functionality, modernization, and compliance with industry standards. This position serves as the subject matter expert and primary point of contact for all engineering operations related to NSCM's media production environments.

Responsibilities:

  • Maintain and repair all IP-based broadcast and AV systems, including IP based digital transmission/transmitter systems, internet streaming devices, digital IP audio/video record and playout systems, production switchers, routing switchers, encoders, decoders, automation and server/file storage systems, digital editing systems, field production gear, and broadcast related hardware.
  • Serve as the lead engineer for NSCM's live and recorded productions, providing expert technical support and supervision during instructional and professional media projects. Take full ownership of system configuration, monitoring, and troubleshooting across camera, lighting, audio, transmission, and control room operations.
  • Develop, implement, and manage technical upgrade initiatives and infrastructure enhancements across all production and instructional spaces. Design detailed signal flow documentation and engineering schematics to guide installations, expansions, and workflow optimization. Provide specific IP signal flow diagrams for CAD/Visio documentation on all work performed on technical systems.
  • Independently schedule and execute preventive maintenance plans. Conduct detailed system diagnostics and repairs at the component level to ensure consistent system performance and reliability.
  • Lead technology forecasting and procurement strategies by researching emerging trends and evaluating new tools and platforms. Maintain comprehensive inventory and asset management systems to support operational continuity.
  • Administer and enhance equipment checkout systems and shared storage environments. Train, lead, and mentor student workers and technical support staff to uphold service excellence and technical reliability.
  • Partner with the NSCM Manager of Main Campus Operations to shape long-term capital and operational budgets. Represent NSCM in vendor negotiations, procurement activities, and cross-departmental collaborations involving technical infrastructure. Act as a strategic contributor to the school's mission by proactively identifying opportunities to innovate, improve, and elevate the quality of media instruction and production.
  • Perform additional operational responsibilities and special projects as directed by the NSCM Manager of Main Campus Operations.

Minimum Qualifications:

Bachelor's or Master's degree and 4+ years of relevant experience; or an equivalent combination of education and experience pursuant to Fla. Stat. 112.219(6).

Preferred Qualifications:

  • A Bachelor's degree or higher in computer engineering, electrical engineering, studio engineering, or broadcast technology.
  • Five years or more experience working as an engineer in a professional broadcast, studio, academic, or remote production environment.
  • Knowledge of professional broadcast systems and equipment including Ross Switchers, Wheatstone Audio Mixers, and Ross Tria.

Special Instructions to the Applicants:

  • The anticipated salary range for this position is $68,670 - negotiable. The final amount will be determined based on the candidate's qualifications, experience, and internal equity considerations.
  • Position requires a valid Class E driver's license. This position may involve driving to various locations on and off campus to conduct University business.
  • All applicants must be authorized to work for any U.S. employer. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position, and the university cannot accommodate H‑1B transfers or employment-based visa processing for individuals currently sponsored by another employer.

This role requires the successful candidate to work on-site at UCF as their primary work location. On-site presence is an essential function of this role.
