Position Summary

Are you passionate about technology and interested in joining a community of collaborative colleagues who respectfully and courageously seek to challenge the status quo? If so, read on to learn more about an exciting opportunity with Deloitte Technology US (DT - US). We are curious and life-long learners focused on technology and innovation.

Recruiting for this role ends on 11/13/2026.

Work you'll do

The position supports the SOC as an escalation point identifying and addressing potential SIEM content/level I and II engineering security concerns as this role is the first line of operational support. This role is also responsible for supporting Security application patching, content creation as requested from all stake holders, and development of process documentation.

Responsibilities by category:

Administrative

  • Maintain ticket management and DevOps activity tracking to ensure accurate work intake, prioritization, and status reporting.
  • Monitor and communicate Microsoft product updates; assess and advise on impacts on the environment and customers.
  • Build strong stakeholder relationships and provide timely end-user support with clear follow-through and resolution documentation.
  • Create and maintain process documentation (runbooks, SOPs, workflows) to support consistent execution and knowledge transfer.
  • Maintain and enforce change control and peer review processes to promote quality, security, and auditability.

Threat Detection

  • Threat detection development in Microsoft Sentinel and Defender platforms sing KQL.
  • Align detection rules to current and emerging threats, leveraging external threat intelligence as appropriate.
  • Identify and remediate detection gaps using the MITRE ATT&CK framework, based on business risk and priorities.
  • Collaborate with Cybersecurity teams (e.g., Incident Response, Threat Intelligence, Engineering) to ensure cross-team alignment and coverage.
  • Develop, tune, and support analytics/detection rules, including performance monitoring and optimization.
  • Develop, maintain, and optimize playbooks/notebooks, including operational reliability and performance.
  • Develop, maintain, and optimize Logic Apps, including operational reliability and performance.
  • Develop, maintain, and optimize workbooks and dashboards to support detection engineering and SOC visibility.
  • Support reporting needs tied to threat detection outcomes, metrics, and operational insights.
  • Define and document required fields per data source to enable effective detection and investigation.
  • Identify and remediate high-cost/expensive detections to improve signal-to-noise ratio and manage platform consumption.

Automation

  • Design, build, and support automation solutions that improve efficiency, consistency, and time-to-response across security operations.

SOC Support & Collaboration

  • Maintain strong SOC partnerships and provide support for SOC inquiries related to the Azure and Microsoft Defender portals, including troubleshooting and operational guidance.

The successful candidate would possess these skills

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The team

Deloitte Technology US (DT - US) helps power Deloitte's success, which serves many of the world's largest, most respected organizations. We develop and deploy cutting-edge internal and go-to-market solutions that help Deloitte operate effectively and lead in the market. Our reputation is built on a tradition of delivering with excellence.

The ~3,000 professionals in DT - US deliver services including:

  • Cyber Security
  • Technology Support
  • Technology & Infrastructure
  • Applications
  • Relationship Management
  • Strategy & Communications
  • Project Management
  • Financials

Cyber Security

Cyber Security vigilantly protects Deloitte and client data. The team leads a strategic cyber risk program that adapts to a rapidly changing threat landscape, changes in business strategies, risks, and vulnerabilities. Using situational awareness, threat intelligence, and building a security culture across the organization, the team helps to protect the Deloitte brand.

Areas of focus include:

  • Risk & Compliance
  • Identity & Access Management
  • Data Protection
  • Cyber Design
  • Threat Detection
  • Incident Response
  • Security Architecture
  • Business Partnership

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Business Administration.
  • Minimum 8 years of various technology experience.
  • Minimum 3 years' cyber security experience within SIEM Administration.
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Sentinel, including building and tuning analytics rules, hunting queries, workbooks, automation, and managing the SIEM data model and workspace.
  • Strong KQL proficiency for threat hunting, detection logic, investigation, and telemetry analysis.

Preferred:

  • MS Sentinel SC-200 badge
  • SOAR and automation experience, especially with Azure Logic Apps, playbooks, and integrations with ITSM or third-party APIs.
  • Cloud Fundamental Certificates.
  • Ability to communicate network security issues to peers and lower management.
  • Hands-on experience with Linux, working knowledge of multiple Cloud environments, Azure O365, and SOC processes.
  • An understanding of possible attack activities such as network probing/ scanning, DDOS, malicious code activity and possible abnormal activities, such as worms, Trojans, viruses, etc.

The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $97,600 to $200,600.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

The Opportunity


The Singla Lab at the University of Central Florida College of Medicine in Orlando seeks a highly motivated, creative, and ambitious postdoctoral fellow to study treatment resistance and tumor-microenvironment interactions in various cancer models and associated toxicological studies.


This part of the project focuses on developing cancer models; therefore, we are looking for a postdoctoral fellow who will conduct innovative cancer research using functional studies with 3D culture models and organoids. Identify the underlying mechanisms using cell biology and molecular biology techniques. They will also be expected to perform research, write manuscripts, assist in grant proposals, and present their findings at local and national meetings. The fellow should work independently, lead project(s), troubleshoot issues, present their work, and train other lab members as part of their postdoctoral training.


Prof. Singla's lab is a friendly and welcoming place with great excitement for cancer and cardiovascular research.


Minimum Qualifications


The ideal candidate should have a Ph.D. in cancer biology/immunology/molecular biology with a strong background in cancer cell culture models (2D, 3D, and organoids), cancer mouse models such as xenotransplantation models, and basic and advanced molecular biology techniques. Candidates should possess a track record of scientific productivity, as well as excellent oral, written, and interpersonal communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications


Experience in testing preclinical animal models, including PDX using humanized mice, syngeneic mouse models, and xenografts, is highly desired.


Additional Application Materials Required


A cover letter, CV, names and contact information of three professional references, and date of availability will be required to be considered.


Special Instructions to the Applicants


All applicants must be authorized to work for any U.S. employer. H-1B visa sponsorship is not available for this position, and the university cannot accommodate H-1B transfers or employment-based visa processing for individuals currently sponsored by another employer.


This position is funded by contracts and grants and is contingent upon available funding.


Unless explicitly stated on the job posting, it is UCF's expectation that an employee of UCF will reside in Florida as of the date the employment begins.


Additional Requirements related to Research Positions


Pursuant to Florida State Statute 1010.35, prior to offering employment to certain individuals in research-related positions, UCF is required to conduct additional screening. Applicants subject to additional screening include any citizen of a foreign country who is not a permanent resident of the U.S., or who is a citizen or permanent resident but is affiliated with or has had at least 1 year of education, employment, or training in China, Cuba, Iran, Russia, North Korea, Syria, or Venezuela.


The additional screening requirements only apply to research-related positions, including, but not limited to faculty, graduate positions, individuals compensated by research grants or contract funds, post-doctoral positions, undergraduate positions, visiting assistant professors, and visiting research associates.

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Mortgage Loan Officer, Accounting / Finance / Banking
Job.JobDescription:
Mortgage Originator

Reports to: Assistant Vice President of Mortgage Services

Salary: Six-Month Ramp-Up Compensation Package follow by a Commission Based Structure ($15,000 sign on bonus)

Why Join Us?

At Trustco Bank, we're committed to fostering a supportive and inclusive workplace where our employees can grow their careers. We believe that our people are our greatest asset and consider our employees as family. We value each team member's contribution and offer a supportive, collaborative work environment. Join Trustco Bank as a Mortgage Originator and make a meaningful impact by helping individuals and families realize their homeownership dreams. We offer a collaborative environment where your expertise is valued and your career can flourish.

Interested in making a difference? Apply today and become a vital part of Trustco Bank's dedicated team!

We believe that investing in our employees means investing in the future of our company. As a valued team member, you will be eligible for a generous compensation and benefits package that includes: medical, dental and vision insurance, a health savings account with an annual employer contribution, a 401(k)-retirement plan with generous employer match, paid time off plus 11 paid federal holidays, training and professional development programs, tuition reimbursement, reduced fees and rates on certain loan products, and much more!

About the Mortgage Originator Role

Unlock Your Earning Potential with the Area's Lowest Mortgage Rates

As a Mortgage Originator with Trustco Bank, you become the face of one of the region's strongest and most respected portfolio lenders. With consistently some of the lowest mortgage rates in the area and a long history of exceptional service, Trustco gives you a unique competitive edge to grow your business, expand your network, and build lifelong client relationships.

Highlights

• Portfolio lender advantages: Faster decisions + greater flexibility

• Some of the lowest mortgage rates in the area — a major selling point

• Strong brand reputation with decades of stability and trust

• Supportive internal mortgage team for seamless processing

• Relationship-driven culture where your growth is a priority

Key Responsibilities

• Business Development & Networking

Build a powerful referral network through targeted marketing, prospecting, and consistent community presence. Develop strong partnerships with real estate agents, builders, and local professionals to generate high-quality mortgage leads and elevate Trustco's presence as the go-to lender.

• Community Engagement

Act as a brand ambassador at community events promoting homeownership and financial literacy. Your involvement strengthens Trustco's legacy as a community-focused lender committed to helping families achieve their financial goals.

• Client Consultation & Loan Analysis

Meet and engage borrowers, assess financial and credit profiles, and understand their homeownership goals. As a portfolio lender, Trustco gives you flexibility, faster decisions, and the ability to offer clients tailored mortgage solutions that set you apart from competitors.

• Product Promotion & Client Education

Highlight Trustco's full suite of mortgage programs, emphasizing our low interest rates, transparent terms, and unmatched client support. Provide easy-to-understand guidance so clients feel confident and informed at every step.

• Loan Processing & Documentation

Gather and organize all required documentation with accuracy and attention to detail. Collaborate with our in-house Mortgage Department to ensure fast, smooth processing and an exceptional client experience from application to closing.

This job description is not exhaustive; duties and responsibilities may change at any time with or without notice.

Qualifications

Required

  • High School Diploma or equivalent; previous sales experience in residential lending preferred. A bachelor's degree in business or related field is a plus.
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills; highly organized with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite, especially Excel and Word.
  • Must be eligible and registered in the Nationwide Mortgage Licensing System & Registry (NMLS) in compliance with the SAFE Act.
  • Fluent in English; bilingual a plus
  • Access to reliable transportation

Schedule

Full-time position. Monday – Friday, 8:30 AM – 5:00 PM. Flexibility for evening and weekend work as needed.

Travel: Occasional travel within the community and surrounding areas to meet clients and attend networking events.

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement:


Trustco Bank is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, marital status, genetic information, disability, or protected veteran status. This includes, but is not limited to, the following:

• Hiring, placement, upgrading, transfer, demotion or promotion

• Treatment during employment

• Rates of pay or other forms of compensation

• Selection for training, including apprenticeship

• Layoff or termination

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Construction & Skilled Trades, Creative / Design / Architecture
Job.JobDescription:
JOB SUMMARY

The primary function of the Virtual Design and Construction (VDC) Manager is to lead the integration of VDC technologies to enhance project delivery and collaboration across all stakeholders, ensuring the successful execution of projects through their lifecycle. The VDC Manager, serves as the technical expert for the project team, ensuring that VDC processes are effectively utilized to meet Universal Standards and expectations.  The VDC Manager acts as the liaison between the project team, design, construction, and other stakeholders, ensuring all VDC processes are effectively utilized to meet Universal Standards and expectations, while also ensuring effective coordination, collaboration, and delivery of a high-quality, on-time, and on-budget project.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Project Development: Lead the implementing VDC processes and standards. This includes managing access to the VDC database to ensure that all design and construction activities align with project goals and objectives.
  • Technical Expertise: Serve as the primary point of contact regarding Universal Creatives VDC standards and processes for the project team, ensuring that the project outcomes reflect the vision, goals, and requirements of Universal Creative.
  • Collaboration & Coordination: Partner with architects, engineers, vendors, contractors, and other stakeholders to integrate VDC tools into project workflows, facilitate coordination, and resolve conflicts early in the design and construction phases.
  • Training & Support: Lead training initiatives for project teams and stakeholders on VDC tools and technologies, promoting effective adoption and usage throughout the project.
  • Risk Mitigation and Reporting: Proactively identify and report risks related to design and construction phases, leveraging VDC tools such as clash detection to analyze potential issues and collaborate with project teams to develop and implement mitigation strategies.
  • Quality Control: Ensure that all VDC deliverables, such as models, drawings, and simulations, meet the required standards and are accurate and reliable.
  • Understand and actively participate in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UO policy, procedures, training and team member involvement activities. 
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

  • Supervises an Exempt team.
  • Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  • Consistent attendance is a job requirement.
  • Preferred technical skills include:
    • Proficient in the use of Autodesks Revit and Autodesk Navisworks.
    • Solid understanding of Autodesk Construction Cloud as a collaborative tool for project coordination and management

EDUCATION

  • Bachelors degree in architecture, construction management, or any construction-related field required. 
  • Masters degree in architecture or related field is preferred.
  • Registered architect or engineer would be a plus.
  • Certification in VDC (e.g., VDC Professional, BIM Manager Certification), BIM (e.g., Autodesk Certified Professional) or construction management is highly preferred.

EXPERIENCE

  • At least 5 years of experience in Building Information Management (BIM), Virtual Design and Construction (VDC) or related field required. A minimum of 3 years in a BIM/VDC leadership or managerial role.
  • Proven expertise in managing VDC processes, including Building Information Modeling (BIM), 3D modeling, clash detection, across a range of project types (e.g., commercial, theme park, industrial, infrastructure).
  • A minimum of 3 years of experience in themed entertainment or other large-scale, complex projects is required.

Your talent, skills and experience will be rewarded with a competitive compensation package.

Job.JobTitle: Manager, Global Mobility Operations & Programs (2 Year Project Assignment)
Job.JobDescription:
JOB SUMMARY:

The Manager, Global Mobility Operations and Programs, ensures effective governance of global mobility processes through the assignee lifecycle, including coordinating across Talent and Culture, systems, and vendor platforms. This role manages payroll and transfer operations, oversees the assignee tax lifecycle, coordinates communications for assignees and external stakeholders, and maintains and improves mobility programs and policies.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Own global mobility processes, controls, service standards, and operating procedures across mobility vendors and internal UDX stakeholders, including Talent and Culture, Finance, Payroll, and business leadership.
  • Establish roles, handoffs, escalation paths, documentation requirements, and service expectations; monitor performance and recurring issues; and lead corrective actions to promote consistent service delivery, clear accountability, data integrity, and timely resolution.
  • Manage the assignee lifecycle for both the relocation and international administrative changes.
  • Manage global and domestic mobility policies and program guidelines to support market competitiveness and compliance with legal, tax, and local employment requirements. Regularly review policy utilization, exceptions, assignee feedback, service data, and external market practices to identify gaps and improvement opportunities.
  • Partners with Legal, Tax, Payroll, Finance, Talent and Culture, business leaders, and mobility vendors to assess impacts, develop recommendations, secure required approvals, implement changes, and educate stakeholders on updated requirements and processes.
  • Manage the end-to-end mobility tax lifecycle, including initiation, authorization, provider coordination, compliance milestones, reconciliations, and assignment closeout.
  • Coordinate with assignees, mobility tax providers, Payroll, Finance, and Talent and Culture to maintain accurate assignment data, monitor deadlines and deliverables, resolve discrepancies, document approvals and exceptions, and ensure timely completion of tax-related activities.
  • Develop and manage clear, timely communications for assignees and stakeholders throughout the mobility lifecycle, including program guidance, process updates, key milestones, required actions, and changes to policies or procedures.
  • Coordinate content with internal subject-matter experts and external providers, maintain approved templates and distribution channels, tailor messages for the intended audience, and use questions and feedback to improve future communications.
  • Understand and actively participate in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UDX policy, procedures, training, and team member involvement activities.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities (KSAs) required.

This position will be expected to effectively handle a large volume of non-routine, complex tasks in which general policies need to be applied to frequently changing situations. It may have strong influence on decisions of a major nature in regards to the global assignments utilized by the company. It will also require a high degree of tact & diplomacy to obtain favorable outcomes or maintain good will amongst assignees, other UPR departments and/or third party service providers.

  • Strong client service, people management, and written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build effective relationships across assignees, business leaders, internal partners, and external providers.
  • Ability to organize and analyze data, including presentation materials and communications pieces
  • Solid base knowledge of compensation, benefits, international payroll, mobility and service models
  • Solid base knowledge of tax compliance
  • Strong financial acumen and analytical skills
  • Solid research and problem-solving skills
  • Experience in vendor management
  • Results-oriented, pragmatic ability to make the complex understandable
  • Multi-lingual skills related to UPR business is preferred
  • Ability to travel occasionally
  • Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  • Consistent attendance is a job requirement.

EDUCATION:

  • Bachelors degree is required in Human Resources, Business Administration or a related field.
  • Global Remuneration or Mobility Certification is preferred.

EXPERIENCE:

  • 5+ years of relevant Human Resources, Global Mobility or related field experience
  • Previous experience in international human resources and/or international payroll issues strongly preferred
  • Previous relocation management company and vendor management strongly preferred
  • Project management and communication experience preferred
  • ; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Job.JobTitle: Director, Journey Automation & Marketing Data Operations
Job.JobDescription:
JOB SUMMARY:

The Director, Journey Automation & Marketing Data Operations leads the strategy, operations, governance, audience development, and journey execution capabilities required to deliver data-driven marketing across Universal Destinations & Experiences (UDX).

This role owns the development of executable audiences and the execution of automated guest journeys, ensuring guest and marketing data can be reliably translated into actionable targeting strategies, personalized experiences, campaigns, and journeys. The Director oversees Marketing Data Operations and Journey Automation, establishing scalable processes, governance, and operational standards across UDX destinations and channels.

Working across Marketing, Commercial Analytics, Digital, Technology, Privacy, and Marketing Operations, this leader will strengthen UDXs ability to use first-party guest data, Analytics-developed insights and models, and measurable learning to advance modern marketing capabilities across platforms including Snowflake, Adobe Experience Platform (AEP), and Adobe Journey Optimizer (AJO).

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

Audience Strategy, Targeting & Activation

  • Own the development, creation, validation, and activation of executable marketing audiences across UDX channels and destinations.
  • Lead the operational strategy for audience segmentation, targeting, eligibility, suppression, personalization, and activation across campaigns and automated journeys.
  • Translate Marketing business objectives into scalable audience and targeting strategies, working with Commercial Analytics to incorporate audience insights, segmentation, predictive models, propensity scores, recommendations, and measurement learnings.
  • Clarify and manage the handoff between Analytics-developed strategy, insights, and models and this functions ownership of executable audience development and activation.
  • Establish reusable audience frameworks, naming conventions, validation standards, and operating processes across campaigns and guest journeys.
  • Enable lifecycle, behavioral, trigger-based, and personalized marketing use cases through reliable audience development and activation practices.
  • Partner with Marketing, CRM, Media, Digital Experience, Commercial Analytics, and destination teams to improve audience activation effectiveness.
  • Translate complex technical and data topics into clear business decisions and recommendations.

Guest Data Operations & Governance

  • Own the operating model for guest and marketing data used for audience activation and personalization.
  • Establish standards for data readiness, quality, validation, taxonomy, documentation, and lifecycle management.
  • Ensure guest profiles, attributes, and audiences are reliable and available for marketing use.
  • Establish SLAs, controls, monitoring, and escalation processes for guest data operations.
  • Partner with Data Engineering and Technology on data issues, dependencies, and capability requirements.
  • Empower technical managers and leads to own day-to-day implementation while removing barriers and resolving cross-functional dependencies.

Journey Automation Execution & Marketing Data Enablement

  • Own the execution of automated marketing journeys, including journey configuration, launch readiness, activation, monitoring, and operational optimization in Adobe Journey Optimizer or comparable platforms.
  • Provide business and operational leadership for the data, audience, and journey capabilities that support data-driven marketing activation, including Adobe AEP and AJO.
  • Ensure audiences, attributes, triggers, eligibility rules, analytical segments, propensity scores, recommendations, content dependencies, and data requirements are ready for journey execution.
  • Operationalize Analytics-developed segments, scores, and recommendations with agreed refresh schedules, validation routines, and monitoring standards.
  • Establish repeatable processes from business requirements through data readiness, audience creation, journey configuration, QA, activation, monitoring, and optimization.
  • Support both batch and near-real-time marketing use cases, including triggered, behavioral, lifecycle, and personalized journey execution.
  • Partner closely with campaign automation, creative, production, and destination teams while maintaining accountability for audience development, journey setup, execution readiness, and operational performance.

Operational Excellence, Privacy & Controls

  • Establish the governance and operational discipline required to scale guest data activation, audience development, and journey execution responsibly.
  • Define KPIs and service levels for audience delivery, journey launch readiness, data quality, freshness, activation performance, issue resolution, measurement readiness, and learning adoption.
  • Ensure audience membership, journey exposure, treatment/control assignment, response, and activation performance data are available to Commercial Analytics for measurement and optimization.
  • Partner with Commercial Analytics before launch to implement agreed holdouts, treatment/control logic, tracking requirements, and learning plans for tests, campaigns, and journeys.
  • Drive root-cause analysis and continuous improvement, using test findings and performance insights to improve future audience activation and journey design.
  • Partner with Privacy, Legal, Security, and Data Governance to embed consent, preference, suppression, and responsible data-use requirements into audience development and journey execution processes.
  • Identify opportunities to automate, simplify, and improve manual processes across audience development, QA, journey execution, and performance monitoring.

People Leadership & Strategic Partnership

  • Lead and develop the Journey Automation & Marketing Data Operations teams.
  • Establish clear roles, priorities, career development, and accountability for audience development, journey execution, data operations, and cross-functional delivery.
  • Manage capacity and resources against enterprise demand.
  • Serve as the senior escalation point for guest data, targeting, audience development, audience activation, journey execution, and journey performance issues.
  • Represent the function with senior Marketing, Commercial Analytics, Digital, Data, and Technology leadership.
  • Understands and actively participates in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UO policy, procedures, training and team member involvement activities.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Strong understanding of audience development, segmentation, targeting, identity, customer profiles, personalization, journey execution, and marketing activation.
  • Strong working knowledge of first-party data activation and the operational requirements needed to support batch, near-real-time, and triggered marketing use cases.
  • Understanding of modern customer data architectures and the relationship between source data, cloud data platforms, identity, audience creation, and downstream activation.
  • Working knowledge of data privacy, consent, preference management, suppression logic, and responsible use of customer data.
  • Ability to translate business and marketing objectives into clear data, audience, and technical requirements.
  • Strong operational mindset with demonstrated ability to create repeatable processes, standards, controls, and performance measures.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify root causes and drive resolution across complex dependencies.
  • Ability to communicate complex data and technology concepts clearly to both technical and nontechnical audiences.
  • Strong executive presence and ability to influence across functions without direct authority.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead through ambiguity, balance competing priorities, and operate effectively in a fast-paced enterprise environment.
  • Working knowledge of SQL and data structures is valuable; direct engineering expertise is not required.
  • Demonstrated ability to partner with analytics teams on experimentation, business-impact measurement, and deployment of analytical outputs into marketing platforms.

EDUCATION:

  • Bachelors degree in Marketing, Business, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.
  • Advanced degree or relevant industry certifications in marketing technology, data, analytics, or digital transformation are beneficial.

EXPERIENCE:

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in marketing technology, customer data, CRM, audience management, targeting, personalization, digital marketing operations, or related disciplines.
  • 5+ years of people leadership experience, including responsibility for team development, organizational priorities, and cross-functional delivery.
  • Demonstrated experience operationalizing first-party customer or guest data for marketing use cases.
  • Experience owning audience development, segmentation, targeting, customer profile activation, journey orchestration, and journey execution capabilities.
  • Experience working within modern cloud data and marketing technology ecosystems, including Snowflake, Adobe Experience Platform (AEP), and Adobe Journey Optimizer (AJO) or comparable platforms.
  • Experience establishing scalable operating models, data-quality controls, service levels, governance standards, and issue-resolution processes.
  • Experience partnering across Marketing, Data, Technology, Analytics, Privacy, Legal, and other enterprise functions.
  • Experience partnering with Commercial Analytics or comparable analytics teams to translate segmentation, predictive models, propensity scores, recommendations, experimentation plans, and test findings into executable marketing audiences, automated journeys, and measurable activation outcomes.
  • Experience supporting complex, multi-brand, multi-destination, or matrixed organizations is strongly valued.
  • Experience within travel, hospitality, entertainment, retail, or other high-volume consumer environments is beneficial.

Your talent, skills and experience will be rewarded with a competitive compensation package.

JOB SUMMARY:

Leads and executes the most difficult and unique purchasing projects. This classification reviews a wide range of purchase requisitions including capital and expense items or services; investigates and develops sources of supplies, preparing bid specifications; issues bid requests and reviews quotations. Also requires interpretation of purchasing procedures to departments and vendors, as a specialist in assigned material categories, which require a high degree of technical knowledge based on sourcing category. Works with key stakeholders and legal to optimize best value for Universal Destinations and Experiences. The Sourcing Manager is responsible for the timely placement of purchase orders and delivery of materials to meet customer order requirements and maintain stock inventory levels within approved guidelines. The Sourcing Manager sources, evaluates, and purchases services, supplies, and equipment based on price, service, quality, and warranty. The Sourcing Manager is responsible for collaborating with business partners (internal and external) to assist with writing specifications and developing appropriate timelines to ensure the supply of material and services is taken into consideration to maximize our guest experience. The Sourcing Manager prepares bid forms, handles the RFX process, analyzes bid results, and makes recommendations and awards contracts. The Sourcing Manager authorizes and processes purchase orders in accordance with Universal Orlandos policies and procedures while taking into account total cost of ownership (TCO) for UDX. Potential to lead or supervise Sourcing Specialists, Associate Sourcing Specialists, and support staff in the future.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Researches possible sources/suppliers for requested items, provides alternatives or substitutions when applicable, and assists internal requesters with select requirements. Job.JobTitle: Senior Surety Underwriter - Small to Mid Commercial
Job.JobDescription:
Description

Liberty Mutual Surety is currently recruiting for a Senior Surety Underwriter to join ourSmall to Mid Commercial Surety team in Florida.

As a Senior Surety Underwriter you will develop and underwrite profitable surety business, and service independent agents, brokers,and Small to Mid Commercial accounts within an assigned territory. Using your excellent relationship skills, you will build and maintain positive partnerships our agents, brokers, and accounts as a trusted advisor and underwriting resource for our producers and customers. You will also use yourbusiness and financial acumen to perform primary credit underwriting and financial/risk analysis, provide recommendations, and make decisions on new and existing accounts. This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced andself-motivated surety professional looking to grow their career with a top surety company that focuses on its employees and customers first.


Liberty Mutual Surety, a business unit of Liberty Mutual Insurance, is the worlds largest globally Surety, including in the United States. Conducting business worldwide through fronting relationships and Liberty-owned subsidiaries, we provide bonds in over 60 countries for construction firms, manufacturers and suppliers, and commercial enterprises on an account and transactional basis. We are committed to building mutually profitable relationships by providing smart business solutions, ease of doing business, and consistent, responsive service. Liberty Mutual Surety is dedicated to the communities we serve and highly values a diverse workforce in more than 18 countries.

Responsibilities:

  • Underwrite and negotiate accounts to maximize profitability whilst minimizing risk, which may include the most complex accounts based on level of role. Makes thorough evaluations and assessments of a customers financial, technical, organizational, and management capacities, including experience, desired objectives as well as a subjective judgment of character.
  • Manage the profitability and retention of an assigned book of business while continue to develop the portfolio through strong relationships and active engagement with new and existing agents and brokers. May assist in developing the marketing plan.
  • Performs analytical evaluations of financial statements on both a static and trend basis. Determines the present and historical financial position of accounts and monitors financial position of risk through analysis of quarterly statements and work in progress data as appropriate.
  • Stay abreast of Liberty Mutual Surety and Global Risk Solutions product lines and identify/promote opportunities across with agents and brokers, leveraging domestic and global capabilities.
  • Responsible for investigation, analyzing, and managing all necessary underwriting/accounting/workflow issues, within framework ofSurety policies and procedures.
  • May assess and identify changes in all aspects of the business including, but not limited to, work program to financial strength criteria, nature of work performed (inherent risk), accuracy and timeliness of data flow, and exposure analyses. Coordinate and surface issues to Home Office Underwriters and Field Management.
  • Assists in the evaluation of business continuity arrangements and funding mechanisms (such as adequacy of life insurance) to preclude financial drain of customer in the event of the demise of (an) owner or other insurable loss.
  • May mentor more junior staff based on level.
  • Performs special projects and other duties as assigned.

If the selected candidate lives within 50 miles of a GRS office, then the selected candidate should be prepared to come into the office two days/week, but this is subject to change.

Qualifications
  • Degree in Business or equivalent typically required
  • A minimum of 2.5 years, typically 3 or more years, of surety UW experience and/or other related experience
  • Proven analytical ability to evaluate and judge underwriting risks within scope of responsibility that includes competence with all phases and aspects of the underwriting process and proficiency in the use of qualitative and quantitative tools and techniques
  • Must demonstrate comprehension of complex technical underwriting issues and be capable of defining and implementing necessary underwriting and administrative processes/workflows to properly manage or administer those issues
  • Proven track record of developing and underwriting profitable Surety business
About Us

Pay Philosophy: The typical starting salary range for this role is determined by a number of factors including skills, experience, education, certifications and location. The full salary range for this role reflects the competitive labor market value for all employees in these positions across the national market and provides an opportunity to progress as employees grow and develop within the role. Some roles at Liberty Mutual have a corresponding compensation plan which may include commission and/or bonus earnings at rates that vary based on multiple factors set forth in the compensation plan for the role.

At Liberty Mutual, our goal is to create a workplace where everyone feels valued, supported, and can thrive. We build an environment that welcomes a wide range of perspectives and experiences, with inclusion embedded in every aspect of our culture and reflected in everyday interactions. This comes to life through comprehensive benefits, workplace flexibility, professional development opportunities, and a host of opportunities provided through our Employee Resource Groups. Each employee plays a role in creating our inclusive culture, which supports every individual to do their best work. Together, we cultivate a community where everyone can make a meaningful impact for our business, our customers, and the communities we serve.

We value your hard work, integrity and commitment to make things better, and we put people first by offering you benefits that support your life and well-being. To learn more about our benefit offerings please visit: https://www.libertymutualgroup.com/about-lm/careers/benefits

Liberty Mutual is an equal opportunity employer. We will not tolerate discrimination on the basis of race, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, age, disability, veteran's status, pregnancy, genetic information or on any basis prohibited by federal, state or local law.

A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.

The Associate Core Creator Manager leads the strategy, relationships and programming that connect EA

SPORTS American Football with its most engaged creator communities across Madden NFL

and College Football.

This role owns a critical, year-round creator capability spanning launch, live service and major

franchise moments. They will build trusted relationships with core creators, develop programs

that drive audience engagement and business impact, and create high-performing content that

can be amplified across creator channels, paid media and the broader marketing ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the Core Creator strategy across Madden NFL and College Football, developing year-round programming that supports franchise, audience and business objectives.
  • Build and manage strategic creator relationships, serving as the primary partner for creators deeply connected to our games, communities and live-service ecosystem.
  • Lead major creator programs and activations, including Creator Capture, Open Directory, Creator Network, Creator Bullpen, Title Update programming and paid creator campaigns.
  • Support live-service growth by activating creators around Ultimate Team, seasonal programs, competitive play, Drops, product updates and other priority moments.
  • Develop high-performing creator content that can serve both creator audiences and downstream marketing channels including paid media, clipping and seeding.
  • Partner across Marketing, Franchise, Communications, Community, Paid Media and Analytics to integrate creators into broader go-to-market and live-service strategies.
  • Measure and optimize creator performance, using audience, engagement and business results to improve programming and investment decisions.
  • Manage creator operations and execution, including contracts, rights, approvals, disclosures, embargoes, payments and talent coordination.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong experience in creator, influencer, social, community or entertainment marketing.
  • Demonstrated ability to build trusted relationships with creators and external talent.
  • Experience developing integrated programs that connect audience engagement to measurable marketing or business outcomes.
  • Strong understanding of gaming, sports and creator culture; deep familiarity with football audiences is highly valuable.
  • Ability to operate strategically while managing complex, fast-moving execution.
  • Strong cross-functional leadership, communication and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Comfortable using performance data and insights to evaluate effectiveness and evolve strategy.

The Associate Core Creator Manager maintains a strong, always-on creator ecosystem that gives Madden NFL and College Football trusted access to core audiences, produces high-performing content, strengthens live-service engagement and increases the effectiveness of broader marketing

investment.

Charles Schwab Bank (CSB) has proven successful in serving the lending needs of Schwab's core Retail consumer clients which is an important business line that we will continue to grow. We now have a unique opportunity to expand our lending capabilities by targeting Schwab's high net worth (HNW) clients and registered investment advisory (RIA) firms. To seize this growth opportunity, we will build a separate, parallel lending business model leveraging Charles Schwab Premier Bank (CSPB). HNW clients and RIA firms have complex credit profiles and higher service level expectations requiring a different approach with specialized expertise to serve their needs.

Our Opportunity:

The Senior Banking team is seeking a high potential candidate to partner with Schwab Wealth Advisory partners and their end clients by providing Banking and Credit solutions. Bank lending products include residential mortgages, home equity lines of credit, and securities-based lending. Schwab Bank also offers trust services and deposit products including checking and savings accounts. The Senior Banker will be responsible for serving Schwab Wealth Advisory clients and will work closely with partners across the Bank including the Bank Sales Team, Bank Credit Team, Bank Operations, Trust and Deposit service teams to develop solutions and recommendations meeting the unique needs of Schwab Wealth Advisory clients. This role encompasses internal marketing such as meetings with various Schwab Partners and client meetings as may be requested. The Senior Banker will also coordinate with Schwab Wealth Advisory clients' accountants, attorneys or other professionals as needed. Additionally, the Senior Banker acts as the primary contact for assisting loan inquiries, loans in process and problem resolution that may need to be completed for both origination and servicing requests.

What you'll do:

  • Advise Schwab Wealth Advisory clients on appropriate Bank lending, deposit and trust solutions including products, pricing and recommended deal structures. Gather information from clients using internal and external resources for the completion of the application process.
  • Partner with Schwab teammates in assigned geographies to discuss Schwab Wealth Advisory client base and identify lending, deposit and trust opportunities and recommend opportunity action plans.
  • Establish a reputation of execution and excellence. Gain confidence of Schwab Partners to fully develop lending, deposit and trust opportunities with their SchwabWealth Advisory clients.
  • Develop and present creative and intelligent lending, deposit and trust solutions; consult partners, such as credit specialists, as needed.
  • Take ownership of banking client experience from initial contact to loan funding or account establishment, working closely with partners and third-party providers to ensure a smooth process for Schwab Wealth Advisoryclients.
  • Work with and communicate effectively with Schwab partners.
  • Responsible for the early identification of complex transaction structures, such as: entity, trust, guarantor, co-op, unique property requirements, condensed timeframes, properties under construction, and need for multiple co-borrowers.
  • Maintain full awareness of status for all SchwabWealth Advisory banking applications in pipeline and function as primary Schwab Bank liaison for all parties involved in bank account opening process, including service, credit, risk and third-party vendors.
  • Address all issues surfaced during loan process and assist with underwriting requests

What you have


Required Qualifications:

  • Minimum of 5 years of successful lending consultation and business development experience in Financial Services or working closely with HNW/UHNW clients.
  • Expert knowledge of credit products including residential mortgage products, home equity lines of credit, and securities-based loans. Familiarity with bank deposit and cash management products and brokerage margin product as well as business banking requirements and structures.
  • Proven ability to analyze cash flow and balance sheet of HNW/UHNW retail brokerage clients and develop client's personal financial statement. General understanding of estate planning techniques, entity structuring, and tax strategies.
  • Strong skills in diplomacy, discretion, and professionalism; ability to efficiently, tactfully & professionally screen, manage and/or decline transactions while maintaining partner and HNW/UHNW client relationships.
  • Possess excellent oral and written communication skills. Exceptional presentation skills.
  • Strong relationship building capabilities with Schwab teammates, HNW/UHNW clients, and matrix partners (e.g., service, credit, risk and third-party vendors).
  • Strong collaboration skills in a team-oriented environment.
  • Attention to detail and the ability to multi-task and work efficiently, independently and with teams, to meet tight deadlines with minimal supervision.
  • Strong command of mortgage underwriting guidelines. (Completion of formal credit training strongly preferred)
  • Series 7 and 63/65 or 66 licenses required.
  • NMLS license required (To be obtained within 90 days of employment)

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Undergraduate or advanced degree preferred.
  • Banking background with experience working with HNW/UHNW brokerage clients strongly preferred.
  • NMLS license required (To be obtained within 90 days of employment)

You demonstrate these behaviors:

  • Building Collaborative Relationships: The ability to develop, maintain, and strengthen partnerships with others inside or outside of the organization who can provide information, assistance, and support.
  • Customer Orientation: Demonstrated concern for satisfying one's external and/or internal customers.
  • Diagnostic Information Gathering: Identifying the information needed to clarify a situation, seeking that information from appropriate sources, and using skillful questioning to draw out the information when others are reluctant to disclose it.
  • Fostering Teamwork: As a team member, the ability and desire to work cooperatively with others on a team; as a team leader, interest, skill, and success in getting groups to learn to work together cooperatively.
  • Results Orientation: Focusing on the desired result of one's own or one's units work; setting challenging goals, focusing effort on the goals, and meeting or exceeding them.

#SchwabBTSjobs


What's in it for you

Job.JobDescription:
Your opportunity


At Schwab, you're empowered to make an impact on your career. Here, innovative thought meets creative problem solving, helping us challenge the status quo and transform the finance industry together.

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis without employer sponsorship.

As a Senior Manager, Digital Product Management, you will lead shared digital capabilities that connect representative and client communication channels with the platforms used by Schwab's client-facing representatives. You will own product strategy and execution across channel integration, interaction data, artificial intelligence, and authentication capabilities that help representatives better understand client interactions and take meaningful action.

Initially, you will support a modern representative servicing platform and Salesforce while designing capabilities that can scale across additional applications and business areas. This role combines product strategy, platform thinking, people leadership, technical curiosity, and enterprise influence to turn complex interaction data into secure, reusable capabilities and practical representative experiences.

What You'll Do

Product Strategy and Ownership

  • Define and maintain product vision, strategy, roadmaps, priorities, and measurable outcomes for interaction intelligence and communication-channel integration.
  • Translate representative, client, business, and application needs into prioritized capabilities and delivery plans.
  • Balance immediate application needs with reusable enterprise services capable of supporting multiple products and business areas.
  • Establish clear product boundaries, ownership, governance, service expectations, and adoption plans.
  • Partner with product teams and stakeholders to establish priorities, sequencing, delivery expectations, and measurable outcomes.

Communication Channel Integration

  • Lead product strategy for integrating NICE, Microsoft Teams, Zoom, Yext, and future communication channels with representative-facing digital platforms.
  • Define scalable approaches for connecting interaction data and related services with consuming applications.
  • Partner with channel owners, product teams, engineering, and architecture to define requirements, sequencing, reliability expectations, and operating models.
  • Navigate dependencies involving identity, permissions, data access, retention, consent, security, privacy, and regulatory requirements.

Artificial Intelligence and Interaction Intelligence

  • Lead the product direction and delivery of AI-powered interaction assistance and the supporting interaction-data capabilities.
  • Define how transcripts, interaction metadata, summaries, signals, and AI-generated insights are captured, processed, governed, and made available to applications.
  • Enable initial use cases within a modern representative servicing platform and Salesforce while building capabilities that may support future AI-powered tools and enterprise consumers.
  • Partner with application teams to ensure shared capabilities address user needs while remaining reusable and scalable.
  • Establish expectations for AI quality, accuracy, transparency, security, governance, and appropriate human review.
  • Define measures for adoption, usefulness, processing quality, representative efficiency, risk, and business value.

Phone Interaction Authentication

  • Partner with Enterprise Architecture and key stakeholders to define solution architecture supporting authentication within phone interactions.
  • Lead delivery of shared capabilities supporting phone authentication within the modern representative servicing platform.
  • Coordinate across channel, identity, security, architecture, compliance, and application teams to resolve end-to-end dependencies.
  • Balance representative usability and client experience with security, operational resilience, privacy, and regulatory expectations.

Cross-Functional Leadership and Delivery

  • Lead multidisciplinary teams through discovery, design, development, testing, launch, adoption, and ongoing product improvement.
  • Partner across engineering, architecture, data, AI, UX, operations, legal, risk, compliance, and business teams.
  • Build alignment among teams operating with different priorities, funding models, delivery schedules, and technical environments.
  • Make clear product decisions when application-specific requirements conflict with the long-term strategy of a shared capability.
  • Communicate product strategy, decisions, trade-offs, progress, dependencies, and risks to senior leaders and delivery teams.
  • Support planning, funding, release readiness, dependency management, adoption, and operational transition.

Why You're Set Up for Success

You'll have the opportunity to combine product strategy, platform thinking, artificial intelligence, technology, data, client experience, and enterprise leadership while shaping capabilities used by Schwab's client-facing representatives.

The role provides meaningful ownership across the product lifecycle, from understanding representative and business needs through product strategy, prioritization, roadmap development, delivery, adoption, measurement, and continued improvement.

You will work across product, engineering, architecture, data, AI, security, risk, compliance, operations, and business functions, giving you an opportunity to influence both immediate representative experiences and the development of reusable capabilities that can scale more broadly across Schwab.

Schwab Training and Development

Schwab supports ongoing learning through role-based development, cross-functional exposure, coaching, and opportunities to deepen expertise in product management, digital platforms, Salesforce capabilities, data and analytics, AI-enabled experiences, technology delivery, and financial services.

You will have opportunities to strengthen capabilities in product discovery, platform product management, roadmap development, AI and data products, stakeholder leadership, technology integration, measurement, risk management, and digital innovation.

Career Pathing

This role develops highly transferable leadership capabilities spanning digital product management, enterprise platforms, artificial intelligence, data and analytics, technology integration, client experience, and business transformation. Success in the role can provide experience relevant to broader leadership opportunities across product, digital, technology, data and analytics, client experience, AI-enabled transformation, and enterprise strategy, based on business needs, demonstrated performance, and individual career interests.

Competitive Compensation

Schwab offers a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to support employees' financial, physical, and emotional well-being. Compensation for this role will be aligned with the approved job level, geographic location, relevant experience, and applicable MyJobs posting requirements.

What you have


The Expertise You Bring

Required Qualifications

  • Progressive experience in digital product management, platform product management, or a related product leadership role.
  • Demonstrated experience defining product strategy and leading complex products from discovery through delivery, adoption, and ongoing improvement.
  • Experience delivering shared platforms, data products, integration services, APIs, or enterprise capabilities used across multiple applications or business areas.
  • Strong understanding of communication channels, contact-center technologies, interaction data, or representative workflow platforms.
  • Experience working with artificial intelligence, machine learning, natural language processing, transcription, summarization, interaction analytics, or comparable AI-enabled capabilities.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead across product, business, engineering, architecture, data, security, legal, risk, and compliance teams.
  • Ability to translate complex product and technical concepts for executive, business, and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience creating outcome-based roadmaps, defining success measures, and using data to guide prioritization and product decisions.
  • Demonstrated ability to build alignment and influence teams and senior leaders without relying solely on direct authority.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 5+ years experience of digital product management
  • Experience with NICE, Microsoft Teams, Zoom, Hearsay, Salesforce, or comparable communication, contact-center, or customer relationship management platforms.
  • Experience developing products within financial services, wealth management, contact centers, or another highly regulated environment.
  • Familiarity with interaction transcripts, conversation intelligence, identity verification, authentication, data retention, privacy, and consent requirements.
  • Experience integrating AI capabilities into employee-facing or representative-facing workflows.
  • Experience developing reusable enterprise services supporting multiple applications, user experiences, or business units.
  • Familiarity with cloud-based integration patterns, event-driven services, data products, and APIs.

The Skills You Bring

  • Product Strategy: Connect customer and business needs to a clear product vision, roadmap, priorities, and measurable outcomes.
  • Strategic Thinking: Connect near-term product and delivery decisions to scalable, long-term platform strategies.
  • Product Management: Lead products throughout discovery, prioritization, development, launch, adoption, measurement, and continuous improvement.
  • Technology Fluency: Engage effectively with architecture, APIs, integrations, cloud services, data platforms, communication technologies, and AI-enabled solutions.
  • Artificial Intelligence: Translate AI, interaction data, transcription, summarization, and analytics capabilities into practical and responsible representative experiences.
  • Building Collaborative Relationships: Establish effective partnerships across product, engineering, architecture, data, AI, UX, operations, legal, risk, compliance, security, and business teams.
  • Influencing Others: Create alignment and drive decisions across teams and leaders with different priorities without relying solely on formal authority.
  • Communication: Translate complex technical and product concepts into clear decisions, recommendations, trade-offs, and executive-level narratives.
  • Decision Making: Navigate ambiguity, competing requirements, risk, and technical dependencies to make timely product decisions and establish accountable ownership.
  • Risk Management: Incorporate privacy, security, compliance, consent, transparency, data governance, and operational resilience into product strategy and design.

*In addition to a base salary (range posted), this role is also eligible for bonus or incentive opportunities*


What's in it for you

At Schwab, you're empowered to shape your future. We champion your growth through meaningful work, continuous learning, and a culture of trust and collaboration—so you can build the skills to make a lasting impact. Our Hybrid Work and Flexibility approach balances our ongoing commitment to workplace flexibility, serving our clients, and our strong belief in the value of being together in person on a regular basis.

We offer a competitive benefits package that takes care of the whole you – both today and in the future:

Your opportunity


At Schwab, you're empowered to make an impact on your career. Here, innovative thought meets creative problem solving, helping us challenge the status quo and transform the finance industry together. As an AI Integration Architect, you'll help shape how emerging artificial intelligence capabilities securely connect across Schwab's enterprise technology ecosystem. Working within Application Architecture, you'll partner with architects, engineers, product teams, and business leaders to translate evolving AI technologies into scalable architecture patterns that enable enterprise reuse, resilience, and responsible innovation.

You'll provide architecture leadership for highly available agentic AI solutions, connecting AI agents with enterprise APIs, cloud services, identity platforms, and large language models. You'll evaluate emerging technologies, establish architecture standards and governance->that inform governance, and solve complex integration, security, resiliency, and scalability challenges. Your ability to think strategically, connect complex systems, influence decisions, and balance long-term architecture with near-term business value will help shape Schwab's evolving AI ecosystem.

What you have


Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience addressing operational and non-functional architecture requirements, including scalability, performance, maintainability, resilience, recovery, security, and privacy.
  • 5+ years of experience with cloud technologies and API management, including enterprise API management platforms and more recently AI gateway platforms.
  • 5+ years of experience delivering services at scale on cloud platforms, preferably Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • 3+ years of experience identifying and mitigating OWASP Top 10 API security risks.
  • 1+ years of experience applying OWASP guidance for LLM and agentic applications to identify and mitigate risks such as prompt injection, sensitive information disclosure, excessive agency, tool misuse, and identity or privilege abuse.
  • Demonstrated ability to architect highly available and resilient agentic AI applications using fault tolerance, observability, workload isolation, retries, timeouts, circuit breakers, and graceful degradation.
  • Experience designing secure, scalable AI integration patterns spanning agent-to-agent communication, tool discovery, enterprise APIs, SaaS platforms, cloud services, middleware, AI and API gateways, and large language models.
  • Strong knowledge of delegated authorization, OAuth/OIDC, identity propagation, least-privilege access, traffic management, cloud platforms, Kubernetes, and service mesh technologies.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Ability to apply enterprise architecture, strategic thinking, and forward thinking to establish standards, guide technology strategy, anticipate industry trends, and influence enterprise-wide direction.
  • Strong conceptual thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to connect complex technologies and business needs into practical, reusable architecture patterns.
  • Demonstrated stakeholder management and communication skills, including the ability to influence architects, engineers, business partners, and executive leaders toward strategic decisions.
  • Ability to promote innovation and experimentation while balancing emerging technology opportunities with enterprise security, resilience, governance, and operational requirements.
  • Experience in financial services, investment management, or securities markets.

Job Summary

Performs technical and administrative work that focuses on designing, implementing, and maintaining security architecture patterns that meet regulatory obligations and data protection requirements as well as aligns with the business and organizational security strategy of SCADA systems. Works collaboratively with Water Reclamation System and Information Technology (IT) staff to build security controls and solutions compliant with approved architecture frameworks and standards. Participates in new projects, analysis of new requirements from platform teams, and technical discussions. Suggests best practices in development and operations areas including best security practices. Mentors and trains junior staff members on security protocols. Work is performed under limited supervision of the Wastewater Systems Manager. Work is evaluated while in progress and upon completion through direct observation, discussion, review of established procedures, and achievement of desired results.

Minimum Qualifications:

Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field and five (5) years of progressive IT experience, including experience in security architecture; or an equivalent combination of education, training, and experience. SCADA, ICS, PLC, CISSP, CISA, CISM, or other relevant security-related designation desired. Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) and Information Systems Security Architecture Professional (ISSAP) certifications are preferred. Valid Florida Driver's License required. Must pass a background investigation which includes a polygraph.

Position Summary

As a Project Manager in the Deloitte Technology-US (DT-US) Office of the CIO (OCIO) PMO team, you will apply sound project-management practices to support delivery of major internal technology initiatives. You will independently lead projects and small programs, ensuring work is planned, coordinated, and delivered on schedule, within budget, and to the expected quality standards.

The DT-US PMO is part of the Office of the CIO and supports technology strategy and transformational initiatives across AI, Cloud, Cyber, and other enterprise capabilities for Deloitte's professionals.

Recruiting for this role ends on 2/26/2027.

Work you'll do

As a DT-US PMO Project Manager, you will lead assigned projects and small programs from initiation through delivery and closure. You will manage scope, schedules, milestones, resources, budgets, risks, issues, dependencies, and stakeholder communications; identify and address delivery concerns early; and maintain clear, actionable reporting for sponsors and delivery teams.

You will build practical knowledge of the business area, technology, and delivery objectives for your assigned work. On larger or more complex programs, you will partner with a Program Manager or Associate Director and take ownership of defined projects or workstreams. You will also contribute to the PMO's evolving methods, templates, tools, and ways of working.

Responsibilities include

  • Independently lead cross-functional projects and straightforward programs, driving delivery of agreed scope, milestones, and outcomes.
  • Develop and maintain integrated project plans, schedules, workstream dependencies, and delivery metrics; monitor progress and take timely corrective action.
  • Coordinate project resources, identify capacity conflicts, and work with stakeholders to resolve issues affecting delivery.
  • Manage project risks and issues, develop mitigation and remediation plans, and escalate material concerns through the appropriate PMO and program channels.
  • Prepare clear, audience-appropriate status reports, dashboards, and decision materials for sponsors, stakeholders, and PMO leadership.
  • Track project budgets, forecasts, and variances, and support actions needed to maintain financial discipline.
  • Build effective working relationships with business, product, technical, and delivery stakeholders to maintain alignment and facilitate decisions.
  • Support more senior PMO leaders on complex programs by owning defined projects or workstreams and contributing to planning, risk management, and stakeholder coordination.
  • Apply established PMO methods and tools consistently and identify practical opportunities to improve delivery processes, templates, and team collaboration.

The successful candidate will be able to:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships across teams
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Apply sound business judgment to shape recommendations and drive informed decision-making
  • Connect activities across teams and initiatives to ensure leadership messaging and actions align
  • Ability to meet deadlines and proactively manage timeline risks
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of relevant project or program management experience supporting cross-functional IT initiatives using structured project-management methods and tools.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently manage project scope, schedules, milestones, resources, risks, issues, dependencies, and stakeholder communications.
  • Experience working with Agile and/or other software delivery methodologies and a solid understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).
  • Proficiency with project-management and reporting tools, such as MS Project & Planner, Azure DevOps, or ServiceNow.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related field
  • Ability to travel 0-10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Strong organizational, analytical, written, and verbal communication skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Experience with project or program financial management, including budgeting, forecasting, or variance tracking.
  • Experience working in a matrixed professional-services organization or consulting environment.
  • Strong risk-mitigation, stakeholder-management, prioritization, and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience working with blended onshore/offshore delivery teams.

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $88,000 to $163,000.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.
